import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import {
  Activity,
  Ban,
  CheckCircle2,
  ChevronRight,
  Fingerprint,
  Search,
  ShieldAlert,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { PageIntro } from "../../components/data-display/PageIntro";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { formatDate } from "../../lib/dates";
import type { AdminActivityRecord } from "../../types/admin";
import { useAdminActivity } from "../useAdmin";

type RiskFilter = "all" | AdminActivityRecord["risk"];

export default function AdminActivityPage() {
  const { label, t, locale } = useLocale();
  const activity = useAdminActivity();
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [risk, setRisk] = useState<RiskFilter>("all");
  const [selectedId, setSelectedId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    const value = search.trim().toLocaleLowerCase();
    return (activity.data || []).filter((item) => {
      if (risk !== "all" && item.risk !== risk) return false;
      if (!value) return true;
      return [t(item.actor), t(item.role), t(item.action), t(item.resource)]
        .join(" ")
        .toLocaleLowerCase()
        .includes(value);
    });
  }, [activity.data, risk, search, t]);
  const selected =
    (activity.data || []).find((item) => item.id === selectedId) ||
    filtered[0] ||
    null;
  if (activity.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (activity.isError)
    return <ErrorState retry={() => void activity.refetch()} />;
  return (
    <div className="container admin-page admin-activity-page">
      <PageIntro
        eyebrow={label("adminActivityEyebrow")}
        title={label("adminActivityTitle")}
        description={label("adminActivityBody")}
      />
      <aside className="admin-audit-rule">
        <Fingerprint size={22} />
        <p>{label("adminAuditRule")}</p>
      </aside>
      <div className="admin-activity-toolbar">
        <label className="admin-search-field">
          <Search size={18} />
          <span className="sr-only">{label("adminSearchActivity")}</span>
          <input
            value={search}
            onChange={(event) => setSearch(event.target.value)}
            placeholder={label("adminSearchActivity")}
          />
        </label>
        <label className="admin-kind-filter">
          <span className="sr-only">{label("adminAllRisk")}</span>
          <select
            value={risk}
            onChange={(event) => setRisk(event.target.value as RiskFilter)}
          >
            <option value="all">{label("adminAllRisk")}</option>
            <option value="normal">{label("adminRiskNormal")}</option>
            <option value="attention">{label("adminRiskAttention")}</option>
            <option value="high">{label("adminRiskHigh")}</option>
          </select>
        </label>
      </div>
      <div className="admin-activity-workbench">
        <section className="admin-log-list" aria-label={label("adminActivity")}>
          {filtered.length ? (
            filtered.map((record) => (
              <button
                type="button"
                className="admin-log-row"
                data-active={selected?.id === record.id || undefined}
                data-risk={record.risk}
                key={record.id}
                onClick={() => setSelectedId(record.id)}
              >
                <span className="admin-log-result" data-result={record.result}>
                  {record.result === "success" ? (
                    <CheckCircle2 size={18} />
                  ) : (
                    <Ban size={18} />
                  )}
                </span>
                <span className="admin-log-copy">
                  <strong>{t(record.action)}</strong>
                  <span>{t(record.resource)}</span>
                  <small>
                    {t(record.actor)} ·{" "}
                    {formatDate(record.at, locale, {
                      day: "numeric",
                      month: "short",
                      hour: "2-digit",
                      minute: "2-digit",
                    })}
                  </small>
                </span>
                <span className="admin-risk-chip" data-risk={record.risk}>
                  {label(
                    record.risk === "high"
                      ? "adminRiskHigh"
                      : record.risk === "attention"
                        ? "adminRiskAttention"
                        : "adminRiskNormal",
                  )}
                </span>
                <ChevronRight size={17} className="directional" />
              </button>
            ))
          ) : (
            <div className="admin-log-empty">
              <Activity size={28} />
              <p>{label("adminNoActivity")}</p>
            </div>
          )}
        </section>
        <section className="admin-log-inspector" aria-live="polite">
          {selected && <ActivityDetail record={selected} />}
        </section>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function ActivityDetail({ record }: { record: AdminActivityRecord }) {
  const { label, t, locale } = useLocale();
  const entries = (value?: Record<string, string>) =>
    Object.entries(value || {});
  return (
    <article className="admin-activity-detail" data-risk={record.risk}>
      <header>
        <span className="admin-log-result" data-result={record.result}>
          {record.result === "success" ? (
            <CheckCircle2 size={21} />
          ) : (
            <ShieldAlert size={21} />
          )}
        </span>
        <div>
          <span className="admin-risk-chip" data-risk={record.risk}>
            {label(
              record.risk === "high"
                ? "adminRiskHigh"
                : record.risk === "attention"
                  ? "adminRiskAttention"
                  : "adminRiskNormal",
            )}
          </span>
          <h2>{t(record.action)}</h2>
          <p>{t(record.resource)}</p>
        </div>
      </header>
      <dl className="admin-activity-facts">
        <div>
          <dt>{label("adminContributor")}</dt>
          <dd>{t(record.actor)}</dd>
        </div>
        <div>
          <dt>{label("adminRole")}</dt>
          <dd>{t(record.role)}</dd>
        </div>
        <div>
          <dt>{label("date")}</dt>
          <dd>
            {formatDate(record.at, locale, {
              dateStyle: "medium",
              timeStyle: "short",
            })}
          </dd>
        </div>
        <div>
          <dt>{label("status")}</dt>
          <dd>
            {label(
              record.result === "success"
                ? "adminResultSuccess"
                : "adminResultBlocked",
            )}
          </dd>
        </div>
      </dl>
      <div className="admin-change-grid">
        <section>
          <span>{label("adminBefore")}</span>
          {entries(record.before).map(([key, value]) => (
            <p key={key}>
              <b>{key}</b>
              <code>{value}</code>
            </p>
          ))}
        </section>
        <section>
          <span>{label("adminAfter")}</span>
          {entries(record.after).map(([key, value]) => (
            <p key={key}>
              <b>{key}</b>
              <code>{value}</code>
            </p>
          ))}
        </section>
      </div>
    </article>
  );
}

import { useState } from "react";
import { Activity, Bookmark, Download, Search, UsersRound } from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { downloadCsv } from "../../lib/csv";
import { formatDate } from "../../lib/dates";
import { EngagementTrend } from "../../features/insights/InsightCharts";
import { useAdminAnalytics } from "../../features/insights/useInsights";
import type { AnalyticsRange } from "../../types/insights";

const ranges: AnalyticsRange[] = ["7d", "30d", "90d"];

export default function AdminAnalyticsPage() {
  const { label, t, locale } = useLocale();
  const [range, setRange] = useState<AnalyticsRange>("30d");
  const query = useAdminAnalytics(range);
  if (query.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (query.isError) return <ErrorState retry={() => void query.refetch()} />;
  const data = query.data;
  const metrics = [
    { label: label("insightsAverageActive"), value: data.totals.activeStudents.toLocaleString(locale), icon: UsersRound },
    { label: label("insightsResourceOpens"), value: data.totals.resourceOpens.toLocaleString(locale), icon: Activity },
    { label: label("insightsSearches"), value: data.totals.searches.toLocaleString(locale), icon: Search },
    { label: label("insightsSaves"), value: data.totals.saves.toLocaleString(locale), icon: Bookmark },
  ];
  const exportData = () => {
    downloadCsv(`medclub-analytics-${range}.csv`, [
      ["date", "active_students", "resource_opens", "searches", "saves"],
      ...data.points.map((point) => [point.date, point.activeStudents, point.resourceOpens, point.searches, point.saves]),
    ]);
    toast.success(label("insightsExported"));
  };
  const maxFunnel = Math.max(...data.funnel.map((item) => item.value), 1);
  const maxContent = Math.max(...data.topContent.map((item) => item.value), 1);
  return (
    <div className="container admin-page insights-admin-page">
      <section className="insights-hero">
        <div>
          <span className="eyebrow">{label("insightsEyebrow")}</span>
          <h1 tabIndex={-1} data-page-heading>{label("insightsTitle")}</h1>
          <p>{label("insightsBody")}</p>
        </div>
        <div className="insights-pulse" aria-hidden="true"><i /><span /><b /></div>
      </section>
      <div className="insights-toolbar">
        <div className="insights-range" role="group" aria-label={label("insightsEngagementTrend")}>
          {ranges.map((item) => <button type="button" key={item} aria-pressed={range === item} onClick={() => setRange(item)}>{label(item === "7d" ? "insightsLast7" : item === "30d" ? "insightsLast30" : "insightsLast90")}</button>)}
        </div>
        <button type="button" className="button button-secondary" onClick={exportData}><Download size={17} />{label("insightsExport")}</button>
      </div>
      <p className="insights-source-note" role="status"><span>{label("insightsAdminNotice")}</span><small>{label("insightsGenerated")} · {formatDate(data.generatedAt, locale)}</small></p>
      <section className="insights-metrics" aria-label={label("adminAnalytics")}>
        {metrics.map(({ label: name, value, icon: Icon }) => <article key={name}><Icon size={20} /><strong>{value}</strong><span>{name}</span></article>)}
        <article className="insight-rate-card"><Bookmark size={20} /><strong>{data.totals.saveRate}%</strong><span>{label("insightsSaveRate")}</span></article>
      </section>
      <section className="insights-dashboard-grid">
        <article className="insight-panel insight-trend-panel">
          <header><h2>{label("insightsEngagementTrend")}</h2><p>{label("insightsTrendBody")}</p></header>
          <EngagementTrend points={data.points} labels={{ opens: label("insightsResourceOpens"), searches: label("insightsSearches"), saves: label("insightsSaves"), accessible: label("insightsEngagementTrend") }} />
        </article>
        <article className="insight-panel insight-funnel-panel">
          <header><h2>{label("insightsFunnel")}</h2><p>{label("insightsFunnelBody")}</p></header>
          <ol>{data.funnel.map((item, index) => <li key={item.id}><span>{String(index + 1).padStart(2, "0")}</span><div><strong>{t(item.label)}</strong><i><b style={{ width: `${(item.value / maxFunnel) * 100}%` }} /></i></div><em>{item.value.toLocaleString(locale)}</em></li>)}</ol>
        </article>
        <article className="insight-panel insight-ranking-panel">
          <header><h2>{label("insightsTopContent")}</h2><p>{label("insightsTopContentBody")}</p></header>
          <div>{data.topContent.map((item) => <section key={item.id}><span><strong>{t(item.label)}</strong><small>{item.value.toLocaleString(locale)} {label("insightsOpens")} · {item.secondary.toLocaleString(locale)} {label("insightsSaves")}</small></span><i><b style={{ width: `${(item.value / maxContent) * 100}%` }} /></i></section>)}</div>
        </article>
        <article className="insight-panel insight-demand-panel">
          <header><h2>{label("insightsCourseDemand")}</h2><p>{label("insightsCourseDemandBody")}</p></header>
          <div>{data.courseDemand.map((item, index) => <section key={item.id}><span>{String(index + 1).padStart(2, "0")}</span><div><strong>{t(item.label)}</strong><small>{item.value.toLocaleString(locale)} {label("insightsOpens")} · {item.secondary.toLocaleString(locale)} {label("insightsInterest")}</small></div></section>)}</div>
        </article>
      </section>
      <p className="insights-boundary-note">{label("insightsNoLiveData")}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState } from "react";
import { AlertTriangle, ArrowRight, Check, Clock3, ShieldCheck, X } from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { PageIntro } from "../../components/data-display/PageIntro";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { AliveTabs } from "../../components/navigation/AliveTabs";
import { Button } from "../../components/ui/button";
import { formatDate } from "../../lib/dates";
import type { AccessChangeRequest } from "../../types/governance";
import { useAccess, useAccessRequests, useGovernanceActions, useGovernanceRoles } from "../governance/useGovernance";

export default function AdminApprovalsPage() {
  const { label, t, locale } = useLocale();
  const requests = useAccessRequests();
  const roles = useGovernanceRoles();
  const access = useAccess();
  const actions = useGovernanceActions();
  const [view, setView] = useState<"pending" | "resolved">("pending");
  if (requests.isPending || roles.isPending || access.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (requests.isError || roles.isError || access.isError) return <ErrorState retry={() => { void requests.refetch(); void roles.refetch(); void access.refetch(); }} />;
  const roleNames = new Map(roles.data.map((role) => [role.id, t(role.name)]));
  const visible = requests.data.filter((request) => view === "pending" ? request.status === "pending" : request.status !== "pending");
  const decide = async (request: AccessChangeRequest, decision: "approve" | "reject") => {
    try { await actions.decide({ requestId: request.id, actorId: access.data.actorId, decision }); toast.success(label("governanceDecisionRecorded")); }
    catch { toast.error(label("governanceDecisionFailed")); }
  };
  return (
    <div className="container admin-page governance-approvals-page">
      <PageIntro eyebrow={label("governanceApprovalsEyebrow")} title={label("governanceApprovalsTitle")} description={label("governanceApprovalsBody")} />
      <div className="governance-approval-toolbar"><AliveTabs items={[{ id: "pending", label: label("governancePendingQueue"), icon: Clock3 }, { id: "resolved", label: label("governanceResolvedQueue"), icon: ShieldCheck }]} value={view} onChange={(value) => setView(value as typeof view)} label={label("governanceApprovals")} /><span><ShieldCheck size={16} />{label("governancePreviewOperator")}</span></div>
      <section className="governance-approval-list" aria-live="polite">
        {visible.length === 0 && <div className="governance-empty-queue"><ShieldCheck size={32} /><p>{label("governanceNoRequests")}</p></div>}
        {visible.map((request) => (
          <article className="governance-approval-card" data-status={request.status} key={request.id}>
            <header><span className="governance-risk-icon"><AlertTriangle size={20} /></span><div><span className="eyebrow">{label("governanceHighRisk")}</span><h2>{t(request.targetUser)}</h2></div><span className="governance-account-state" data-status={request.status}>{label(request.status === "approved" ? "governanceApproved" : request.status === "rejected" ? "governanceRejected" : "governancePending")}</span></header>
            <dl><div><dt>{label("governanceRequestedBy")}</dt><dd>{t(request.requestedBy)}</dd></div><div><dt>{label("date")}</dt><dd>{formatDate(request.createdAt, locale, { day: "numeric", month: "short", hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" })}</dd></div></dl>
            <div className="governance-role-delta"><span>{request.addRoleIds.length ? request.addRoleIds.map((id) => roleNames.get(id) || id).join(", ") : label("governanceNoChange")}</span><ArrowRight size={18} className="directional" /><span>{request.removeRoleIds.length ? request.removeRoleIds.map((id) => roleNames.get(id) || id).join(", ") : label("governanceNoChange")}</span><small className="delta-add">+ {label("governanceAdd")}</small><small className="delta-remove">− {label("governanceRemove")}</small></div>
            <blockquote>{request.reason}</blockquote>
            <div className="governance-approval-chain" aria-label={label("governanceApprovalsProgress")}>{Array.from({ length: request.approvalsRequired }, (_, index) => { const approval = request.approvals[index]; return <span className={approval ? approval.decision : ""} key={index}>{approval ? approval.decision === "approved" ? <Check size={15} /> : <X size={15} /> : index + 1}<small>{approval ? t(approval.actor) : `${request.approvals.length}/${request.approvalsRequired}`}</small></span>; })}</div>
            {request.status === "pending" && <footer><Button onClick={() => void decide(request, "approve")} disabled={actions.isMutating}><Check size={16} />{label("governanceApprove")}</Button><Button variant="outline" onClick={() => void decide(request, "reject")} disabled={actions.isMutating}><X size={16} />{label("governanceReject")}</Button></footer>}
          </article>
        ))}
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/admin/content/AdminContentPage.tsx
============================================================
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom";
import {
  BookOpenCheck,
  Check,
  CheckCircle2,
  FileCheck2,
  FileClock,
  FilePenLine,
  RotateCcw,
  Search,
  Send,
  ShieldCheck,
  UserRoundCheck,
} from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { PageIntro } from "../../components/data-display/PageIntro";
import { EmptyState } from "../../components/feedback/EmptyState";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { AliveTabs } from "../../components/navigation/AliveTabs";
import { Modal } from "../../components/ui/Modal";
import { Button } from "../../components/ui/button";
import { formatDate } from "../../lib/dates";
import type { AdminContentItem, AdminWorkflowStatus } from "../../types/admin";
import { adminKindKey, adminStatusKey } from "../admin-format";
import { useAdminActions, useAdminContent } from "../useAdmin";

type QueueView =
  "all" | "under-review" | "changes-requested" | "approved" | "published";

export default function AdminContentPage() {
  const { label, t, locale } = useLocale();
  const query = useAdminContent();
  const actions = useAdminActions();
  const [params, setParams] = useSearchParams();
  const [view, setView] = useState<QueueView>("all");
  const [kind, setKind] = useState("all");
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [note, setNote] = useState("");
  const [publishTarget, setPublishTarget] = useState<AdminContentItem | null>(
    null,
  );
  const selectedId = params.get("item");

  const items = query.data || [];
  const selected = items.find((item) => item.id === selectedId) || null;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!selectedId && items.length) {
      const preferred =
        items.find((item) => item.status === "under-review") || items[0];
      setParams(
        (current) => {
          const next = new URLSearchParams(current);
          next.set("item", preferred.id);
          return next;
        },
        { replace: true },
      );
    }
  }, [items, selectedId, setParams]);

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    const value = search.trim().toLocaleLowerCase();
    const staleOnly = params.get("health") === "stale";
    return items.filter((item) => {
      if (view !== "all" && item.status !== view) return false;
      if (kind !== "all" && item.kind !== kind) return false;
      if (
        staleOnly &&
        (!item.staleAfter ||
          new Date(item.staleAfter) >= new Date("2026-09-03T23:59:59+03:00"))
      )
        return false;
      if (!value) return true;
      return [t(item.title), t(item.contributor), t(item.topic)]
        .join(" ")
        .toLocaleLowerCase()
        .includes(value);
    });
  }, [items, kind, params, search, t, view]);

  const tabs = [
    {
      id: "all",
      label: label("allContent"),
      icon: FileCheck2,
      count: items.length,
    },
    {
      id: "under-review",
      label: label("underReview"),
      icon: FileClock,
      count: items.filter((item) => item.status === "under-review").length,
    },
    {
      id: "changes-requested",
      label: label("changesRequested"),
      icon: RotateCcw,
      count: items.filter((item) => item.status === "changes-requested").length,
    },
    {
      id: "approved",
      label: label("approved"),
      icon: CheckCircle2,
      count: items.filter((item) => item.status === "approved").length,
    },
    {
      id: "published",
      label: label("publishedStatus"),
      icon: Send,
      count: items.filter((item) => item.status === "published").length,
    },
  ] as const;

  const choose = (item: AdminContentItem) => {
    setNote("");
    setParams((current) => {
      const next = new URLSearchParams(current);
      next.set("item", item.id);
      return next;
    });
  };
  const transition = async (
    item: AdminContentItem,
    action: "request-changes" | "approve" | "publish" | "return-to-review",
  ) => {
    try {
      await actions.review({ itemId: item.id, action, note });
      setNote("");
      setPublishTarget(null);
      toast.success(label("adminActionSaved"));
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error(
        error instanceof Error && error.message === "ADMIN_SAFETY_CHECK_FAILED"
          ? label("adminPublishBlocked")
          : label("adminActionFailed"),
      );
    }
  };

  if (query.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (query.isError) return <ErrorState retry={() => void query.refetch()} />;
  return (
    <div className="container admin-page admin-content-page">
      <PageIntro
        eyebrow={label("adminContentEyebrow")}
        title={label("adminContentTitle")}
        description={label("adminContentBody")}
      />
      <div className="admin-content-toolbar">
        <AliveTabs
          label={label("status")}
          items={[...tabs]}
          value={view}
          onChange={setView}
        />
        <label className="admin-search-field">
          <Search size={18} />
          <span className="sr-only">{label("adminSearchContent")}</span>
          <input
            value={search}
            onChange={(event) => setSearch(event.target.value)}
            placeholder={label("adminSearchContent")}
          />
        </label>
        <label className="admin-kind-filter">
          <span className="sr-only">{label("adminAllKinds")}</span>
          <select
            value={kind}
            onChange={(event) => setKind(event.target.value)}
          >
            <option value="all">{label("adminAllKinds")}</option>
            {(
              [
                "contribution",
                "resource",
                "article",
                "homepage",
                "event",
                "opportunity",
              ] as const
            ).map((value) => (
              <option key={value} value={value}>
                {label(adminKindKey(value))}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </label>
      </div>

      <div className="admin-content-workbench">
        <section
          className="admin-content-list"
          aria-label={label("adminReviewQueue")}
        >
          <p className="admin-list-count">
            <strong>{filtered.length}</strong> {label("adminQueueCount")}
          </p>
          {filtered.length ? (
            filtered.map((item) => (
              <button
                type="button"
                className="admin-content-row"
                data-active={selected?.id === item.id || undefined}
                data-status={item.status}
                onClick={() => choose(item)}
                key={item.id}
              >
                <span className="admin-content-row-mark">
                  <BookOpenCheck size={19} />
                </span>
                <span className="admin-content-row-copy">
                  <small>
                    {label(adminKindKey(item.kind))} · {t(item.topic)}
                  </small>
                  <strong>{t(item.title)}</strong>
                  <span>
                    {t(item.contributor)} · {formatDate(item.updatedAt, locale)}
                  </span>
                </span>
                <span className="admin-status" data-status={item.status}>
                  {label(adminStatusKey(item.status))}
                </span>
              </button>
            ))
          ) : (
            <EmptyState
              title={label("emptyTitle")}
              description={label("adminSelectItemBody")}
            />
          )}
        </section>

        <section className="admin-review-inspector" aria-live="polite">
          {selected ? (
            <ReviewInspector
              item={selected}
              note={note}
              setNote={setNote}
              pending={actions.isMutating}
              request={(action) => {
                if (action === "publish") setPublishTarget(selected);
                else void transition(selected, action);
              }}
            />
          ) : (
            <div className="admin-inspector-empty">
              <FilePenLine size={30} />
              <h2>{label("adminSelectItem")}</h2>
              <p>{label("adminSelectItemBody")}</p>
            </div>
          )}
        </section>
      </div>

      <Modal
        open={!!publishTarget}
        onClose={() => setPublishTarget(null)}
        title={label("adminPublish")}
        description={label("adminPublishBlocked")}
        className="admin-confirm-dialog"
      >
        <div className="admin-confirm-mark">
          <ShieldCheck size={29} />
        </div>
        <p>{publishTarget ? t(publishTarget.title) : ""}</p>
        <div className="admin-confirm-actions">
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setPublishTarget(null)}>
            {label("close")}
          </Button>
          <Button
            className="button button-primary"
            disabled={actions.isMutating}
            onClick={() =>
              publishTarget && void transition(publishTarget, "publish")
            }
          >
            <Send size={17} /> {label("adminPublish")}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
}

function ReviewInspector({
  item,
  note,
  setNote,
  pending,
  request,
}: {
  item: AdminContentItem;
  note: string;
  setNote: (value: string) => void;
  pending: boolean;
  request: (
    action: "request-changes" | "approve" | "publish" | "return-to-review",
  ) => void;
}) {
  const { label, t, locale } = useLocale();
  const canRequest = item.status === "under-review";
  const canApprove = item.status === "under-review";
  const canPublish = item.status === "approved";
  const canReturn = item.status === "changes-requested";
  return (
    <article className="admin-review-card" data-status={item.status}>
      <header>
        <span className="admin-status" data-status={item.status}>
          {label(adminStatusKey(item.status))}
        </span>
        <span className="admin-version-chip">
          <FileClock size={15} /> {label("adminVersion")} {item.versionNumber}
        </span>
      </header>
      <span className="eyebrow">{label(adminKindKey(item.kind))}</span>
      <h2>{t(item.title)}</h2>
      <p>{t(item.summary)}</p>
      <div className="admin-fact-grid">
        <div>
          <UserRoundCheck size={17} />
          <span>{label("adminContributor")}</span>
          <strong>{t(item.contributor)}</strong>
        </div>
        <div>
          <ShieldCheck size={17} />
          <span>{label("adminReviewer")}</span>
          <strong>
            {item.reviewer ? t(item.reviewer) : label("adminUnassigned")}
          </strong>
        </div>
        <div data-valid={item.rightsConfirmed || undefined}>
          <Check size={17} />
          <span>
            {label(
              item.rightsConfirmed
                ? "adminRightsConfirmed"
                : "adminRightsMissing",
            )}
          </span>
          <strong>
            {item.rightsConfirmed ? label("adminYes") : label("adminNo")}
          </strong>
        </div>
        <div>
          <BookOpenCheck size={17} />
          <span>{label("adminReferenceCount")}</span>
          <strong>{item.referenceCount}</strong>
        </div>
      </div>
      {item.reviewerNote && (
        <aside className="admin-reviewer-note">
          <strong>{label("reviewerFeedback")}</strong>
          <p>{t(item.reviewerNote)}</p>
        </aside>
      )}
      <details className="admin-review-history" open>
        <summary>{label("adminReviewTrail")}</summary>
        <ol>
          {[...item.history].reverse().map((entry) => (
            <li key={entry.id} data-status={entry.status}>
              <i />
              <div>
                <strong>{label(adminStatusKey(entry.status))}</strong>
                <span>{t(entry.note)}</span>
                <small>
                  {t(entry.actor)} ·{" "}
                  {formatDate(entry.at, locale, {
                    day: "numeric",
                    month: "short",
                    hour: "2-digit",
                    minute: "2-digit",
                  })}
                </small>
              </div>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ol>
      </details>
      {(canRequest || canApprove || canPublish || canReturn) && (
        <div className="admin-decision-box">
          <label htmlFor="admin-decision-note">
            {label("adminDecisionNote")}
          </label>
          <textarea
            id="admin-decision-note"
            value={note}
            onChange={(event) => setNote(event.target.value)}
            placeholder={label("adminDecisionPlaceholder")}
            rows={3}
          />
          <div className="admin-decision-actions">
            {canRequest && (
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                disabled={pending || !note.trim()}
                onClick={() => request("request-changes")}
              >
                <RotateCcw size={16} />
                {label("adminRequestChanges")}
              </Button>
            )}
            {canApprove && (
              <Button
                className="button button-primary"
                disabled={pending}
                onClick={() => request("approve")}
              >
                <CheckCircle2 size={16} />
                {label("adminApprove")}
              </Button>
            )}
            {canPublish && (
              <Button
                className="button button-primary"
                disabled={
                  pending || !item.rightsConfirmed || item.referenceCount < 1
                }
                onClick={() => request("publish")}
              >
                <Send size={16} />
                {label("adminPublish")}
              </Button>
            )}
            {canReturn && (
              <Button
                className="button button-primary"
                disabled={pending}
                onClick={() => request("return-to-review")}
              >
                <FileClock size={16} />
                {label("adminReturnReview")}
              </Button>
            )}
          </div>
          <small>{label("adminDeviceState")}</small>
        </div>
      )}
    </article>
  );
}

FILE: src/admin/governance/README.md
============================================================
# V0.12 governance boundary

V0.12 keeps three concepts deliberately separate:

- roles grant typed system capabilities;
- team memberships record organizational positions and volunteer hours;
- symbolic titles are display-only and never authorize an operation.

The preview adapter persists normalized data under `STORAGE_KEYS.governance`. It enforces the five-founder invariant, prevents founder suspension or permission reduction, rejects self-approval and requires two distinct approvals before a high-risk access change takes effect.

These local checks make the preview honest, but they are not a production security boundary. A real API and database must repeat every permission, founder-protection and approval invariant transactionally. The frontend may hide or disable a control for clarity; it must never be the only enforcement layer.

Routes are capability-gated through `CapabilityGate`:

- `/admin/governance`
- `/admin/users`
- `/admin/roles`
- `/admin/approvals`

The navigation elevates governance without crowding the mobile tab bar. Desktop uses grouped operations and access controls; mobile keeps four frequent destinations and moves the rest into a focused native-modal menu.

import { useMemo, useState, type CSSProperties } from "react";
import { ArrowUpRight, Download, FileCheck2, Search, ShieldAlert } from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { AppLink } from "../../components/navigation/AppLink";
import type { MessageKey } from "../../constants/messages";
import { downloadCsv } from "../../lib/csv";
import { formatDate } from "../../lib/dates";
import { useContentHealth } from "../../features/insights/useInsights";
import type { ContentHealthIssueCode, ContentHealthRecord } from "../../types/insights";

const issueKeys: Record<ContentHealthIssueCode, MessageKey> = {
  "missing-file": "healthIssueMissingFile",
  "missing-reviewer": "healthIssueMissingReviewer",
  "missing-references": "healthIssueMissingReferences",
  "missing-translation": "healthIssueMissingTranslation",
  "rights-unconfirmed": "healthIssueRightsUnconfirmed",
  stale: "healthIssueStale",
};

const kinds: ContentHealthRecord["kind"][] = ["resource", "article", "contribution", "homepage", "event", "opportunity"];

export default function AdminContentHealthPage() {
  const { label, t, locale } = useLocale();
  const query = useContentHealth();
  const [severity, setSeverity] = useState<"all" | ContentHealthRecord["severity"]>("all");
  const [kind, setKind] = useState<"all" | ContentHealthRecord["kind"]>("all");
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const filtered = useMemo(() => (query.data?.records || []).filter((record) => {
    const needle = search.trim().toLocaleLowerCase(locale);
    return (severity === "all" || record.severity === severity) &&
      (kind === "all" || record.kind === kind) &&
      (!needle || [record.title.en, record.title.ar, record.context.en, record.context.ar].join(" ").toLocaleLowerCase(locale).includes(needle));
  }), [kind, locale, query.data?.records, search, severity]);
  if (query.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (query.isError) return <ErrorState retry={() => void query.refetch()} />;
  const data = query.data;
  const exportHealth = () => {
    downloadCsv("medclub-content-health.csv", [
      ["id", "kind", "title_en", "title_ar", "score", "status", "issues", "updated_at", "source_href"],
      ...filtered.map((record) => [record.sourceId, record.kind, record.title.en, record.title.ar, record.score, record.severity, record.issues.join("|"), record.updatedAt, record.href]),
    ]);
    toast.success(label("insightsExported"));
  };
  const kindLabel = (value: ContentHealthRecord["kind"]) => label(value === "resource" ? "resources" : value === "article" ? "journal" : value === "contribution" ? "myContributions" : value === "homepage" ? "home" : value === "event" ? "events" : "opportunities");
  return (
    <div className="container admin-page health-page">
      <section className="health-hero">
        <div>
          <span className="eyebrow">{label("healthEyebrow")}</span>
          <h1 tabIndex={-1} data-page-heading>{label("healthTitle")}</h1>
          <p>{label("healthBody")}</p>
        </div>
        <div className="health-orb" style={{ "--health-score": data.score } as CSSProperties}><FileCheck2 size={28} /><strong>{data.score}</strong><span>/ 100</span></div>
      </section>
      <p className="insights-source-note" role="status"><span>{label("insightsAdminNotice")}</span><small>{label("insightsGenerated")} · {formatDate(data.generatedAt, locale)}</small></p>
      <section className="health-summary" aria-label={label("healthOverall")}>
        <button type="button" aria-pressed={severity === "all"} onClick={() => setSeverity("all")}><span>{data.records.length}</span><strong>{label("healthAll")}</strong></button>
        <button type="button" data-severity="critical" aria-pressed={severity === "critical"} onClick={() => setSeverity("critical")}><span>{data.counts.critical}</span><strong>{label("healthCritical")}</strong></button>
        <button type="button" data-severity="attention" aria-pressed={severity === "attention"} onClick={() => setSeverity("attention")}><span>{data.counts.attention}</span><strong>{label("healthAttention")}</strong></button>
        <button type="button" data-severity="healthy" aria-pressed={severity === "healthy"} onClick={() => setSeverity("healthy")}><span>{data.counts.healthy}</span><strong>{label("healthHealthy")}</strong></button>
      </section>
      <div className="health-toolbar">
        <label className="health-search"><Search size={18} /><span className="sr-only">{label("healthSearch")}</span><input value={search} onChange={(event) => setSearch(event.target.value)} placeholder={label("healthSearch")} /></label>
        <label><span className="sr-only">{label("healthAllKinds")}</span><select value={kind} onChange={(event) => setKind(event.target.value as typeof kind)}><option value="all">{label("healthAllKinds")}</option>{kinds.map((item) => <option key={item} value={item}>{kindLabel(item)}</option>)}</select></label>
        <button type="button" className="button button-secondary" onClick={exportHealth}><Download size={17} />{label("insightsExport")}</button>
      </div>
      <p className="health-explainer"><ShieldAlert size={18} />{label("healthScoring")}</p>
      <div className="health-list" aria-live="polite">
        {filtered.map((record) => <article className="health-record" data-severity={record.severity} key={record.id}>
          <div className="health-score"><strong>{record.score}</strong><span>/100</span></div>
          <div className="health-record-copy"><span className="health-kind">{kindLabel(record.kind)} · {t(record.context)}</span><h2>{t(record.title)}</h2><p>{formatDate(record.updatedAt, locale)}</p><div className="health-tags">{record.issues.length ? record.issues.map((issue) => <span key={issue}>{label(issueKeys[issue])}</span>) : <span className="healthy">{label("healthHealthy")}</span>}</div></div>
          <AppLink className="health-open" href={record.href} aria-label={`${label("healthOpenItem")}: ${t(record.title)}`}><ArrowUpRight size={19} className="directional" /></AppLink>
        </article>)}
        {!filtered.length && <p className="health-empty">{label("healthEmpty")}</p>}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { AlertTriangle, Check, KeyRound, LockKeyhole, ShieldCheck, UsersRound } from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { PageIntro } from "../../components/data-display/PageIntro";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { Button } from "../../components/ui/button";
import type { Capability, CapabilityGroup } from "../../types/governance";
import { useCapabilities, useGovernanceActions, useGovernanceRoles } from "../governance/useGovernance";

export default function AdminRolesPage() {
  const { label, t } = useLocale();
  const roles = useGovernanceRoles();
  const definitions = useCapabilities();
  const actions = useGovernanceActions();
  const [selectedId, setSelectedId] = useState("founder");
  const selected = roles.data?.find((role) => role.id === selectedId) || roles.data?.[0];
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<Capability[]>([]);
  useEffect(() => setDraft(selected ? [...selected.capabilities] : []), [selected]);
  const grouped = useMemo(() => {
    const result = new Map<CapabilityGroup, NonNullable<typeof definitions.data>>();
    for (const group of ["content", "people", "governance", "operations"] as const) result.set(group, []);
    for (const item of definitions.data || []) result.get(item.group)?.push(item);
    return result;
  }, [definitions.data]);
  if (roles.isPending || definitions.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (roles.isError || definitions.isError) return <ErrorState retry={() => { void roles.refetch(); void definitions.refetch(); }} />;
  const toggle = (capability: Capability) => {
    if (selected?.protected) return;
    setDraft((current) => current.includes(capability) ? current.filter((item) => item !== capability) : [...current, capability]);
  };
  const save = async () => {
    if (!selected) return;
    try { await actions.updateRole({ roleId: selected.id, capabilities: draft }); toast.success(label("governanceRoleSaved")); }
    catch { toast.error(label("governanceRoleFailed")); }
  };
  const groupLabel: Record<CapabilityGroup, ReturnType<typeof label>> = {
    content: label("governanceGroupContent"), people: label("governanceGroupPeople"), governance: label("governanceGroupGovernance"), operations: label("governanceGroupOperations"),
  };
  return (
    <div className="container admin-page governance-roles-page">
      <PageIntro eyebrow={label("governanceRolesEyebrow")} title={label("governanceRolesTitle")} description={label("governanceRolesBody")} />
      <section className="governance-role-layout">
        <nav className="governance-role-list" aria-label={label("governanceRoles")}>
          {roles.data.map((role) => <button type="button" key={role.id} data-tone={role.tone} className={role.id === selected?.id ? "active" : ""} aria-pressed={role.id === selected?.id} onClick={() => setSelectedId(role.id)}><span className="governance-role-glyph">{role.protected ? <ShieldCheck size={20} /> : <KeyRound size={20} />}</span><span><strong>{t(role.name)}</strong><small><UsersRound size={13} />{role.memberCount} {label("governanceMembers")}</small></span>{role.protected && <LockKeyhole size={16} />}</button>)}
        </nav>
        {selected && <article className="governance-capability-panel">
          <header><span className="governance-role-glyph" data-tone={selected.tone}>{selected.protected ? <ShieldCheck size={24} /> : <KeyRound size={24} />}</span><div><h2>{t(selected.name)}</h2><p>{t(selected.description)}</p></div>{selected.protected && <span className="governance-lock-chip"><LockKeyhole size={14} />{label("governanceProtectedRole")}</span>}</header>
          {selected.protected && <p className="governance-protected-note"><ShieldCheck size={18} />{label("governanceProtectedRoleBody")}</p>}
          <div className="governance-capability-groups">
            {[...grouped].map(([group, items]) => <section key={group}><h3>{groupLabel[group]}</h3><div>{items.map((item) => { const checked = draft.includes(item.id); return <button type="button" key={item.id} disabled={selected.protected} className={checked ? "selected" : ""} aria-pressed={checked} onClick={() => toggle(item.id)}><span className="governance-capability-check">{checked && <Check size={15} />}</span><span><strong>{t(item.label)}</strong><small>{t(item.description)}</small></span>{item.highRisk && <em><AlertTriangle size={13} />{label("governanceHighRiskCapability")}</em>}</button>; })}</div></section>)}
          </div>
          <Button disabled={selected.protected || actions.isMutating} onClick={() => void save()}>{label("governanceSaveRole")}</Button>
        </article>}
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/admin/users/AdminUsersPage.tsx
============================================================
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { BadgeCheck, Clock3, KeyRound, ShieldCheck, Sparkles, UsersRound } from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { PageIntro } from "../../components/data-display/PageIntro";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { SearchInput } from "../../components/forms/SearchInput";
import { Modal } from "../../components/ui/Modal";
import { Button } from "../../components/ui/button";
import { formatDate } from "../../lib/dates";
import type { GovernanceUser } from "../../types/governance";
import { useGovernanceActions, useGovernanceRoles, useGovernanceUsers } from "../governance/useGovernance";

export default function AdminUsersPage() {
  const { label, t, locale } = useLocale();
  const usersQuery = useGovernanceUsers();
  const rolesQuery = useGovernanceRoles();
  const actions = useGovernanceActions();
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const [selectedId, setSelectedId] = useState<string>();
  const [requestOpen, setRequestOpen] = useState(false);
  const [addRoleId, setAddRoleId] = useState("");
  const [removeRoleId, setRemoveRoleId] = useState("");
  const [reason, setReason] = useState("");
  const filtered = useMemo(() => (usersQuery.data || []).filter((user) => `${t(user.name)} ${user.email}`.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(query.trim().toLocaleLowerCase())), [query, t, usersQuery.data]);
  if (usersQuery.isPending || rolesQuery.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (usersQuery.isError || rolesQuery.isError) return <ErrorState retry={() => { void usersQuery.refetch(); void rolesQuery.refetch(); }} />;
  const selected = usersQuery.data.find((user) => user.id === selectedId) || filtered[0] || usersQuery.data[0];
  const rolesById = new Map(rolesQuery.data.map((role) => [role.id, role]));
  const submit = async () => {
    if (!selected) return;
    try {
      await actions.requestChange({ targetUserId: selected.id, addRoleIds: addRoleId ? [addRoleId] : [], removeRoleIds: removeRoleId ? [removeRoleId] : [], reason });
      setRequestOpen(false); setAddRoleId(""); setRemoveRoleId(""); setReason("");
      toast.success(label("governanceRequestCreated"));
    } catch { toast.error(label("governanceRequestFailed")); }
  };
  return (
    <div className="container admin-page governance-users-page">
      <PageIntro eyebrow={label("governanceUsersEyebrow")} title={label("governanceUsersTitle")} description={label("governanceUsersBody")} />
      <section className="governance-user-layout">
        <aside className="governance-user-list">
          <header><strong>{label("governanceAllUsers")}</strong><span>{usersQuery.data.length}</span></header>
          <SearchInput value={query} onChange={setQuery} label={label("governanceSearchUsers")} />
          <div className="governance-user-scroll">
            {filtered.map((user) => <UserRow user={user} selected={selected?.id === user.id} onSelect={() => setSelectedId(user.id)} key={user.id} />)}
          </div>
        </aside>
        {selected && (
          <article className="governance-user-inspector">
            <header>
              <span className="governance-avatar">{selected.initials}</span>
              <div><h2>{t(selected.name)}</h2><p>{selected.email}</p><span className="governance-account-state" data-status={selected.status}>{label(selected.isFounder ? "governanceFounder" : selected.status === "active" ? "governanceActive" : selected.status === "invited" ? "governanceInvited" : "governanceSuspended")}</span></div>
              {selected.isFounder && <ShieldCheck className="governance-founder-seal" size={30} />}
            </header>
            <p className="governance-last-active"><Clock3 size={15} />{label("governanceLastActive")} · {formatDate(selected.lastActiveAt, locale, { day: "numeric", month: "short", hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" })}</p>
            <div className="governance-identity-grid">
              <section><h3><KeyRound size={18} />{label("governanceRolesLabel")}</h3><div className="governance-chip-list">{selected.roleIds.map((id) => <span data-kind="role" key={id}>{rolesById.has(id) ? t(rolesById.get(id)!.name) : id}</span>)}</div></section>
              <section><h3><UsersRound size={18} />{label("governanceMembershipsLabel")}</h3>{selected.memberships.map((membership, index) => <div className="governance-membership" key={index}><strong>{t(membership.team)}</strong><span>{membership.positions.map(t).join(" · ")}</span><small>{membership.volunteerHours} {label("governanceVolunteerHours")}</small></div>)}</section>
              <section><h3><Sparkles size={18} />{label("governanceTitlesLabel")}</h3><div className="governance-chip-list">{selected.symbolicTitles.length ? selected.symbolicTitles.map((title, index) => <span data-kind="title" key={index}>{t(title)}</span>) : <small>{label("governanceNoTitles")}</small>}</div></section>
            </div>
            {selected.isFounder && <p className="governance-protected-note"><BadgeCheck size={18} />{label("governanceProtectedAction")}</p>}
            <div className="governance-inspector-actions">
              <Button onClick={() => setRequestOpen(true)}>{label("governanceRequestChange")}</Button>
              <Button variant="outline" disabled={selected.isFounder || actions.isMutating} onClick={() => void actions.suspend(selected.id).catch(() => toast.error(label("governanceProtectedAction")))}>{label("governanceSuspend")}</Button>
            </div>
          </article>
        )}
      </section>
      <Modal open={requestOpen} onClose={() => setRequestOpen(false)} title={label("governanceRequestTitle")} description={label("governanceRequestBody")} className="governance-request-modal">
        <div className="governance-request-form">
          <label>{label("governanceAddRole")}<select value={addRoleId} onChange={(event) => setAddRoleId(event.target.value)}><option value="">{label("governanceNoChange")}</option>{rolesQuery.data.filter((role) => !selected?.roleIds.includes(role.id)).map((role) => <option value={role.id} key={role.id}>{t(role.name)}</option>)}</select></label>
          <label>{label("governanceRemoveRole")}<select value={removeRoleId} disabled={selected?.isFounder} onChange={(event) => setRemoveRoleId(event.target.value)}><option value="">{label("governanceNoChange")}</option>{selected?.roleIds.map((id) => <option value={id} key={id}>{rolesById.has(id) ? t(rolesById.get(id)!.name) : id}</option>)}</select></label>
          <label>{label("governanceReason")}<textarea rows={4} value={reason} onChange={(event) => setReason(event.target.value)} placeholder={label("governanceReasonPlaceholder")} /></label>
          <Button disabled={!reason.trim() || (!addRoleId && !removeRoleId) || actions.isMutating} onClick={() => void submit()}>{label("governanceSubmitRequest")}</Button>
        </div>
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
}

function UserRow({ user, selected, onSelect }: { user: GovernanceUser; selected: boolean; onSelect: () => void }) {
  const { label, t } = useLocale();
  return <button type="button" className={selected ? "active" : ""} onClick={onSelect} aria-pressed={selected}><span className="governance-avatar">{user.initials}</span><span><strong>{t(user.name)}</strong><small>{user.email}</small></span>{user.isFounder && <ShieldCheck size={17} aria-label={label("governanceFounder")} />}</button>;
}

FILE: src/admin/versions/AdminVersionsPage.tsx
============================================================
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  ArrowRightLeft,
  Clock3,
  FileClock,
  History,
  RotateCcw,
  ShieldCheck,
} from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { PageIntro } from "../../components/data-display/PageIntro";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { Modal } from "../../components/ui/Modal";
import { Button } from "../../components/ui/button";
import { formatDate } from "../../lib/dates";
import type { AdminContentVersion } from "../../types/admin";
import { adminStatusKey } from "../admin-format";
import {
  useAdminActions,
  useAdminContent,
  useAdminVersions,
} from "../useAdmin";

export default function AdminVersionsPage() {
  const { label, t, locale } = useLocale();
  const content = useAdminContent();
  const [itemId, setItemId] = useState<string>();
  const resolvedItemId = itemId || content.data?.[0]?.id;
  const versions = useAdminVersions(resolvedItemId);
  const actions = useAdminActions();
  const [selectedId, setSelectedId] = useState<string>();
  const [restoreTarget, setRestoreTarget] =
    useState<AdminContentVersion | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!itemId && content.data?.length) setItemId(content.data[0].id);
  }, [content.data, itemId]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (
      versions.data?.length &&
      !versions.data.some((item) => item.id === selectedId)
    )
      setSelectedId(versions.data[0].id);
  }, [selectedId, versions.data]);
  if (content.isPending || versions.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (content.isError || versions.isError)
    return (
      <ErrorState
        retry={() => {
          void content.refetch();
          void versions.refetch();
        }}
      />
    );
  const item = content.data.find((entry) => entry.id === resolvedItemId);
  const selected =
    versions.data.find((entry) => entry.id === selectedId) || null;
  const restore = async () => {
    if (!restoreTarget || !resolvedItemId) return;
    try {
      await actions.restore({
        itemId: resolvedItemId,
        versionId: restoreTarget.id,
      });
      setRestoreTarget(null);
      toast.success(label("adminRestored"));
    } catch {
      toast.error(label("adminRestoreFailed"));
    }
  };
  return (
    <div className="container admin-page admin-versions-page">
      <PageIntro
        eyebrow={label("adminVersionsEyebrow")}
        title={label("adminVersionsTitle")}
        description={label("adminVersionsBody")}
      />
      <div className="admin-version-picker">
        <label htmlFor="version-content">{label("adminChooseContent")}</label>
        <select
          id="version-content"
          value={resolvedItemId || ""}
          onChange={(event) => {
            setItemId(event.target.value);
            setSelectedId(undefined);
          }}
        >
          {content.data.map((entry) => (
            <option key={entry.id} value={entry.id}>
              {t(entry.title)}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
        {item && (
          <span className="admin-current-version">
            <ShieldCheck size={16} />
            {label("adminCurrentVersion")} · {item.versionNumber}
          </span>
        )}
      </div>
      {versions.data.length ? (
        <div className="admin-version-workbench">
          <ol className="admin-version-timeline">
            {versions.data.map((version) => {
              const current = version.versionNumber === item?.versionNumber;
              return (
                <li key={version.id} data-current={current || undefined}>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    data-active={selected?.id === version.id || undefined}
                    onClick={() => setSelectedId(version.id)}
                  >
                    <span className="admin-version-node">
                      <FileClock size={17} />
                    </span>
                    <span>
                      <strong>
                        {label("adminVersion")} {version.versionNumber}
                      </strong>
                      <small>{t(version.reason)}</small>
                      <time>
                        {formatDate(version.createdAt, locale, {
                          day: "numeric",
                          month: "short",
                          year: "numeric",
                          hour: "2-digit",
                          minute: "2-digit",
                        })}
                      </time>
                    </span>
                    {current && <b>{label("adminCurrent")}</b>}
                  </button>
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ol>
          {selected && item && (
            <section className="admin-version-compare">
              <header>
                <ArrowRightLeft size={20} />
                <span>{label("adminCompare")}</span>
              </header>
              <div className="admin-snapshot-grid">
                <article>
                  <span>{label("adminCurrent")}</span>
                  <b>
                    {label("adminVersion")} {item.versionNumber}
                  </b>
                  <h2>{t(item.title)}</h2>
                  <p className="admin-status" data-status={item.status}>
                    {label(adminStatusKey(item.status))}
                  </p>
                  <small>
                    {item.reviewerNote
                      ? t(item.reviewerNote)
                      : label("adminUnassigned")}
                  </small>
                </article>
                <i className="admin-compare-pulse">
                  <ArrowRightLeft size={18} />
                </i>
                <article data-old="true">
                  <span>{formatDate(selected.createdAt, locale)}</span>
                  <b>
                    {label("adminVersion")} {selected.versionNumber}
                  </b>
                  <h2>{t(selected.snapshot.title)}</h2>
                  <p
                    className="admin-status"
                    data-status={selected.snapshot.status}
                  >
                    {label(adminStatusKey(selected.snapshot.status))}
                  </p>
                  <small>
                    {selected.snapshot.reviewerNote
                      ? t(selected.snapshot.reviewerNote)
                      : t(selected.reason)}
                  </small>
                </article>
              </div>
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                disabled={
                  selected.versionNumber === item.versionNumber ||
                  actions.isMutating
                }
                onClick={() => setRestoreTarget(selected)}
              >
                <RotateCcw size={17} /> {label("adminRestore")}
              </Button>
            </section>
          )}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="admin-no-versions">
          <History size={31} />
          <p>{label("adminNoVersions")}</p>
        </div>
      )}
      <aside className="admin-boundary-panel admin-version-boundary">
        <Clock3 size={22} />
        <div>
          <strong>{label("adminPermissionsBoundary")}</strong>
          <p>{label("adminPermissionsBoundaryBody")}</p>
        </div>
      </aside>
      <Modal
        open={!!restoreTarget}
        onClose={() => setRestoreTarget(null)}
        title={label("adminRestoreTitle")}
        description={label("adminRestoreBody")}
        className="admin-confirm-dialog"
      >
        <div className="admin-confirm-mark">
          <RotateCcw size={29} />
        </div>
        <p>
          {restoreTarget
            ? `${label("adminVersion")} ${restoreTarget.versionNumber} · ${t(restoreTarget.snapshot.title)}`
            : ""}
        </p>
        <div className="admin-confirm-actions">
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setRestoreTarget(null)}>
            {label("close")}
          </Button>
          <Button
            className="button button-primary"
            disabled={actions.isMutating}
            onClick={() => void restore()}
          >
            {label("adminRestoreConfirm")}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
}

import { Bookmark, Check } from "lucide-react";
import { useOverlays } from "../providers/OverlayProvider";
import { useLocale } from "../providers/LocaleProvider";
import { useSavedItems } from "../providers/SavedItemsProvider";
import { SearchDialog } from "../../features/search/SearchDialog";
import { ResourceDetails } from "../../features/resources/ResourceDetails";
import { EventDetails } from "../../features/events/EventDetails";
import { OpportunityDetails } from "../../features/opportunities/OpportunityDetails";
import { ArticleDetails } from "../../features/community/ArticleDetails";
import { Modal } from "../../components/ui/Modal";
import { Button } from "../../components/ui/button";
export function AppOverlays() {
  const { detail, closeDetail } = useOverlays();
  const { t, label } = useLocale();
  const { saved, toggle, isPending } = useSavedItems();
  return (
    <>
      <SearchDialog />
      {detail && (
        <Modal
          open
          onClose={closeDetail}
          title={t(detail.item.title)}
          description={t(
            detail.kind === "article"
              ? detail.item.excerpt
              : detail.item.description,
          )}
          className="detail-modal"
        >
          <span className="eyebrow">
            {label(detail.kind)} · {label("sample")}
          </span>
          {detail.kind === "resource" ? (
            <ResourceDetails item={detail.item} />
          ) : detail.kind === "event" ? (
            <EventDetails item={detail.item} />
          ) : detail.kind === "opportunity" ? (
            <OpportunityDetails item={detail.item} />
          ) : (
            <ArticleDetails item={detail.item} />
          )}{" "}
          <Button
            className="button button-primary"
            disabled={isPending}
            aria-pressed={saved.includes(detail.item.id)}
            onClick={() => toggle(detail.item.id)}
          >
            {saved.includes(detail.item.id) ? (
              <Check size={17} />
            ) : (
              <Bookmark size={17} />
            )}{" "}
            {label(saved.includes(detail.item.id) ? "saved" : "saveToLibrary")}
          </Button>
        </Modal>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

  const adaptive = useAdaptiveNavigation();
  const { label } = useLocale();

      className="app-shell"
      data-navigation={navigation}
      data-sidebar={sidebarCollapsed ? "collapsed" : "expanded"}
      data-space="public"
      data-nav-adaptive={adaptive.secondary ? "section" : "scroll"}

      data-study-focus={adaptive.focus || undefined}

FILE: src/app/providers/AppearanceProvider.tsx
============================================================
import {
  createContext,
  useContext,
  useState,
  useEffect,
  useMemo,
  type ReactNode,
} from "react";
import { STORAGE_KEYS } from "../../constants/config";
export type NavigationLayout = "vertical" | "horizontal";
interface AppearancePreferences {
  navigation: NavigationLayout;
  sidebarCollapsed: boolean;
}
const DEFAULTS: AppearancePreferences = {
  navigation: "vertical",
  sidebarCollapsed: false,
};
const isLayout = (value: unknown): value is NavigationLayout =>
  value === "vertical" || value === "horizontal";
function readPreferences(): AppearancePreferences {
  try {
    const value: unknown = JSON.parse(
      localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.appearance) || "null",
    );
    if (
      value &&
      typeof value === "object" &&
      "navigation" in value &&
      isLayout(value.navigation)
    )
      return {
        navigation: value.navigation,
        sidebarCollapsed:
          "sidebarCollapsed" in value && value.sidebarCollapsed === true,
      };
  } catch {
    /* Old, invalid or unavailable preferences use safe defaults. */
  }
  return DEFAULTS;
}
interface AppearanceContext extends AppearancePreferences {
  setNavigation: (layout: NavigationLayout) => void;
  setSidebarCollapsed: (collapsed: boolean) => void;
  persisted: boolean;
}
const Context = createContext<AppearanceContext | null>(null);
export function AppearanceProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [preferences, setPreferences] = useState(readPreferences);
  const [persisted, setPersisted] = useState(true);
  useEffect(() => {
    const sync = (event: StorageEvent) => {
      if (event.key === STORAGE_KEYS.appearance || event.key === null)
        setPreferences(readPreferences());
    };
    window.addEventListener("storage", sync);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("storage", sync);
  }, []);
  const value = useMemo(() => {
    function update(change: Partial<AppearancePreferences>) {
      const next = { ...preferences, ...change };
      setPreferences(next);
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.appearance, JSON.stringify(next));
        setPersisted(true);
      } catch {
        setPersisted(false);
      }
    }
    return {
      ...preferences,
      persisted,
      setNavigation: (navigation: NavigationLayout) => {
        if (isLayout(navigation)) update({ navigation });
      },
      setSidebarCollapsed: (sidebarCollapsed: boolean) =>
        update({ sidebarCollapsed }),
    };
  }, [preferences, persisted]);
  return <Context.Provider value={value}>{children}</Context.Provider>;
}
export function useAppearance() {
  const value = useContext(Context);
  if (!value) throw new Error("AppearanceProvider required");
  return value;
}

import { useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { AppearanceProvider } from "./AppearanceProvider";
import { MotionConfig } from "framer-motion";
import { Toaster } from "sonner";
import { TooltipProvider } from "../../components/ui/tooltip";
import { LocaleProvider, useLocale } from "./LocaleProvider";
import { ServicesProvider } from "./ServicesProvider";
import { SavedItemsProvider } from "./SavedItemsProvider";

import type { Locale } from "../../types/content";

import { StudyChromeProvider } from "./StudyChromeProvider";
function Notifications() {
  const { dir } = useLocale();
  return (
    <Toaster
      position={dir === "rtl" ? "bottom-left" : "bottom-right"}
      dir={dir}
      theme="light"
    />
  );

  children,
  services = mockServices,
  initialLocale,
}: {
  children: ReactNode;
  services?: MedClubServices;
  initialLocale?: Locale;

            staleTime: QUERY_STALE_TIME,

FILE: src/app/providers/AuthProvider.tsx
============================================================
import {
  createContext,
  useCallback,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useMemo,
  useState,
  type ReactNode,
} from "react";
import { useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useServices } from "./ServicesProvider";
import type {
  AuthProfileInput,
  AuthSnapshot,
  RegisterInput,
  SignInInput,
} from "../../types/auth";

interface AuthContextValue {
  snapshot: AuthSnapshot;
  isPending: boolean;
  refresh: () => Promise<AuthSnapshot>;
  signIn: (input: SignInInput) => Promise<AuthSnapshot>;
  register: (input: RegisterInput) => Promise<AuthSnapshot>;
  verifyEmail: (code: string) => Promise<AuthSnapshot>;
  requestPasswordReset: (email: string) => Promise<void>;
  updateProfile: (input: AuthProfileInput) => Promise<AuthSnapshot>;
  signOut: () => Promise<AuthSnapshot>;
}

const initialSnapshot: AuthSnapshot = { status: "anonymous", user: null };
const Context = createContext<AuthContextValue | null>(null);

export function AuthProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const services = useServices();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const [snapshot, setSnapshot] = useState(initialSnapshot);
  const [isPending, setPending] = useState(true);

  const commit = useCallback(
    async (next: AuthSnapshot) => {
      setSnapshot(next);
      if (next.user)
        queryClient.setQueryData(["personal", "profile"], next.user.profile);
      else queryClient.removeQueries({ queryKey: ["personal", "profile"] });
      return next;
    },
    [queryClient],
  );

  const refresh = useCallback(async () => {
    const next = await services.auth.getSnapshot();
    setPending(false);
    return commit(next);
  }, [commit, services.auth]);

  useEffect(() => {
    void refresh();
    return services.auth.subscribe(() => void refresh());
  }, [refresh, services.auth]);

  const run = useCallback(
    async (action: () => Promise<AuthSnapshot>) => {
      setPending(true);
      try {
        return await commit(await action());
      } finally {
        setPending(false);
      }
    },
    [commit],
  );

  const value = useMemo<AuthContextValue>(
    () => ({
      snapshot,
      isPending,
      refresh,
      signIn: (input) => run(() => services.auth.signIn(input)),
      register: (input) => run(() => services.auth.register(input)),
      verifyEmail: (code) => run(() => services.auth.verifyEmail(code)),
      requestPasswordReset: async (email) => {
        setPending(true);
        try {
          await services.auth.requestPasswordReset(email);
        } finally {
          setPending(false);
        }
      },
      updateProfile: (input) => run(() => services.auth.updateProfile(input)),
      signOut: () => run(() => services.auth.signOut()),
    }),
    [isPending, refresh, run, services.auth, snapshot],
  );

  return <Context.Provider value={value}>{children}</Context.Provider>;
}

export function useAuth() {
  const value = useContext(Context);
  if (!value) throw new Error("AuthProvider required");
  return value;
}

FILE: src/app/providers/LocaleProvider.tsx
============================================================
import {
  createContext,
  useContext,
  useState,
  useEffect,
  useMemo,
  type ReactNode,
} from "react";
import type { Locale, Text } from "../../types/content";
import { messages, type MessageKey } from "../../constants/messages";
import { DEFAULT_LOCALE, STORAGE_KEYS } from "../../constants/config";
interface LocaleContextValue {
  locale: Locale;
  dir: "ltr" | "rtl";
  setLocale: (value: Locale) => void;
  t: (value: Text) => string;
  label: (key: MessageKey) => string;
}
const Context = createContext<LocaleContextValue | null>(null);
export function LocaleProvider({
  children,
  initialLocale = DEFAULT_LOCALE,
}: {
  children: ReactNode;
  initialLocale?: Locale;
}) {
  const [locale, setValue] = useState<Locale>(() => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.locale);
      return saved === "ar" || saved === "en" ? saved : initialLocale;
    } catch {
      return initialLocale;
    }
  });
  const dir: "ltr" | "rtl" = locale === "ar" ? "rtl" : "ltr";
  useEffect(() => {
    document.documentElement.lang = locale;
    document.documentElement.dir = dir;
  }, [locale, dir]);
  function setLocale(value: Locale) {
    setValue(value);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.locale, value);
    } catch {
      /* Language still works for this session. */
    }
  }
  const value = useMemo(
    () => ({
      locale,
      dir,
      setLocale,
      t: (text: Text) => text[locale],
      label: (key: MessageKey) => messages[locale][key],
    }),
    [locale, dir],
  );
  return <Context.Provider value={value}>{children}</Context.Provider>;
}
export function useLocale() {
  const value = useContext(Context);
  if (!value) throw new Error("LocaleProvider required");
  return value;
}

FILE: src/app/providers/OverlayProvider.tsx
============================================================
import { useLocation } from "react-router-dom";
import {
  createContext,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useState,
  type ReactNode,
} from "react";
import type { DetailRecord } from "../../types/content";
import { useWorkspace } from "./WorkspaceProvider";
interface OverlayContextValue {
  searchOpen: boolean;
  detail: DetailRecord | null;
  openSearch: () => void;
  closeSearch: () => void;
  openDetail: (record: DetailRecord) => void;
  closeDetail: () => void;
}
const Context = createContext<OverlayContextValue | null>(null);
export function OverlayProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const location = useLocation();
  const { send } = useWorkspace();
  useEffect(() => {
    setSearch(false);
    setDetail(null);
  }, [location.pathname]);
  const [searchOpen, setSearch] = useState(false);
  const [detail, setDetail] = useState<DetailRecord | null>(null);
  function openSearch() {
    if (detail) return;
    setSearch(true);
  }
  function closeSearch() {
    setSearch(false);
  }
  function openDetail(record: DetailRecord) {
    if (record.kind === "resource")
      void send({ type: "view-resource", id: record.item.id });
    setSearch(false);
    setDetail(record);
  }
  function closeDetail() {
    setDetail(null);
  }
  useEffect(() => {
    function key(e: KeyboardEvent) {
      const target = e.target;
      const editing =
        target instanceof HTMLElement &&
        (target.isContentEditable || target.matches("input,textarea,select"));
      if (editing || document.querySelector('dialog[open], [role="dialog"]'))
        return;
      if (
        ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key.toLowerCase() === "k") ||
        e.key === "/"
      ) {
        e.preventDefault();
        openSearch();
      }
    }
    window.addEventListener("keydown", key);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", key);
  }, [detail]);
  return (
    <Context.Provider
      value={{
        searchOpen,
        detail,
        openSearch,
        closeSearch,
        openDetail,
        closeDetail,
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </Context.Provider>
  );
}
export function useOverlays() {
  const value = useContext(Context);
  if (!value) throw new Error("OverlayProvider required");
  return value;
}

import { type ReactNode } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useLocale } from "./LocaleProvider";
import { useWorkspace } from "./WorkspaceProvider";
/** Compatibility facade: existing V0.1/V0.2 cards keep the same API. */
export function SavedItemsProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  return children;
}
export function useSavedItems() {
  const { state, send, isPending, isError } = useWorkspace();
  const { label } = useLocale();
  return {
    saved: state.savedIds,
    isPending: isPending || isError,
    toggle: async (id: string) => {
      const removing = state.savedIds.includes(id);
      if (await send({ type: "toggle-save", id }))
        toast(label(removing ? "removed" : "saved"));
    },
  };
}

import {

  type ReactNode,

import { useLocation } from "react-router-dom";

const Context = createContext({
  focus: false,
  setFocus: (_value: boolean) => {},
});
export function StudyChromeProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const { pathname } = useLocation();
  const [focusPath, setFocusPath] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const focus = focusPath === pathname;
  useEffect(() => {
    setFocusPath(null);
  }, [pathname]);

      value={{
        focus,
        setFocus: (value) => setFocusPath(value ? pathname : null),
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </Context.Provider>
  );
}
export const useStudyChrome = () => useContext(Context);

FILE: src/app/providers/WorkspaceProvider.tsx
============================================================
import {
  createContext,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useRef,
  type ReactNode,
} from "react";
import { useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useServices } from "./ServicesProvider";
import { useLocale } from "./LocaleProvider";
import { useStudentProfile } from "../../hooks/useContent";
import { emptyWorkspace } from "../../lib/workspace-state";
import type { PersonalWorkspace, WorkspaceAction } from "../../types/workspace";
const empty = emptyWorkspace();
interface WorkspaceContext {
  state: PersonalWorkspace;
  isPending: boolean;
  isError: boolean;
  persistent: boolean;
  send: (action: WorkspaceAction) => Promise<boolean>;
  retry: () => void;
}
const Context = createContext<WorkspaceContext | null>(null);
export function WorkspaceProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const { workspace } = useServices();
  const { label } = useLocale();
  const profile = useStudentProfile();
  const id = profile.data?.id;
  const client = useQueryClient();
  const queue = useRef<Promise<unknown>>(Promise.resolve());
  const key = ["workspace", id];
  const query = useQuery({
    queryKey: key,
    queryFn: () => workspace.get(id!),
    enabled: !!id,
  });
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!id) return;
    return workspace.subscribe?.(id, () => {
      void client.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["workspace", id] });
    });
  }, [id, workspace, client]);
  async function send(action: WorkspaceAction) {
    if (!id || !query.data) {
      toast.error(label("workspaceNotReady"));
      return false;
    }
    const job = queue.current
      .catch(() => undefined)
      .then(async () => {
        try {
          const snapshot = await workspace.dispatch(id, action);
          client.setQueryData(["workspace", id], snapshot);
          if (!snapshot.persistent) toast(label("sessionOnly"));
          return true;
        } catch {
          toast.error(label("workspaceSaveFailed"));
          return false;
        }
      });
    queue.current = job;
    return job;
  }
  return (
    <Context.Provider
      value={{
        state: query.data?.state || empty,
        isPending:
          !(profile.isError || query.isError) &&
          (profile.isPending || query.isPending),
        isError: profile.isError || query.isError,
        persistent: query.data?.persistent ?? true,
        send,
        retry: () => {
          void profile.refetch();
          void query.refetch();
        },
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </Context.Provider>
  );
}
export function useWorkspace() {
  const context = useContext(Context);
  if (!context) throw new Error("WorkspaceProvider required");
  return context;
}
