import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { motion, useReducedMotion } from "framer-motion";

export function AcademicTransition({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion();
  return (
    <motion.div
      className="academic-route-transition"
      initial={reduced ? false : { opacity: 0, y: 10, scale: 0.997 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 }}
      transition={{ duration: reduced ? 0 : 0.32, ease: [0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1] }}
    >
      {!reduced && (
        <motion.span
          className="academic-route-thread"
          aria-hidden="true"
          initial={{ scaleX: 0, opacity: 0.7 }}
          animate={{ scaleX: 1, opacity: 0 }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.55, ease: "easeOut" }}
        />
      )}
      {children}
    </motion.div>
  );
}

  personal = false,
  admin = false,
}: {
  personal?: boolean;
  admin?: boolean;
}) {

  return (
    <div className="container not-found">
      <h1>{label("notFound")}</h1>
      <p>{label("notFoundBody")}</p>
      <ActionLink href={admin ? "/admin" : personal ? "/my" : "/"}>
        {label(admin ? "adminOverview" : personal ? "backToMySpace" : "back")}
      </ActionLink>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/app/router/CapabilityGate.tsx
============================================================
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import type { Capability } from "../../types/governance";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { useLocale } from "../providers/LocaleProvider";
import { useAccess } from "../../admin/governance/useGovernance";

export function CapabilityGate({ capability, children }: { capability: Capability; children: ReactNode }) {
  const { label } = useLocale();
  const access = useAccess();
  if (access.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (access.isError) return <ErrorState retry={() => void access.refetch()} />;
  if (!access.data.capabilities.includes(capability)) {
    return (
      <section className="container governance-forbidden" role="alert">
        <span aria-hidden="true">403</span>
        <h1 data-page-heading tabIndex={-1}>{label("governanceForbiddenTitle")}</h1>
        <p>{label("governanceForbiddenBody")}</p>
      </section>
    );
  }
  return <>{children}</>;
}

FILE: src/app/router/MedicalTransition.tsx

import { motion, useReducedMotion } from "framer-motion";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

export function MedicalTransition({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion();
  return (
    <motion.div
      className="medical-route-transition"
      initial={reduced ? false : { opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
      transition={{ duration: reduced ? 0 : 0.32, ease: [0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1] }}
    >
      {!reduced && (
        <motion.div
          className="medical-scan"
          aria-hidden="true"
          initial={{ scaleX: 0, opacity: 0.9 }}
          animate={{ scaleX: 1, opacity: 0 }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.72, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }}
        >
          <i />
        </motion.div>
      )}
      {children}
    </motion.div>
  );
}

FILE: src/app/router/RequireAuth.tsx
============================================================
import { Navigate, Outlet, useLocation } from "react-router-dom";
import { useAuth } from "../providers/AuthProvider";
import { routes, signInPath } from "../../constants/routes";
import { useLocale } from "../providers/LocaleProvider";

export function RequireAuth() {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const location = useLocation();
  const { label } = useLocale();
  const returnTo = `${location.pathname}${location.search}${location.hash}`;

  if (auth.isPending)
    return (
      <div className="auth-gate" role="status" aria-live="polite">
        <span className="auth-gate-pulse" aria-hidden="true" />
        {label("authLoading")}
      </div>
    );
  if (auth.snapshot.status === "verification-required")
    return (
      <Navigate
        replace
        to={`${routes.verify}?returnTo=${encodeURIComponent(returnTo)}`}
      />
    );
  if (auth.snapshot.status !== "authenticated")
    return <Navigate replace to={signInPath(returnTo)} />;
  return <Outlet />;
}

import { useEffect } from "react";
import { useLocation } from "react-router-dom";
import { useLocale } from "../providers/LocaleProvider";
export function RouteEffects() {
  const location = useLocation();
  const { label, locale } = useLocale();
  useEffect(() => {
    const keys = {
      "/": "home",
      "/search": "search",
      "/my/search": "personalSearch",
      "/my/calendar": "calendar",
      "/my/notifications": "notifications",
      "/my/events": "myEvents",
      "/my/opportunities": "myOpportunities",
      "/my/mentorship": "myMentorship",
      "/my/contributions": "myContributions",
      "/my/orders": "myOrders",
      "/my/applications": "myApplications",
      "/my/team": "teamProfile",
      "/events": "events",
      "/opportunities": "opportunities",
      "/community": "community",
      "/community/activities": "activities",
      "/community/media": "media",
      "/community/executive-bodies": "executiveBodies",
      "/community/honor-plate": "honorPlate",
      "/community/hall-of-honor": "hallOfHonor",
      "/community/about": "aboutMedClub",
      "/journal": "journal",
      "/mentorship": "mentorship",
      "/mentorship/sessions": "groupSessions",
      "/mentorship/qa": "mentorQA",
      "/contribute": "contribute",
      "/recruitment": "recruitment",
      "/learn": "learn",
      "/learn/basic-sciences": "basic",
      "/learn/clinical-sciences": "clinical",
      "/my": "mySpace",
      "/my/learning": "myLearning",
      "/my/progress": "myProgress",
      "/my/library": "libraryShort",
      "/my/focus": "myFocus",
      "/my/profile": "myProfile",
      "/my/settings": "personalSettings",
      "/utilities": "tools",
      "/store": "store",
      "/store/cart": "cart",
      "/auth/sign-in": "signIn",
      "/auth/register": "createAccount",
      "/auth/verify": "verifyEmail",
      "/auth/recover": "forgotPassword",
      "/admin": "adminOverview",
      "/admin/content": "adminContent",
      "/admin/builder": "builderNavigation",
      "/admin/activity": "adminActivity",
      "/admin/versions": "adminVersions",
      "/admin/governance": "governanceNavigation",
      "/admin/users": "governanceUsers",
      "/admin/roles": "governanceRoles",
      "/admin/approvals": "governanceApprovals",
      "/admin/analytics": "adminAnalytics",
      "/admin/content-health": "adminContentHealth",
      "/learn/electronic-exams": "exams",
    } as const;
    const key = keys[location.pathname as keyof typeof keys];
    const academicChild =
      location.pathname.includes("/batches/") ||
      /^\/learn\/clinical-sciences\/(fourth|fifth|sixth)-year$/.test(
        location.pathname,
      );
    document.title = `${key ? label(key) : label(location.pathname.startsWith("/admin/builder/") ? "builderEditor" : location.pathname.startsWith("/events/") ? "event" : location.pathname.startsWith("/opportunities/") ? "opportunity" : location.pathname.startsWith("/journal/") ? "journal" : location.pathname.startsWith("/store/products/") ? "product" : location.pathname.startsWith("/recruitment/") ? "position" : location.pathname.startsWith("/learn/courses/") || location.pathname.startsWith("/my/learning/") ? "course" : academicChild ? "academic" : "notFound")} | MedClub`;
  }, [location.pathname, locale, label]);
  useEffect(() => {
    let observer: MutationObserver | undefined;
    const focusAtNavigation = document.activeElement;
    const frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      if (location.hash) {
        let id = location.hash.slice(1);
        try {
          id = decodeURIComponent(id);
        } catch {}
        const scroll = () => {
          const target = document.getElementById(id);
          if (!target) return false;
          target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "auto" });
          observer?.disconnect();
          return true;
        };
        // Lazy route content may mount after this effect, including on a direct hash URL.
        if (!scroll()) {
          observer = new MutationObserver(scroll);
          observer.observe(document.getElementById("main") ?? document.body, {
            childList: true,
            subtree: true,
          });
        }
      } else {
        window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "auto" });
        // Do not steal focus if the user already opened a menu/dialog or moved on
        // while a lazy route was committing.
        if (
          !document.querySelector('dialog[open], [role="dialog"]') &&
          (document.activeElement === focusAtNavigation ||
            document.activeElement === document.body)
        ) {
          document.getElementById("main")?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
        }
      }
    });
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
      observer?.disconnect();
    };
  }, [location.pathname, location.hash, location.key]);
  return null;
}

import { motion, useReducedMotion } from "framer-motion";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
export function RouteTransition({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion();
  return (
    <motion.div
      initial={reduced ? false : { opacity: 0, y: 6 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.18, ease: "easeOut" }}
    >
      {children}
    </motion.div>
  );
}

FILE: src/app/router/SpaceTransition.tsx
============================================================
import { useEffect, useRef, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { motion, useReducedMotion } from "framer-motion";
import { useLocale } from "../providers/LocaleProvider";

type Space = "personal" | "public" | "auth" | "admin";

/** Cross-fades product worlds without hiding focused content or transforming fixed nav. */
export function SpaceTransition({ space, children }: { space: Space; children: ReactNode }) {
  const previous = useRef<Space>(space);
  const reduced = useReducedMotion();
  const { label } = useLocale();
  const from = previous.current;
  const crossing = from !== space;
  useEffect(() => { previous.current = space; }, [space]);
  const transitionLabel = space === "admin"
    ? label("spaceEnteringAdmin")
    : from === "admin"
      ? label("spaceLeavingAdmin")
      : space === "personal"
        ? label("spaceLeavingPublic")
        : label("spaceLeavingPersonal");
  return (
    <motion.div
      key={space}
      className={`space-transition space-transition-${space}`}
      data-workspace={space}
      data-arriving={crossing || undefined}
      initial={crossing && !reduced ? { opacity: 0.08, filter: "blur(10px)" } : false}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, filter: "blur(0px)", transitionEnd: { filter: "none" } }}
      style={{ willChange: "auto" }}
      transition={{ duration: reduced ? 0 : 0.48, ease: [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1] }}
    >
      {children}
      {crossing && !reduced && (
        <motion.div className="space-flight-gate" data-from={from} data-to={space} aria-hidden="true" initial={{ opacity: 1 }} animate={{ opacity: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.7, ease: "easeOut" }}>
          <span className="space-flight-aperture"><i /><i /><i /></span>
          <span className="space-flight-streaks"><i /><i /><i /><i /><i /><i /></span>
          <small>{transitionLabel}</small>
        </motion.div>
      )}
    </motion.div>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/cards/AcademicPortalCard.tsx
============================================================
import type { CSSProperties, PointerEvent, ReactNode } from "react";
import { ArrowUpRight } from "lucide-react";
import { AppLink } from "../navigation/AppLink";

export function AcademicPortalCard({
  href,
  eyebrow,
  title,
  description,
  action,
  tone,
  children,
}: {
  href: string;
  eyebrow: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  action: string;
  tone: "basic" | "clinical";
  children?: ReactNode;
}) {
  function follow(event: PointerEvent<HTMLAnchorElement>) {
    const bounds = event.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
    event.currentTarget.style.setProperty(
      "--spot-x",
      `${event.clientX - bounds.left}px`,
    );
    event.currentTarget.style.setProperty(
      "--spot-y",
      `${event.clientY - bounds.top}px`,
    );
  }
  return (
    <AppLink
      href={href}
      className={`academic-portal portal-${tone}`}
      onPointerMove={follow}
      style={{ "--spot-x": "65%", "--spot-y": "35%" } as CSSProperties}
    >
      <span className="portal-spot" aria-hidden="true" />
      <span className="portal-grid" aria-hidden="true" />
      <span className="portal-copy">
        <span className="academic-kicker">{eyebrow}</span>
        <strong>{title}</strong>
        <span>{description}</span>
      </span>
      {children}
      <span className="portal-action">
        {action}
        <ArrowUpRight size={19} className="directional" />
      </span>
    </AppLink>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/cards/EventTicketCard.tsx
============================================================
import { ArrowUpRight, Clock3, MapPin, UsersRound } from "lucide-react";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { eventPath } from "../../constants/routes";
import { eventAvailability, eventPlacesLeft } from "../../lib/discovery";
import { formatDate } from "../../lib/dates";
import type { ClubEvent } from "../../types/content";
import { AppLink } from "../navigation/AppLink";
import { SaveButton } from "./SaveButton";

const statusKeys = {
  upcoming: "opensSoon",
  open: "eventOpen",
  waitlist: "eventWaitlist",
  closed: "registrationClosed",
  ended: "registrationClosed",
} as const;

export function EventTicketCard({ event }: { event: ClubEvent }) {
  const { t, label, locale } = useLocale();
  const status = eventAvailability(event);
  const progress = Math.min(
    100,
    (event.registeredCount / event.capacity) * 100,
  );
  return (
    <article className="event-ticket" data-status={status}>
      <div
        className="ticket-date"
        aria-label={formatDate(event.startDate, locale)}
      >
        <span>{formatDate(event.startDate, locale, { month: "short" })}</span>
        <b>{formatDate(event.startDate, locale, { day: "2-digit" })}</b>
        <small>
          {formatDate(event.startDate, locale, { weekday: "short" })}
        </small>
      </div>
      <div className="ticket-body">
        <div className="ticket-topline">
          <span className="eyebrow">{t(event.type)}</span>
          <span className="event-status" data-status={status}>
            {label(statusKeys[status])}
          </span>
        </div>
        <h2>
          <AppLink href={eventPath(event.slug)}>{t(event.title)}</AppLink>
        </h2>
        <p>{t(event.description)}</p>
        <div className="ticket-facts">
          <span>
            <Clock3 size={15} />
            {formatDate(event.startDate, locale, {
              hour: "numeric",
              minute: "2-digit",
            })}
          </span>
          <span>
            <MapPin size={15} />
            {t(event.location)}
          </span>
          <span>
            <UsersRound size={15} />
            {status === "open"
              ? `${eventPlacesLeft(event)} ${label("spotsLeft")}`
              : `${event.registeredCount}/${event.capacity}`}
          </span>
        </div>
        <div className="capacity-line" aria-hidden="true">
          <i style={{ width: `${progress}%` }} />
        </div>
        <div className="ticket-actions">
          <AppLink className="text-link" href={eventPath(event.slug)}>
            {label("eventView")}
            <ArrowUpRight size={17} className="directional" />
          </AppLink>
          <SaveButton id={event.id} title={t(event.title)} />
        </div>
      </div>
    </article>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/cards/MentorCard.tsx
============================================================
import { ArrowUpRight, Languages, MapPin, UsersRound } from "lucide-react";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { routes } from "../../constants/routes";
import type { Mentor, MentorshipRequest } from "../../types/content";
import { AppLink } from "../navigation/AppLink";
import { Button } from "../ui/button";

export function MentorCard({
  mentor,
  request,
  onRequest,
}: {
  mentor: Mentor;
  request?: MentorshipRequest;
  onRequest: (mentor: Mentor) => void;
}) {
  const { t, label } = useLocale();
  const openPlaces = Math.max(0, mentor.capacity - mentor.activeMentees);
  return (
    <article
      className="mentor-card"
      data-capacity={openPlaces ? "open" : "full"}
    >
      <div className="mentor-card-head">
        <span className="mentor-avatar" aria-hidden="true">
          {t(mentor.initials)}
        </span>
        <div>
          <span>
            {t(mentor.title)} · {label("classOf")} {mentor.graduationYear}
          </span>
          <h2>{t(mentor.name)}</h2>
          <strong>{t(mentor.specialty)}</strong>
        </div>
      </div>
      <p>{t(mentor.bio)}</p>
      <div className="mentor-meta">
        <span>
          <MapPin size={15} /> {label(mentor.format)}
        </span>
        <span>
          <Languages size={15} /> {mentor.languages.map(t).join(" · ")}
        </span>
      </div>
      <div className="mentor-areas">
        <span>{label("mentoringAreas")}</span>
        <ul>
          {mentor.areas.map((area) => (
            <li key={area.en}>{t(area)}</li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </div>
      <div
        className="mentor-capacity"
        aria-label={`${openPlaces} ${label("placesAvailable")}`}
      >
        <span>
          <UsersRound size={17} />
        </span>
        <div>
          <i
            style={{
              width: `${(mentor.activeMentees / mentor.capacity) * 100}%`,
            }}
          />
        </div>
        <strong>
          {openPlaces
            ? `${openPlaces} ${label("placesAvailable")}`
            : label("atCapacity")}
        </strong>
      </div>
      {request &&
      request.status !== "cancelled" &&
      request.status !== "declined" ? (
        <AppLink
          href={routes.myMentorship}
          className="button button-secondary mentor-action"
        >
          {label(request.status)}
          <ArrowUpRight size={17} className="directional" />
        </AppLink>
      ) : (
        <Button
          className="button button-primary mentor-action"
          disabled={!openPlaces}
          onClick={() => onRequest(mentor)}
        >
          {label("requestSession")}
          <ArrowUpRight size={17} className="directional" />
        </Button>
      )}
    </article>
  );
}

import { CalendarDays, Clock3, MapPin, UsersRound } from "lucide-react";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { formatDate } from "../../lib/dates";
import type { Mentor, MentorshipSession } from "../../types/content";
import { Button } from "../ui/button";

export function MentorshipSessionCard({
  session,
  mentor,
  joined,
  busy,
  onToggle,
}: {
  session: MentorshipSession;
  mentor?: Mentor;
  joined: boolean;
  busy: boolean;
  onToggle: () => void;
}) {
  const { t, label, locale } = useLocale();
  const full = session.registeredCount >= session.capacity && !joined;
  return (
    <article className="mentor-session-card" data-joined={joined || undefined}>
      <div className="session-date-block">
        <CalendarDays size={20} />
        <strong>
          {formatDate(session.startsAt, locale, {
            day: "2-digit",
            month: "short",
          })}
        </strong>
        <span>
          {formatDate(session.startsAt, locale, {
            hour: "2-digit",
            minute: "2-digit",
          })}
        </span>
      </div>
      <div className="session-card-copy">
        <span className="eyebrow">{t(session.topic)}</span>
        <h2>{t(session.title)}</h2>
        <p>{t(session.summary)}</p>
        <div className="session-facts">
          <span>
            <Clock3 size={15} /> {label(session.format)}
          </span>
          <span>
            <MapPin size={15} /> {t(session.location)}
          </span>
          <span>
            <UsersRound size={15} /> {session.registeredCount}/
            {session.capacity} {label("registeredCount")}
          </span>
        </div>
        <small>
          {label("facilitatedBy")}: {mentor ? t(mentor.name) : "—"} ·{" "}
          {label("forStudents")}: {t(session.audience)}
        </small>
      </div>
      <Button
        variant={joined ? "outline" : "default"}
        className={joined ? "button" : "button button-primary"}
        disabled={busy || full}
        onClick={onToggle}
      >
        {label(
          joined ? "leaveSession" : full ? "sessionFull" : "joinGroupSession",
        )}
      </Button>
    </article>
  );
}

import {
  BadgeCheck,
  ClipboardPenLine,
  ContactRound,
  MessagesSquare,
  ScanSearch,
  UserRoundCheck,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { applicationStage } from "../../lib/recruitment";
import type { RecruitmentApplicationStatus } from "../../types/recruitment";

const stages = [
  { key: "applyStage", icon: ClipboardPenLine },
  { key: "screeningStage", icon: ScanSearch },
  { key: "interviewStage", icon: MessagesSquare },
  { key: "decisionStage", icon: BadgeCheck },
  { key: "onboardingStage", icon: UserRoundCheck },
  { key: "memberStage", icon: ContactRound },
] as const;

export function RecruitmentPipeline({
  status,
  compact = false,
}: {
  status?: RecruitmentApplicationStatus;
  compact?: boolean;
}) {
  const { label } = useLocale();
  const active = status ? applicationStage(status) : -1;
  const stopped = status === "rejected" || status === "withdrawn";
  return (
    <ol
      className={`recruitment-pipeline ${compact ? "recruitment-pipeline-compact" : ""}`}
      aria-label={label("recruitmentPathTitle")}
      data-stopped={stopped || undefined}
    >
      {stages.map(({ key, icon: Icon }, index) => (
        <li
          key={key}
          data-state={
            active < 0
              ? "future"
              : index < active
                ? "complete"
                : index === active
                  ? "active"
                  : "future"
          }
        >
          <span aria-hidden="true">
            <Icon size={compact ? 16 : 19} />
            <i />
          </span>
          <strong>{label(key)}</strong>
        </li>
      ))}
    </ol>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/feedback/AppErrorBoundary.tsx
============================================================
import { Component, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { messages } from "../../constants/messages";
import { STORAGE_KEYS } from "../../constants/config";
export class AppErrorBoundary extends Component<
  { children: ReactNode },
  { failed: boolean }
> {
  state = { failed: false };
  static getDerivedStateFromError() {
    return { failed: true };
  }
  render() {
    if (!this.state.failed) return this.props.children;
    let locale: "en" | "ar" = "en";
    try {
      if (localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.locale) === "ar") locale = "ar";
    } catch {}
    const m = messages[locale];
    return (
      <main
        className="container not-found"
        dir={locale === "ar" ? "rtl" : "ltr"}
      >
        <h1>{m.errorTitle}</h1>
        <p>{m.errorBody}</p>
        <button
          className="button button-primary"
          onClick={() => window.location.reload()}
        >
          {m.retry}
        </button>
      </main>
    );
  }
}

============================================================
FILE: src/components/navigation/AdaptiveNavigation.tsx
============================================================
import {
  useCallback,
  useEffect,
  useId,
  useRef,
  useState,
  type ReactNode,
} from "react";
import { useLocation } from "react-router-dom";
import { ChevronRight, Menu, Pin, PinOff, X } from "lucide-react";
import { useStudyChrome } from "../../app/providers/StudyChromeProvider";
import { useStudyCopy } from "../../features/courses/study-copy";

const pinKey = "medclub:navigation:pinned:v1";
export const isCourseRoute = (path: string) =>
  /^\/(?:learn\/courses|my\/learning)\/[^/]+\/?$/.test(path);
export const hasSectionNavigation = (path: string) =>
  isCourseRoute(path) ||
  /^\/(?:community|journal|mentorship|contribute|store|recruitment)(?:\/|$)/.test(
    path,
  );

export function useAdaptiveNavigation(personal = false) {
  const { pathname } = useLocation();
  const { focus } = useStudyChrome();
  const enabled = personal ? isCourseRoute(pathname) : true;
  const secondary = hasSectionNavigation(pathname);
  const [pinned, setPinned] = useState(() => {
    try {
      return localStorage.getItem(pinKey) === "true";
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  });
  const [hidden, setHidden] = useState(false);
  const root = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const handle = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const timer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined>(undefined);
  const hovering = useRef(false);
  const config = useRef({ enabled, pinned, focus });
  config.current = { enabled, pinned, focus };
  const cancel = useCallback(() => {
    if (timer.current) clearTimeout(timer.current);
  }, []);
  const locked = useCallback(
    () =>
      hovering.current ||
      !!root.current?.contains(document.activeElement) ||
      !!document.querySelector('dialog[open], [role="dialog"], [role="menu"]'),
    [],
  );
  const reveal = useCallback(() => {
    cancel();
    setHidden(false);
  }, [cancel]);
  const retreat = useCallback(() => {
    const state = config.current;
    if (state.enabled && (!state.pinned || state.focus) && !locked())
      setHidden(true);
  }, [locked]);
  const leave = useCallback(() => {
    hovering.current = false;
    cancel();
    if (secondary || focus || window.scrollY > 80)
      timer.current = setTimeout(retreat, 650);
  }, [cancel, focus, retreat, secondary]);
  useEffect(() => {
    reveal();
    hovering.current = false;
    if (enabled && (secondary || focus) && (!pinned || focus))
      timer.current = setTimeout(retreat, focus ? 120 : 1100);
    return cancel;
  }, [pathname, enabled, secondary, pinned, focus, reveal, retreat, cancel]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enabled) return;
    let previous = window.scrollY,
      total = 0,
      direction = 0,
      frame = 0;
    const scroll = () => {
      if (frame) return;
      frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        frame = 0;
        const next = Math.max(0, window.scrollY),
          delta = next - previous;
        previous = next;
        if (Math.abs(delta) < 2) return;
        const sign = Math.sign(delta);
        total = direction === sign ? total + Math.abs(delta) : Math.abs(delta);
        direction = sign;
        if (next <= 12 && !config.current.focus) {
          reveal();
          total = 0;
        } else if (sign > 0 && total >= 48) {
          retreat();
          total = 0;
        } else if (sign < 0 && total >= 24) {
          reveal();
          total = 0;
        }
      });
    };
    window.addEventListener("scroll", scroll, { passive: true });
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("scroll", scroll);
      cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
    };
  }, [enabled, reveal, retreat]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const storage = (event: StorageEvent) => {
      if (event.key === pinKey) setPinned(event.newValue === "true");
    };
    window.addEventListener("storage", storage);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("storage", storage);
  }, []);
  const togglePin = () => {
    const value = !pinned;
    setPinned(value);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(pinKey, String(value));
    } catch {}
    if (value) reveal();
  };
  return {
    enabled,
    secondary,
    focus,
    hidden: enabled && hidden,
    pinned,
    root,
    handle,
    reveal,
    leave,
    hovering,
    togglePin,
    hide: () => {
      cancel();
      setHidden(true);
      handle.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    },
  };
}

export function AdaptiveNavigation({
  children,
  state,
  personal = false,
}: {
  children: ReactNode;
  state: ReturnType<typeof useAdaptiveNavigation>;
  personal?: boolean;
}) {
  const s = useStudyCopy();
  const id = useId();
  if (!state.enabled) return <>{children}</>;
  return (
    <>
      <div
        className="adaptive-navigation-controls"
        data-open={!state.hidden}
        onPointerEnter={(event) => {
          if (event.pointerType === "mouse") state.reveal();
        }}
      >
        <button
          ref={state.handle}
          type="button"
          className="navigation-glance"
          aria-label={s(personal ? "personalMenu" : "menu")}
          aria-expanded={!state.hidden}
          aria-controls={id}
          onClick={state.reveal}
          onFocus={() => {
            if (state.hidden) state.reveal();
          }}
        >
          <Menu size={17} aria-hidden="true" />
          <span>{s(personal ? "personalMenu" : "menu")}</span>
          <ChevronRight size={14} className="directional" aria-hidden="true" />
        </button>
        {!state.hidden && (
          <div className="navigation-reveal-actions">
            <button
              type="button"
              aria-pressed={state.pinned}
              aria-label={s(state.pinned ? "unpin" : "pin")}
              onClick={state.togglePin}
            >
              {state.pinned ? <PinOff size={17} /> : <Pin size={17} />}
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              aria-label={s("collapse")}
              onClick={state.hide}
            >
              <X size={17} />
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      <div
        id={id}
        ref={state.root}
        className="adaptive-navigation-panel"
        inert={state.hidden || undefined}
        onPointerEnter={(event) => {
          if (event.pointerType === "mouse") {
            state.hovering.current = true;
            state.reveal();
          }
        }}
        onPointerLeave={state.leave}
        onFocusCapture={state.reveal}
        onBlur={(event) => {
          if (!event.currentTarget.contains(event.relatedTarget)) state.leave();
        }}
      >
        {children}
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Activity, ChartNoAxesCombined, FileClock, Fingerprint, HeartPulse, KeyRound, LayoutDashboard, Menu, PanelsTopLeft, ShieldCheck, Stethoscope, UsersRound } from "lucide-react";
import { useLocation } from "react-router-dom";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { useAccess, useAccessRequests } from "../../admin/governance/useGovernance";
import { useNavigationScrollCues } from "../../hooks/useNavigationScrollCues";
import type { MessageKey } from "../../constants/messages";
import type { Capability } from "../../types/governance";
import { Modal } from "../ui/Modal";
import { AppLink } from "./AppLink";
import { AppearanceSettings } from "./AppearanceSettings";
import { NavigationHint } from "./NavigationHint";
import { SidebarToggle } from "./SidebarToggle";

type NavItem = { href: string; label: MessageKey; icon: typeof LayoutDashboard; capability: Capability; priority?: boolean; badge?: boolean };
const operations: NavItem[] = [
  { href: "/admin", label: "adminOverview", icon: LayoutDashboard, capability: "admin.access" },
  { href: "/admin/content", label: "adminContent", icon: ShieldCheck, capability: "content.review" },
  { href: "/admin/builder", label: "builderNavigation", icon: PanelsTopLeft, capability: "builder.manage" },
];
const insights: NavItem[] = [
  { href: "/admin/analytics", label: "adminAnalytics", icon: ChartNoAxesCombined, capability: "activity.view" },
  { href: "/admin/content-health", label: "adminContentHealth", icon: HeartPulse, capability: "content.review" },
];
const safety: NavItem[] = [
  { href: "/admin/governance", label: "governanceNavigation", icon: Fingerprint, capability: "admin.access", priority: true },
  { href: "/admin/users", label: "governanceUsers", icon: UsersRound, capability: "users.view" },
  { href: "/admin/roles", label: "governanceRoles", icon: KeyRound, capability: "roles.manage" },
  { href: "/admin/approvals", label: "governanceApprovals", icon: ShieldCheck, capability: "governance.approve", badge: true },
  { href: "/admin/activity", label: "adminActivity", icon: Activity, capability: "activity.view" },
  { href: "/admin/versions", label: "adminVersions", icon: FileClock, capability: "versions.restore" },
];

export function AdminNavigation() {
  const { label } = useLocale();
  const { pathname } = useLocation();
  const [moreOpen, setMoreOpen] = useState(false);
  const access = useAccess();
  const requests = useAccessRequests();
  const pending = requests.data?.filter((request) => request.status === "pending").length || 0;
  const { scrollArea, scrollCues } = useNavigationScrollCues(pathname);
  useEffect(() => setMoreOpen(false), [pathname]);
  const active = (href: string) => href === "/admin" ? pathname === href : pathname === href || pathname.startsWith(`${href}/`);
  const navItem = ({ href, label: key, icon: Icon, priority, badge }: NavItem) => (
    <NavigationHint label={label(key)} key={href}>
      <AppLink href={href} className={`navigation-item ${priority ? "admin-priority-item" : ""} ${active(href) ? "active" : ""}`} aria-current={active(href) ? "page" : undefined}>
        <span className="admin-nav-icon" aria-hidden="true"><Icon size={20} /><i /></span>
        <span className="navigation-item-label">{label(key)}</span>
        {badge && pending > 0 && <b className="admin-nav-badge" aria-label={`${pending} ${label("governancePending")}`}>{pending}</b>}
      </AppLink>
    </NavigationHint>
  );
  const allowed = (item: NavItem) => access.data?.capabilities.includes(item.capability) ?? false;
  const visibleOperations = operations.filter(allowed);
  const visibleInsights = insights.filter(allowed);
  const visibleSafety = safety.filter(allowed);
  const phonePrimary = [...visibleOperations.slice(0, 3), ...visibleSafety.filter((item) => item.priority)].slice(0, 4);
  const phoneMore = [...visibleInsights, ...visibleSafety.filter((item) => !item.priority), ...visibleOperations.slice(3)];
  return (
    <>
      <aside className="desktop-navigation admin-navigation" aria-label={label("adminNavigation")}>
        <SidebarToggle controls="admin-sidebar-links" />
        <AppLink href="/admin" className="admin-brand"><span className="admin-brand-orbit" aria-hidden="true"><Stethoscope size={23} /><i /></span><span><strong>{label("admin")}</strong><small>{label("adminControlRoom")}</small></span></AppLink>
        <div className="navigation-scroll-frame" data-scroll-before={scrollCues.before || undefined} data-scroll-after={scrollCues.after || undefined}>
          <div ref={scrollArea} className="navigation-scroll" id="admin-sidebar-links">
            <nav className="navigation-primary" aria-label={label("adminNavigation")}>
              <p className="navigation-label">{label("governanceOperationsGroup")}</p>
              {visibleOperations.map(navItem)}
              <p className="navigation-label admin-insights-label">{label("adminInsightsGroup")}</p>
              {visibleInsights.map(navItem)}
              <p className="navigation-label admin-safety-label">{label("governanceSafetyGroup")}</p>
              {visibleSafety.map(navItem)}
            </nav>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="admin-nav-footer"><AppearanceSettings /><div className="navigation-version"><span className="status-dot" />{label("insightsPreviewShort")}</div></div>
      </aside>
      <nav className="phone-navigation admin-phone-navigation" aria-label={label("adminMobileNavigation")}>
        {phonePrimary.map(({ href, label: key, icon: Icon }) => <AppLink href={href} key={href} className={active(href) ? "active" : ""} aria-current={active(href) ? "page" : undefined}><span className="admin-nav-icon" aria-hidden="true"><Icon size={20} /><i /></span><span>{label(key)}</span></AppLink>)}
        <button type="button" className={phoneMore.some((item) => active(item.href)) ? "active" : ""} aria-label={label("governanceMobileMore")} onClick={() => setMoreOpen(true)}><Menu size={20} /><span>{label("more")}</span>{pending > 0 && <b>{pending}</b>}</button>
      </nav>
      <Modal open={moreOpen} onClose={() => setMoreOpen(false)} title={label("governanceMobileMore")} description={label("governanceMobileMoreBody")} className="admin-mobile-menu-modal">
        <nav className="admin-mobile-more-links" aria-label={label("adminNavigation")}>
          {phoneMore.map(({ href, label: key, icon: Icon, badge }) => <AppLink key={href} href={href} onClick={() => setMoreOpen(false)} aria-current={active(href) ? "page" : undefined}><span className="admin-nav-icon"><Icon size={21} /><i /></span><span>{label(key)}</span>{badge && pending > 0 && <b>{pending}</b>}</AppLink>)}
          <AppLink className="admin-mobile-exit" href="/my/profile" onClick={() => setMoreOpen(false)}>{label("governanceBackPersonal")}</AppLink>
          <AppLink className="admin-mobile-exit" href="/" onClick={() => setMoreOpen(false)}>{label("adminBackHome")}</AppLink>
        </nav>
      </Modal>
    </>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/navigation/AliveTabs.tsx
============================================================
import type { LucideIcon } from "lucide-react";

export interface AliveTab<T extends string> {
  id: T;
  label: string;
  icon: LucideIcon;
  count?: number;
}

export function AliveTabs<T extends string>({
  label,
  items,
  value,
  onChange,
}: {
  label: string;
  items: AliveTab<T>[];
  value: T;
  onChange: (value: T) => void;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="alive-tabs" role="group" aria-label={label}>
      {items.map(({ id, label: tabLabel, icon: Icon, count }) => (
        <button
          key={id}
          aria-label={count === undefined ? tabLabel : `${tabLabel} · ${count}`}
          aria-pressed={value === id}
          onClick={() => onChange(id)}
        >
          <span className="tab-icon" aria-hidden="true">
            <Icon size={18} />
            <i />
          </span>
          <span>{tabLabel}</span>
          {count !== undefined && <b>{count}</b>}
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useWorkspacePaths } from "../../hooks/useWorkspacePaths";
import { NavigationHint } from "./NavigationHint";
import { Check, SlidersHorizontal } from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useLocation } from "react-router-dom";
import { Modal } from "../ui/Modal";
import {
  useAppearance,
  type NavigationLayout,
} from "../../app/providers/AppearanceProvider";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
export function AppearanceSettings({ compact = false }: { compact?: boolean }) {
  const paths = useWorkspacePaths();
  const { navigation, setNavigation, persisted } = useAppearance();
  const { label } = useLocale();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const location = useLocation();
  useEffect(() => setOpen(false), [location.key]);
  return (
    <>
      <NavigationHint label={label("appearance")}>
        <button
          className={
            compact
              ? "workspace-icon appearance-shortcut"
              : "navigation-preferences"
          }
          aria-label={label("appearance")}
          aria-haspopup="dialog"
          aria-expanded={open}
          onClick={() => setOpen(true)}
        >
          <SlidersHorizontal size={19} />
          {!compact && <span>{label("appearance")}</span>}
        </button>
      </NavigationHint>
      <Modal
        open={open}
        onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
        title={label("appearanceTitle")}
        description={label("appearanceDescription")}
        className="appearance-dialog"
        onAfterClose={() => {
          // Switching orientation can hide the trigger that originally opened this dialog.
          if (
            !paths.personal &&
            window.matchMedia("(min-width: 768px)").matches
          ) {
            const selector =
              navigation === "horizontal"
                ? ".workspace-header .appearance-shortcut, .admin-header .appearance-shortcut"
                : ".desktop-navigation .navigation-preferences";
            const target = document.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(selector);
            if (target) {
              target.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }
          }
        }}
      >
        <div className="appearance-heading">
          <span className="settings-symbol">
            <SlidersHorizontal size={25} />
          </span>
        </div>
        <fieldset className="layout-options">
          <legend>{label("desktopNavigation")}</legend>
          {(["vertical", "horizontal"] as NavigationLayout[]).map((layout) => (
            <label
              className={`layout-option ${navigation === layout ? "selected" : ""}`}
              key={layout}
            >
              <input
                type="radio"
                name="navigation-layout"
                value={layout}
                checked={navigation === layout}
                onChange={() => setNavigation(layout)}
              />
              <span
                className={`layout-miniature miniature-${layout}`}
                aria-hidden="true"
              >
                <i className="mini-nav">
                  <b />
                  <b />
                  <b />
                </i>
                <i className="mini-page">
                  <b />
                  <span />
                  <span />
                </i>
              </span>
              <span className="layout-option-label">
                {label(layout)}
                {navigation === layout && <Check size={17} />}
              </span>
              <small>
                {label(
                  layout === "vertical"
                    ? "verticalDescription"
                    : "horizontalDescription",
                )}
              </small>
            </label>
          ))}
        </fieldset>
        <p className="settings-note">{label("mobileNavigationNote")}</p>
        <p className="settings-saved" role="status">
          {label(persisted ? "preferencesSaved" : "sessionOnly")}
        </p>
        <button
          className="button button-primary appearance-done"
          onClick={() => setOpen(false)}
        >
          {label("done")}
          <Check size={17} />
        </button>
      </Modal>
    </>
  );
}

import { forwardRef, type AnchorHTMLAttributes } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
type Props = Omit<AnchorHTMLAttributes<HTMLAnchorElement>, "href"> & {
  href: string;
};
export const AppLink = forwardRef<HTMLAnchorElement, Props>(function AppLink(
  { href, children, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <Link ref={ref} to={href} {...props}>
      {children}
    </Link>
  );
});

FILE: src/components/navigation/DesktopNavigation.tsx

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useLocation } from "react-router-dom";
import {
  House,
  BookOpen,
  Users,
  Sparkles,
  CalendarDays,
  ShoppingBag,
  ChevronDown,
  ArrowUpRight,
  UserRound,
  Timer,
  Heart,
  HeartHandshake,
  FileCheck2,
} from "lucide-react";
import { SidebarToggle } from "./SidebarToggle";
import { NavigationHint } from "./NavigationHint";
import type { SiteContent } from "../../types/content";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { Brand } from "./Brand";
import { AppLink } from "./AppLink";
import { MegaMenu } from "./MegaMenu";
import { AppearanceSettings } from "./AppearanceSettings";
import { useAppearance } from "../../app/providers/AppearanceProvider";
import { useNavigationScrollCues } from "../../hooks/useNavigationScrollCues";
import { useAuth } from "../../app/providers/AuthProvider";
import { signInPath } from "../../constants/routes";
const icons = {
  community: Users,
  opportunities: Sparkles,
  events: CalendarDays,
  store: ShoppingBag,
  mentorship: HeartHandshake,
  contributions: FileCheck2,
};
export function DesktopNavigation({ site }: { site: SiteContent }) {
  const { label, t } = useLocale();
  const { navigation } = useAppearance();
  const auth = useAuth();
  const signedIn = auth.snapshot.status === "authenticated";
  const location = useLocation();
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false);
  const root = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
  const trigger = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const { scrollArea, scrollCues } = useNavigationScrollCues(
    `${location.pathname}:${navigation}:${expanded}`,
  );
  useEffect(() => setExpanded(false), [location.key]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const outside = (event: PointerEvent) => {
      if (!root.current?.contains(event.target as Node)) setExpanded(false);
    };
    document.addEventListener("pointerdown", outside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("pointerdown", outside);
  }, []);
  const active = (href: string) =>
    href === "/"
      ? location.pathname === "/" && !location.hash
      : href.startsWith("/#")
        ? location.pathname === "/" && location.hash === href.slice(1)
        : location.pathname.startsWith(href);
  return (
    <aside
      className="desktop-navigation"
      ref={root}
      aria-label={label("mainNavigation")}
      onKeyDown={(event) => {
        if (event.key === "Escape" && expanded) {
          setExpanded(false);
          trigger.current?.focus();
        }
      }}
      onBlur={(event) => {
        if (
          event.relatedTarget &&
          !event.currentTarget.contains(event.relatedTarget)
        )
          setExpanded(false);
      }}
    >
      <SidebarToggle controls="public-sidebar-links" />
      <div className="navigation-brand">
        <Brand brand={site.brand} />
      </div>
      <div
        className="navigation-scroll-frame"
        data-scroll-before={scrollCues.before || undefined}
        data-scroll-after={scrollCues.after || undefined}
      >
        <div
          ref={scrollArea}
          className="navigation-scroll"
          id="public-sidebar-links"
        >
          <p className="navigation-label">{label("exploreLabel")}</p>
          <nav className="navigation-primary" aria-label={label("discover")}>
            <NavigationHint label={label("home")}>
              <AppLink
                href="/"
                className={`navigation-item ${active("/") ? "active" : ""}`}
                aria-current={active("/") ? "page" : undefined}
              >
                <House size={20} />
                <span>{label("home")}</span>
              </AppLink>
            </NavigationHint>
            <div className="learn-disclosure">
              <NavigationHint label={label("learn")}>
                <button
                  ref={trigger}
                  className={`navigation-item ${active("/learn") ? "active" : ""}`}
                  aria-expanded={expanded}
                  aria-controls="learn-menu"
                  onClick={() => setExpanded((value) => !value)}
                  onKeyDown={(event) => {
                    if (event.key === "ArrowDown") {
                      event.preventDefault();
                      setExpanded(true);
                      requestAnimationFrame(() =>
                        root.current
                          ?.querySelector<HTMLAnchorElement>("#learn-menu a")
                          ?.focus(),
                      );
                    }
                  }}
                >
                  <BookOpen size={20} />
                  <span>{label("learn")}</span>
                  <ChevronDown size={15} className="disclosure-chevron" />
                </button>
              </NavigationHint>
              {expanded && navigation !== "horizontal" && (
                <MegaMenu
                  navigation={site.navigation}
                  onNavigate={() => setExpanded(false)}
                />
              )}
            </div>
            {site.navigation.main.map((item) => {
              const Icon = icons[item.id as keyof typeof icons] || Sparkles;
              return (
                <NavigationHint label={t(item.label)} key={item.id}>
                  <AppLink
                    href={item.href}
                    className={`navigation-item ${active(item.href) ? "active" : ""}`}
                    aria-current={
                      active(item.href)
                        ? item.href.startsWith("/#")
                          ? "location"
                          : "page"
                        : undefined
                    }
                  >
                    <Icon size={20} />
                    <span>{t(item.label)}</span>
                  </AppLink>
                </NavigationHint>
              );
            })}
          </nav>
          <div className="navigation-workspace">
            <p className="navigation-label">{label("workspace")}</p>
            <NavigationHint label={label(signedIn ? "myProfile" : "signIn")}>
              <AppLink
                className={`navigation-item workspace-portal-item space-portal-link ${active("/my") ? "active" : ""}`}
                href={signedIn ? "/my" : signInPath("/my")}
                aria-current={active("/my") ? "page" : undefined}
              >
                <UserRound size={20} />
                <span>{label(signedIn ? "myProfile" : "signIn")}</span>
              </AppLink>
            </NavigationHint>
            <NavigationHint label={label("studyToolsShort")}>
              <AppLink
                className={`navigation-item ${active("/utilities") ? "active" : ""}`}
                href="/utilities"
                aria-current={active("/utilities") ? "page" : undefined}
              >
                <Timer size={20} />
                <span>{label("studyToolsShort")}</span>
              </AppLink>
            </NavigationHint>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      {expanded && navigation === "horizontal" && (
        <MegaMenu
          navigation={site.navigation}
          onNavigate={() => setExpanded(false)}
        />
      )}
      <div className="navigation-bottom">
        <div className="sidebar-note">
          <span className="sidebar-note-icon">
            <Heart size={19} />
          </span>
          <p>{t(site.hero.note)}</p>
          <AppLink href="/community">
            {label("findYourPeople")}
            <ArrowUpRight size={18} className="directional" />
          </AppLink>
        </div>
        <AppearanceSettings />
        <div className="navigation-version">
          <span className="status-dot" />
          {label("previewShort")}
        </div>
      </div>
    </aside>
  );
}

import { Heart } from "lucide-react";

export function Footer({ site }: { site: SiteContent }) {

  return (
    <footer className="footer">
      <div className="container">
        <div className="footer-top">
          <div className="footer-brand">
            <Brand brand={site.brand} />

FILE: src/components/navigation/MobileNavigation.tsx
============================================================
import { Menu } from "lucide-react";
import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useLocation } from "react-router-dom";
import { Modal } from "../ui/Modal";
import type { SiteContent } from "../../types/content";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { AppLink } from "./AppLink";
import { useAuth } from "../../app/providers/AuthProvider";
import { signInPath } from "../../constants/routes";
export function MobileNavigation({ site }: { site: SiteContent }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const { label, t } = useLocale();
  const location = useLocation();
  const auth = useAuth();
  const signedIn = auth.snapshot.status === "authenticated";
  const secondaryActive = [
    "/events",
    "/opportunities",
    "/community",
    "/journal",
    "/mentorship",
    "/contribute",
    "/recruitment",
    "/store",
    "/utilities",
  ].some((path) => location.pathname.startsWith(path));
  useEffect(() => setOpen(false), [location.key]);
  return (
    <>
      <button
        className={`icon-button mobile-menu ${secondaryActive ? "active" : ""}`}
        aria-current={secondaryActive ? "page" : undefined}
        aria-label={label("menu")}
        aria-haspopup="dialog"
        aria-expanded={open}
        onClick={() => setOpen(true)}
      >
        <Menu size={21} />
        <span>{label("more")}</span>
      </button>
      <Modal
        open={open}
        onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
        title={label("menuTitle")}
        description={label("menuDescription")}
        className="mobile-menu-dialog"
      >
        <nav className="mobile-nav-list" aria-label={label("menuTitle")}>
          <AppLink href="/" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
            {label("home")}
          </AppLink>
          <AppLink href="/learn" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
            {label("learn")}
          </AppLink>
          {[
            ...site.navigation.academic,
            ...site.navigation.main,
            ...site.navigation.tools,
          ].map((item) => (
            <AppLink
              key={item.id}
              href={item.href}
              onClick={() => setOpen(false)}
            >
              {t(item.label)}
            </AppLink>
          ))}
          <AppLink href="/journal" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
            {label("journal")}
          </AppLink>
          <AppLink
            href={signedIn ? "/my" : signInPath("/my")}
            onClick={() => setOpen(false)}
          >
            {label(signedIn ? "myProfile" : "signIn")}
          </AppLink>
        </nav>
      </Modal>
    </>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/navigation/NavigationHint.tsx
============================================================
import { useState, type ReactElement } from "react";
import { useAppearance } from "../../app/providers/AppearanceProvider";
import { Tooltip, TooltipTrigger, TooltipContent } from "../ui/tooltip";
/** Keep icon-only navigation named for keyboard and pointer users. */
export function NavigationHint({
  label,
  children,
}: {
  label: string;
  children: ReactElement;
}) {
  const { sidebarCollapsed, navigation } = useAppearance();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  return (
    <Tooltip
      open={sidebarCollapsed && navigation === "vertical" && open}
      onOpenChange={setOpen}
    >
      <TooltipTrigger asChild>{children}</TooltipTrigger>
      <TooltipContent side="right" sideOffset={17}>
        {label}
      </TooltipContent>
    </Tooltip>
  );
}

  const canOpenAdmin = access.data?.capabilities.includes("admin.access") ?? false;

  const phoneMore = items.filter((item) => !phonePrimaryHrefs.has(item.href));

  useEffect(() => setMoreOpen(false), [pathname]);
  const active = (href: string) =>

          className="navigation-scroll-frame"
          data-scroll-before={scrollCues.before || undefined}
          data-scroll-after={scrollCues.after || undefined}

            ref={scrollArea}

            id="personal-sidebar-links"
          >
            <p className="navigation-label">{label("workspace")}</p>

              className="navigation-primary"
              aria-label={label("personalNavigation")}

FILE: src/components/navigation/SidebarToggle.tsx
============================================================
import { PanelLeftClose, PanelLeftOpen } from "lucide-react";
import { useAppearance } from "../../app/providers/AppearanceProvider";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
export function SidebarToggle({ controls }: { controls: string }) {
  const { sidebarCollapsed, setSidebarCollapsed } = useAppearance();
  const { label } = useLocale();
  const title = label(sidebarCollapsed ? "expandSidebar" : "collapseSidebar");
  return (
    <button
      className="sidebar-toggle"
      type="button"
      onClick={() => setSidebarCollapsed(!sidebarCollapsed)}
      aria-expanded={!sidebarCollapsed}
      aria-controls={controls}
      aria-label={title}
      title={title}
    >
      {sidebarCollapsed ? (
        <PanelLeftOpen size={17} />
      ) : (
        <PanelLeftClose size={17} />
      )}
    </button>
  );
}

          label: label("cart"),
          icon: ShoppingCart,
          count: cartQuantity(store.cart),
        },
        {
          id: "/my/orders",
          label: label("myOrders"),
          icon: PackageCheck,
          count: store.orders.filter((order) => order.status !== "cancelled")
            .length,
        },
      ]}
      value={value}
      onChange={navigate}
    />
  );
}

export function ActionLink({
  href,
  children,
  variant = "primary",
}: {
  href: string;
  children: ReactNode;
  variant?: "primary" | "outline";
}) {
  return (
    <Button
      asChild
      className={`button button-${variant}`}
      variant={variant === "primary" ? "default" : "outline"}
    >
      <AppLink href={href}>{children}</AppLink>
    </Button>
  );
}

import * as React from "react";
import { cva, type VariantProps } from "class-variance-authority";
import { Slot } from "radix-ui";

import { cn } from "../../lib/utils";

const badgeVariants = cva(
  "inline-flex w-fit shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1 overflow-hidden rounded-full border border-transparent px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium whitespace-nowrap transition-[color,box-shadow] focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-[3px] focus-visible:ring-ring/50 aria-invalid:border-destructive aria-invalid:ring-destructive/20 dark:aria-invalid:ring-destructive/40 [&>svg]:pointer-events-none [&>svg]:size-3",
  {
    variants: {
      variant: {
        default: "bg-primary text-primary-foreground [a&]:hover:bg-primary/90",
        secondary:
          "bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground [a&]:hover:bg-secondary/90",
        destructive:
          "bg-destructive text-white focus-visible:ring-destructive/20 dark:bg-destructive/60 dark:focus-visible:ring-destructive/40 [a&]:hover:bg-destructive/90",
        outline:
          "border-border text-foreground [a&]:hover:bg-accent [a&]:hover:text-accent-foreground",
        ghost: "[a&]:hover:bg-accent [a&]:hover:text-accent-foreground",
        link: "text-primary underline-offset-4 [a&]:hover:underline",
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: {
      variant: "default",
    },
  },
);

function Badge({
  className,
  variant = "default",
  asChild = false,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"span"> &
  VariantProps<typeof badgeVariants> & { asChild?: boolean }) {
  const Comp = asChild ? Slot.Root : "span";

  return (
    <Comp
      data-slot="badge"
      data-variant={variant}
      className={cn(badgeVariants({ variant }), className)}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}

export { Badge, badgeVariants };

import * as React from "react";
import { cva, type VariantProps } from "class-variance-authority";
import { Slot } from "radix-ui";

import { cn } from "../../lib/utils";

const buttonVariants = cva(
  "inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap transition-all outline-none focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-[3px] focus-visible:ring-ring/50 disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 aria-invalid:border-destructive aria-invalid:ring-destructive/20 dark:aria-invalid:ring-destructive/40 [&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:shrink-0 [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-4",
  {
    variants: {
      variant: {
        default: "bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90",
        destructive:
          "bg-destructive text-white hover:bg-destructive/90 focus-visible:ring-destructive/20 dark:bg-destructive/60 dark:focus-visible:ring-destructive/40",
        outline:
          "border bg-background shadow-xs hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground dark:border-input dark:bg-input/30 dark:hover:bg-input/50",
        secondary:
          "bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/80",
        ghost:
          "hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground dark:hover:bg-accent/50",
        link: "text-primary underline-offset-4 hover:underline",
      },
      size: {
        default: "h-9 px-4 py-2 has-[>svg]:px-3",
        xs: "h-6 gap-1 rounded-md px-2 text-xs has-[>svg]:px-1.5 [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-3",
        sm: "h-8 gap-1.5 rounded-md px-3 has-[>svg]:px-2.5",
        lg: "h-10 rounded-md px-6 has-[>svg]:px-4",
        icon: "size-9",
        "icon-xs": "size-6 rounded-md [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-3",
        "icon-sm": "size-8",
        "icon-lg": "size-10",
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: {
      variant: "default",
      size: "default",
    },
  },
);

function Button({
  className,
  variant = "default",
  size = "default",
  asChild = false,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"button"> &
  VariantProps<typeof buttonVariants> & {
    asChild?: boolean;
  }) {
  const Comp = asChild ? Slot.Root : "button";

  return (
    <Comp
      data-slot="button"
      data-variant={variant}
      data-size={size}
      className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant, size, className }))}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}

export { Button, buttonVariants };

"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { XIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { Dialog as DialogPrimitive } from "radix-ui";

import { cn } from "../../lib/utils";
import { Button } from "./button";

function Dialog({
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof DialogPrimitive.Root>) {
  return <DialogPrimitive.Root data-slot="dialog" {...props} />;
}

function DialogTrigger({
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof DialogPrimitive.Trigger>) {
  return <DialogPrimitive.Trigger data-slot="dialog-trigger" {...props} />;
}

function DialogPortal({
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof DialogPrimitive.Portal>) {
  return <DialogPrimitive.Portal data-slot="dialog-portal" {...props} />;
}

function DialogClose({
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof DialogPrimitive.Close>) {
  return <DialogPrimitive.Close data-slot="dialog-close" {...props} />;
}

function DialogOverlay({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof DialogPrimitive.Overlay>) {
  return (
    <DialogPrimitive.Overlay
      data-slot="dialog-overlay"
      className={cn(
        "fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/50 data-[state=closed]:animate-out data-[state=closed]:fade-out-0 data-[state=open]:animate-in data-[state=open]:fade-in-0",
        className,
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}

function DialogContent({
  className,
  children,
  showCloseButton = true,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof DialogPrimitive.Content> & {
  showCloseButton?: boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <DialogPortal data-slot="dialog-portal">
      <DialogOverlay />
      <DialogPrimitive.Content
        data-slot="dialog-content"
        className={cn(
          "fixed top-[50%] left-[50%] z-50 grid w-full max-w-[calc(100%-2rem)] translate-x-[-50%] translate-y-[-50%] gap-4 rounded-lg border bg-background p-6 shadow-lg duration-200 outline-none data-[state=closed]:animate-out data-[state=closed]:fade-out-0 data-[state=closed]:zoom-out-95 data-[state=open]:animate-in data-[state=open]:fade-in-0 data-[state=open]:zoom-in-95 sm:max-w-lg",
          className,
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        {children}
        {showCloseButton && (
          <DialogPrimitive.Close
            data-slot="dialog-close"
            className="absolute top-4 right-4 rounded-xs opacity-70 ring-offset-background transition-opacity hover:opacity-100 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-ring focus:ring-offset-2 focus:outline-hidden disabled:pointer-events-none data-[state=open]:bg-accent data-[state=open]:text-muted-foreground [&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:shrink-0 [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-4"
          >
            <XIcon />
            <span className="sr-only">Close</span>
          </DialogPrimitive.Close>
        )}
      </DialogPrimitive.Content>
    </DialogPortal>
  );
}

function DialogHeader({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"div">) {
  return (
    <div
      data-slot="dialog-header"
      className={cn("flex flex-col gap-2 text-center sm:text-left", className)}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}

function DialogFooter({
  className,
  showCloseButton = false,
  children,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
  showCloseButton?: boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <div
      data-slot="dialog-footer"
      className={cn(
        "flex flex-col-reverse gap-2 sm:flex-row sm:justify-end",
        className,
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      {children}
      {showCloseButton && (
        <DialogPrimitive.Close asChild>
          <Button variant="outline">Close</Button>
        </DialogPrimitive.Close>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function DialogTitle({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof DialogPrimitive.Title>) {
  return (
    <DialogPrimitive.Title
      data-slot="dialog-title"
      className={cn("text-lg leading-none font-semibold", className)}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}

function DialogDescription({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof DialogPrimitive.Description>) {
  return (
    <DialogPrimitive.Description
      data-slot="dialog-description"
      className={cn("text-sm text-muted-foreground", className)}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}

export {
  Dialog,
  DialogClose,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogOverlay,
  DialogPortal,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogTrigger,
};

FILE: src/components/ui/Modal.tsx
============================================================
import { useId, useLayoutEffect, useRef, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { createPortal } from "react-dom";
import { X } from "lucide-react";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
export function Modal({
  open,
  onClose,
  title,
  description,
  children,
  className = "",
  hideHeading = false,
  onAfterClose,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  children: ReactNode;
  className?: string;
  hideHeading?: boolean;
  onAfterClose?: () => void;
}) {
  const { dir, label } = useLocale();
  const dialog = useRef<HTMLDialogElement>(null);
  const afterClose = useRef(onAfterClose);
  afterClose.current = onAfterClose;
  const titleId = useId(),
    descriptionId = useId();
  // Native modality moves focus and makes the background inert atomically.
  // Never aria-hide the shell or restore focus before the dialog has closed.
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const node = dialog.current;
    if (!open || !node) return;
    node.showModal();
    const overflow = document.body.style.overflow;
    document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
    return () => {
      node.close();
      document.body.style.overflow = overflow;
      afterClose.current?.();
    };
  }, [open]);
  return createPortal(
    <dialog
      ref={dialog}
      dir={dir}
      className={`medclub-modal medclub-native-modal ${className}`}
      aria-labelledby={titleId}
      aria-describedby={descriptionId}
      onCancel={(event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        onClose();
      }}
      onClick={(event) => {
        if (event.target !== event.currentTarget) return;
        const r = event.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (
          event.clientX < r.left ||
          event.clientX > r.right ||
          event.clientY < r.top ||
          event.clientY > r.bottom
        )
          onClose();
      }}
    >
      <div className={hideHeading ? "sr-only" : "modal-heading"}>
        <h2 id={titleId} data-slot="dialog-title">
          {title}
        </h2>
        <p id={descriptionId} data-slot="dialog-description">
          {description}
        </p>
      </div>
      {open && children}
      <button
        type="button"
        className="modal-close"
        aria-label={label("close")}
        onClick={onClose}
      >
        <X size={19} />
      </button>
    </dialog>,
    document.body,
  );
}

        "group-data-[variant=line]/tabs-list:bg-transparent group-data-[variant=line]/tabs-list:data-[state=active]:bg-transparent dark:group-data-[variant=line]/tabs-list:data-[state=active]:border-transparent dark:group-data-[variant=line]/tabs-list:data-[state=active]:bg-transparent",
        "data-[state=active]:bg-background data-[state=active]:text-foreground dark:data-[state=active]:border-input dark:data-[state=active]:bg-input/30 dark:data-[state=active]:text-foreground",

        className,
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}

function TabsContent({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof TabsPrimitive.Content>) {
  return (
    <TabsPrimitive.Content
      data-slot="tabs-content"
      className={cn("flex-1 outline-none", className)}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}

export { Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger, TabsContent, tabsListVariants };

"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { Tooltip as TooltipPrimitive } from "radix-ui";

import { cn } from "../../lib/utils";

function TooltipProvider({
  delayDuration = 0,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof TooltipPrimitive.Provider>) {
  return (
    <TooltipPrimitive.Provider
      data-slot="tooltip-provider"
      delayDuration={delayDuration}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}

function Tooltip({
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof TooltipPrimitive.Root>) {
  return <TooltipPrimitive.Root data-slot="tooltip" {...props} />;
}

function TooltipTrigger({
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof TooltipPrimitive.Trigger>) {
  return <TooltipPrimitive.Trigger data-slot="tooltip-trigger" {...props} />;
}

function TooltipContent({
  className,
  sideOffset = 0,
  children,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof TooltipPrimitive.Content>) {
  return (
    <TooltipPrimitive.Portal>
      <TooltipPrimitive.Content
        data-slot="tooltip-content"
        sideOffset={sideOffset}
        className={cn(
          "z-50 w-fit origin-(--radix-tooltip-content-transform-origin) animate-in rounded-md bg-foreground px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-balance text-background fade-in-0 zoom-in-95 data-[side=bottom]:slide-in-from-top-2 data-[side=left]:slide-in-from-right-2 data-[side=right]:slide-in-from-left-2 data-[side=top]:slide-in-from-bottom-2 data-[state=closed]:animate-out data-[state=closed]:fade-out-0 data-[state=closed]:zoom-out-95",
          className,
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        {children}
        <TooltipPrimitive.Arrow className="z-50 size-2.5 translate-y-[calc(-50%_-_2px)] rotate-45 rounded-[2px] bg-foreground fill-foreground" />
      </TooltipPrimitive.Content>
    </TooltipPrimitive.Portal>
  );
}

FILE: src/features/academics/BatchPage.tsx

import type { CSSProperties } from "react";
import {
  ArrowUpRight,
  Archive,
  BookOpen,
  CalendarDays,
  GraduationCap,
} from "lucide-react";
import { Navigate, useParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { useBatches, useCourses } from "../../hooks/useContent";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { batchPath, routes } from "../../constants/routes";
import { AppLink } from "../../components/navigation/AppLink";
import { CourseCard } from "../../components/cards/CourseCard";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { EmptyState } from "../../components/feedback/EmptyState";

export default function BatchPage({ view }: { view: "current" | "archive" }) {
  const { batchSlug } = useParams();
  const batches = useBatches(),
    courses = useCourses();
  const { t, label } = useLocale();
  if (batches.isPending || courses.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (batches.isError || courses.isError)
    return (
      <ErrorState
        retry={() => {
          void batches.refetch();
          void courses.refetch();
        }}
      />
    );
  const batch = batches.data.find((item) => item.slug === batchSlug);
  if (!batch)
    return (
      <EmptyState
        title={label("notFound")}
        description={label("notFoundBody")}
        href={routes.basic}
      />
    );
  const current = batch.terms.find((term) => term.current);
  if (view === "current" && !current)
    return <Navigate to={batchPath(batch.slug, "archive")} replace />;
  return (
    <div className={`container batch-page batch-page-${batch.accent}`}>
      <header className="batch-identity-card">
        <div className="batch-identity-copy">
          <span className="academic-kicker">{t(batch.classLabel)}</span>
          <h1 data-page-heading tabIndex={-1}>
            {t(batch.name)}
          </h1>
          <strong>{t(batch.tagline)}</strong>
          <p>{t(batch.description)}</p>
        </div>
        <div
          className="batch-progress-seal"
          style={
            { "--progress": `${batch.progress * 3.6}deg` } as CSSProperties
          }
        >
          <span>
            <b>{batch.progress}%</b>
            {label("journeyComplete")}
          </span>
        </div>
        <dl className="batch-meta">
          <div>
            <dt>
              <GraduationCap size={16} />
              {label("graduation")}
            </dt>
            <dd>{batch.graduationYear}</dd>
          </div>
          <div>
            <dt>
              <BookOpen size={16} />
              {label("yearNumber")}
            </dt>
            <dd>{batch.studyYear}</dd>
          </div>
          <div>
            <dt>
              <CalendarDays size={16} />
              {label("semester")}
            </dt>
            <dd>{current?.semester ?? "—"}</dd>
          </div>
        </dl>
      </header>
      <nav className="batch-view-switch" aria-label={label("choosePath")}>
        <AppLink
          href={batchPath(batch.slug)}
          aria-current={view === "current" ? "page" : undefined}
        >
          <BookOpen size={17} />
          {label("currentSemester")}
        </AppLink>
        <AppLink
          href={batchPath(batch.slug, "archive")}
          aria-current={view === "archive" ? "page" : undefined}
        >
          <Archive size={17} />
          {label("archive")}
        </AppLink>
      </nav>
      {view === "current" && current ? (
        <section className="term-section">
          <div className="academic-section-heading">
            <span>{String(current.semester).padStart(2, "0")}</span>
            <div>
              <small>{current.academicYear}</small>
              <h2>{t(current.label)}</h2>
            </div>
            <i />
          </div>
          <div className="course-grid academic-course-grid">
            {current.courseIds
              .map((id) => courses.data.find((course) => course.id === id))
              .filter(Boolean)
              .map((course) => (
                <CourseCard course={course!} key={course!.id} />
              ))}
          </div>
        </section>
      ) : (
        <section className="archive-section">
          <div className="academic-section-heading">
            <span>
              <Archive size={20} />
            </span>
            <h2>{label("archivedTerms")}</h2>
            <i />
          </div>
          {batch.terms.filter((term) => !term.current).length ? (
            batch.terms
              .filter((term) => !term.current)
              .map((term) => (
                <details className="archive-term" key={term.id}>
                  <summary>
                    <span>
                      <small>
                        {term.academicYear} · {label("semester")}{" "}
                        {term.semester}
                      </small>
                      <b>{t(term.label)}</b>
                    </span>
                    <span>
                      {term.courseIds.length} {label("coursesCount")}
                      <ArrowUpRight size={18} />
                    </span>
                  </summary>
                  <div className="course-grid academic-course-grid">
                    {term.courseIds
                      .map((id) =>
                        courses.data.find((course) => course.id === id),
                      )
                      .filter(Boolean)
                      .map((course) => (
                        <CourseCard course={course!} key={course!.id} />
                      ))}
                  </div>
                </details>
              ))
          ) : (
            <EmptyState description={label("noArchive")} />
          )}
        </section>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
