FILE: src/features/academics/CatalogPage.tsx
============================================================
import { useState } from "react";
import type { Track } from "../../types/content";
import { useCourses } from "../../hooks/useContent";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { PageIntro } from "../../components/data-display/PageIntro";
import { CourseCard } from "../../components/cards/CourseCard";
import { SearchInput } from "../../components/forms/SearchInput";
import {
  Tabs,
  TabsList,
  TabsTrigger,
  TabsContent,
} from "../../components/ui/tabs";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { EmptyState } from "../../components/feedback/EmptyState";
export default function CatalogPage({ track }: { track?: Track }) {
  const query = useCourses();
  const { label, dir } = useLocale();
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState("all");
  if (query.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (query.isError) return <ErrorState retry={() => void query.refetch()} />;
  const records = query.data.filter(
    (c) =>
      (!track || c.track === track) &&
      (filter === "all" || c.track === filter) &&
      [c.title.en, c.title.ar, c.batch.en, c.batch.ar, c.code]
        .join(" ")
        .toLowerCase()
        .includes(search.toLowerCase()),
  );
  return (
    <div className="container">
      <PageIntro
        eyebrow={label("learnEyebrow")}
        title={label(track || "learnTitle")}
        description={label("learnBody")}
      />
      <Tabs value={filter} onValueChange={setFilter} dir={dir}>
        <div className="catalog-controls">
          <TabsList className="filter-tabs" aria-label={label("course")}>
            {(track ? ["all"] : ["all", "basic", "clinical"]).map((value) => (
              <TabsTrigger value={value} key={value}>
                {label(value === "all" ? "allCourses" : (value as Track))}
              </TabsTrigger>
            ))}
          </TabsList>
          <SearchInput
            value={search}
            onChange={setSearch}
            label={label("courseSearch")}
          />
        </div>
        {["all", "basic", "clinical"].map((value) => (
          <TabsContent key={value} value={value}>
            <div className="course-grid">
              {records.map((course) => (
                <CourseCard key={course.id} course={course} />
              ))}
              {!records.length && (
                <EmptyState
                  title={label("emptyCourses")}
                  description={label("emptyCoursesBody")}
                />
              )}
            </div>
          </TabsContent>
        ))}
      </Tabs>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState } from "react";
import { useCourses, useStudentProfile } from "../../hooks/useContent";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { PageIntro } from "../../components/data-display/PageIntro";
import { SearchInput } from "../../components/forms/SearchInput";
import { CourseCard } from "../../components/cards/CourseCard";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { EmptyState } from "../../components/feedback/EmptyState";
export default function MyLearningPage() {
  const courses = useCourses(),
    profile = useStudentProfile();
  const { label } = useLocale();
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  if (courses.isPending || profile.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (courses.isError || profile.isError)
    return (
      <ErrorState
        retry={() => {
          void courses.refetch();
          void profile.refetch();
        }}
      />
    );
  const selected = courses.data.filter(
    (c) =>
      profile.data.courseIds.includes(c.id) &&
      [c.title.en, c.title.ar, c.code]
        .join(" ")
        .toLowerCase()
        .includes(search.toLowerCase()),
  );
  return (
    <div className="container">
      <PageIntro
        title={label("myLearning")}
        eyebrow={label("yourOwnPace")}
        description={label("myLearningBody")}
      />
      <SearchInput
        value={search}
        onChange={setSearch}
        label={label("findMyCourse")}
      />
      <div className="course-grid personal-learning-grid">
        {selected.map((course) => (
          <CourseCard course={course} key={course.id} />
        ))}
        {selected.length === 0 && (
          <EmptyState
            title={label("emptyCourses")}
            description={label("myCoursesEmpty")}
          />
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { CheckCircle2, LogOut } from "lucide-react";
import { useNavigate, useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { useAuth } from "../../app/providers/AuthProvider";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { Button } from "../../components/ui/button";
import { safeReturnTo } from "../../lib/auth";

export function AuthenticatedState() {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const { label } = useLocale();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [search] = useSearchParams();
  const returnTo = safeReturnTo(search.get("returnTo"));
  const user = auth.snapshot.user;
  if (!user) return null;
  return (
    <section className="auth-panel auth-success-panel">
      <span className="auth-success-icon" aria-hidden="true">
        <CheckCircle2 />
      </span>
      <p className="auth-eyebrow">{label("verifiedAccount")}</p>
      <h2>{label("continueToMyMedClub")}</h2>
      <p>
        {label("signedInAs")} <strong>{user.email}</strong>
      </p>
      <div className="auth-action-stack">
        <Button
          type="button"
          className="button button-primary auth-submit"
          onClick={() => navigate(returnTo)}
        >
          {label("continueToMyMedClub")}
        </Button>
        <Button
          type="button"
          variant="ghost"
          className="auth-quiet-action"
          onClick={() => void auth.signOut()}
        >
          <LogOut />
          {label("signOut")}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";

const vertexShader = `
  attribute vec3 aPosition;
  attribute float aSeed;
  uniform float uTime;
  uniform vec2 uPointer;
  uniform float uAspect;
  varying float vSeed;
  varying float vDepth;

  mat2 rotate2d(float angle) {
    float s = sin(angle);
    float c = cos(angle);
    return mat2(c, -s, s, c);
  }

  void main() {
    vec3 point = aPosition;
    float drift = uTime * (0.08 + aSeed * 0.05);
    point.xz = rotate2d(drift + uPointer.x * 0.34) * point.xz;
    point.yz = rotate2d(uPointer.y * 0.2) * point.yz;
    point.x += sin(uTime * 0.35 + aSeed * 18.0) * 0.08;
    float depth = max(2.4, 7.4 - point.z);
    vec2 projected = point.xy / depth * 3.1;
    gl_Position = vec4(projected.x / uAspect, projected.y, 0.0, 1.0);
    gl_PointSize = (2.2 + aSeed * 4.8) * (7.0 / depth);
    vSeed = aSeed;
    vDepth = clamp(1.0 - depth / 10.0, 0.0, 1.0);
  }
`;

const fragmentShader = `
  precision mediump float;
  varying float vSeed;
  varying float vDepth;

  void main() {
    vec2 center = gl_PointCoord - vec2(0.5);
    float distanceToCenter = length(center);
    if (distanceToCenter > 0.5) discard;
    float halo = smoothstep(0.5, 0.04, distanceToCenter);
    vec3 red = vec3(0.98, 0.24, 0.24);
    vec3 coral = vec3(1.0, 0.62, 0.4);
    vec3 pearl = vec3(1.0, 0.92, 0.82);
    vec3 color = mix(red, coral, vSeed);
    color = mix(color, pearl, vDepth * 0.48);
    gl_FragColor = vec4(color, halo * (0.24 + vDepth * 0.76));
  }
`;

function compile(gl: WebGLRenderingContext, type: number, source: string) {
  const shader = gl.createShader(type);
  if (!shader) return null;
  gl.shaderSource(shader, source);
  gl.compileShader(shader);
  if (!gl.getShaderParameter(shader, gl.COMPILE_STATUS)) {
    gl.deleteShader(shader);
    return null;
  }
  return shader;
}

function createParticleData() {
  const points: number[] = [];
  const seeds: number[] = [];
  let randomState = 8608;
  const random = () => {
    randomState = (randomState * 16807) % 2147483647;
    return (randomState - 1) / 2147483646;
  };

  for (let strand = 0; strand < 2; strand += 1) {
    for (let index = 0; index < 420; index += 1) {
      const progress = index / 419;
      const angle = progress * Math.PI * 8 + strand * Math.PI;
      const radius = 1.32 + Math.sin(progress * Math.PI * 5) * 0.11;
      points.push(
        Math.cos(angle) * radius,
        (progress - 0.5) * 6.4,
        Math.sin(angle) * radius,
      );
      seeds.push(strand ? 0.78 : 0.28);
    }
  }

  for (let index = 0; index < 520; index += 1) {
    const angle = random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const radius = 1.9 + random() * 3.3;
    points.push(
      Math.cos(angle) * radius,
      (random() - 0.5) * 7.8,
      Math.sin(angle) * radius,
    );
    seeds.push(random());
  }

  return {
    positions: new Float32Array(points),
    seeds: new Float32Array(seeds),
    count: seeds.length,
  };
}

export function MedicalFieldCanvas() {
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
  const [available, setAvailable] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    if (typeof WebGLRenderingContext === "undefined") {
      setAvailable(false);
      return;
    }
    let gl: WebGLRenderingContext | null = null;
    try {
      gl = canvas.getContext("webgl", {
        alpha: true,
        antialias: false,
        powerPreference: "high-performance",
      });
    } catch {
      gl = null;
    }
    if (!gl) {
      setAvailable(false);
      return;
    }

    const vertex = compile(gl, gl.VERTEX_SHADER, vertexShader);
    const fragment = compile(gl, gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER, fragmentShader);
    if (!vertex || !fragment) {
      setAvailable(false);
      return;
    }
    const program = gl.createProgram();
    if (!program) return;
    gl.attachShader(program, vertex);
    gl.attachShader(program, fragment);
    gl.linkProgram(program);
    if (!gl.getProgramParameter(program, gl.LINK_STATUS)) {
      setAvailable(false);
      return;
    }

    const particles = createParticleData();
    const positionBuffer = gl.createBuffer();
    const seedBuffer = gl.createBuffer();
    const positionLocation = gl.getAttribLocation(program, "aPosition");
    const seedLocation = gl.getAttribLocation(program, "aSeed");
    const timeLocation = gl.getUniformLocation(program, "uTime");
    const pointerLocation = gl.getUniformLocation(program, "uPointer");
    const aspectLocation = gl.getUniformLocation(program, "uAspect");
    const pointer = { x: 0, y: 0 };
    const target = { x: 0, y: 0 };
    const reduced = window.matchMedia(
      "(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)",
    ).matches;
    let visible = true;
    let animationFrame = 0;

    gl.useProgram(program);
    gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, positionBuffer);
    gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, particles.positions, gl.STATIC_DRAW);
    gl.enableVertexAttribArray(positionLocation);
    gl.vertexAttribPointer(positionLocation, 3, gl.FLOAT, false, 0, 0);
    gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, seedBuffer);
    gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, particles.seeds, gl.STATIC_DRAW);
    gl.enableVertexAttribArray(seedLocation);
    gl.vertexAttribPointer(seedLocation, 1, gl.FLOAT, false, 0, 0);
    gl.enable(gl.BLEND);
    gl.blendFunc(gl.SRC_ALPHA, gl.ONE);
    gl.clearColor(0, 0, 0, 0);

    const resize = () => {
      const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      const ratio = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 1.75);
      canvas.width = Math.max(1, Math.floor(bounds.width * ratio));
      canvas.height = Math.max(1, Math.floor(bounds.height * ratio));
      gl.viewport(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    };
    const onPointerMove = (event: PointerEvent) => {
      const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      target.x = ((event.clientX - bounds.left) / bounds.width - 0.5) * 2;
      target.y = ((event.clientY - bounds.top) / bounds.height - 0.5) * -2;
    };
    const render = (timestamp: number) => {
      pointer.x += (target.x - pointer.x) * 0.04;
      pointer.y += (target.y - pointer.y) * 0.04;
      gl.clear(gl.COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);
      gl.uniform1f(timeLocation, reduced ? 0 : timestamp / 1000);
      gl.uniform2f(pointerLocation, pointer.x, pointer.y);
      gl.uniform1f(aspectLocation, canvas.width / canvas.height);
      gl.drawArrays(gl.POINTS, 0, particles.count);
      if (!reduced && visible) animationFrame = requestAnimationFrame(render);
    };
    const observer =
      typeof IntersectionObserver === "undefined"
        ? null
        : new IntersectionObserver(([entry]) => {
            visible = entry?.isIntersecting ?? true;
            if (visible && !reduced) {
              cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrame);
              animationFrame = requestAnimationFrame(render);
            }
          });
    const resizeObserver =
      typeof ResizeObserver === "undefined"
        ? null
        : new ResizeObserver(() => {
            resize();
            if (reduced) render(0);
          });

    resize();
    resizeObserver?.observe(canvas);
    observer?.observe(canvas);
    if (!resizeObserver) window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
    if (!reduced) canvas.addEventListener("pointermove", onPointerMove);
    render(0);

    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrame);
      resizeObserver?.disconnect();
      observer?.disconnect();
      window.removeEventListener("resize", resize);
      canvas.removeEventListener("pointermove", onPointerMove);
      gl.deleteBuffer(positionBuffer);
      gl.deleteBuffer(seedBuffer);
      gl.deleteProgram(program);
      gl.deleteShader(vertex);
      gl.deleteShader(fragment);
    };
  }, []);

  return (
    <canvas
      ref={canvasRef}
      className="auth-medical-field"
      data-webgl={available ? "active" : "fallback"}
      aria-hidden="true"
    />
  );
}

FILE: src/features/auth/README.md
============================================================
# Authentication feature — V0.8

This feature contains the dedicated account experience:

- sign in with safe return-to routing;
- registration and preview email verification;
- non-enumerating recovery state;
- WebGL medical identity field and static fallback;
- already-authenticated handling.

State is provided by `app/providers/AuthProvider.tsx` through the `AuthService` contract. `services/local-auth.service.ts` is a browser-local demonstration adapter. It must be replaced before real student accounts or private data are introduced.

Production requirements include server-issued secure sessions, email ownership verification, expiring recovery tokens, rate limits, lockouts, CSRF defenses, server-side role/capability enforcement, audit records and privacy/account-lifecycle decisions.

import { useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { CheckCircle2, RotateCcwKey } from "lucide-react";
import { useAuth } from "../../app/providers/AuthProvider";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { AppLink } from "../../components/navigation/AppLink";
import { Button } from "../../components/ui/button";
import { routes } from "../../constants/routes";

export default function RecoverPage() {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const { label } = useLocale();
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [sent, setSent] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const submit = async (event: FormEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    if (!/^\S+@\S+\.\S+$/.test(email)) {
      setError(label("emailInvalid"));
      return;
    }
    await auth.requestPasswordReset(email);
    setSent(true);
  };

  return (
    <section className="auth-panel">
      <div className="auth-panel-heading">
        <p className="auth-eyebrow">
          <RotateCcwKey />
          {label("forgotPassword")}
        </p>
        <h2>{label("recoverTitle")}</h2>
        <p>{label("recoverBody")}</p>
      </div>
      {sent ? (
        <div className="auth-recovery-result" role="status">
          <CheckCircle2 />
          <p>{label("recoverySent")}</p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <form className="auth-form" onSubmit={submit} noValidate>
          <label className="auth-field" htmlFor="recover-email">
            <span>{label("email")}</span>
            <input
              id="recover-email"
              type="email"
              autoComplete="email"
              value={email}
              onChange={(event) => setEmail(event.target.value)}
            />
          </label>
          {error && (
            <p className="auth-form-error" role="alert">
              {error}
            </p>
          )}
          <Button
            type="submit"
            disabled={auth.isPending}
            className="button button-primary auth-submit"
          >
            {label("sendRecovery")}
          </Button>
        </form>
      )}
      <p className="auth-switch">
        <AppLink href={routes.signIn}>{label("backToSignIn")}</AppLink>
      </p>
      <div className="auth-boundary-note">
        <strong>{label("authPreview")}</strong>
        <span>{label("authPreviewBody")}</span>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

FILE: src/features/auth/RegisterPage.tsx

import { useMemo, useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { Eye, EyeOff, UserRoundPlus } from "lucide-react";
import { useNavigate, useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { useAuth } from "../../app/providers/AuthProvider";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { AppLink } from "../../components/navigation/AppLink";
import { Button } from "../../components/ui/button";
import { authErrorKey, safeReturnTo } from "../../lib/auth";
import { routes } from "../../constants/routes";
import { AuthenticatedState } from "./AuthenticatedState";

export default function RegisterPage() {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const { label } = useLocale();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [search] = useSearchParams();
  const returnTo = safeReturnTo(search.get("returnTo"));
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    fullName: "",
    email: "",
    batch: "Shifaa",
    year: 3,
    password: "",
    confirm: "",
  });
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const passwordReady = useMemo(
    () =>
      form.password.length >= 8 &&
      /[A-Za-z]/.test(form.password) &&
      /\d/.test(form.password),
    [form.password],
  );

  if (auth.snapshot.status === "authenticated") return <AuthenticatedState />;

  const update = (key: keyof typeof form, value: string | number) =>
    setForm((current) => ({ ...current, [key]: value }));
  const submit = async (event: FormEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    if (!form.fullName.trim() || !form.email.trim() || !form.batch.trim()) {
      setError(label("requiredField"));
      return;
    }
    if (!/^\S+@\S+\.\S+$/.test(form.email)) {
      setError(label("emailInvalid"));
      return;
    }
    if (!passwordReady) {
      setError(label("passwordRules"));
      return;
    }
    if (form.password !== form.confirm) {
      setError(label("passwordMismatch"));
      return;
    }
    try {
      await auth.register({
        fullName: form.fullName,
        email: form.email,
        password: form.password,
        year: form.year,
        batch: form.batch,
      });
      navigate(`${routes.verify}?returnTo=${encodeURIComponent(returnTo)}`, {
        replace: true,
      });
    } catch (caught) {
      setError(label(authErrorKey(caught)));
    }
  };

  return (
    <section className="auth-panel auth-register-panel">
      <div className="auth-panel-heading">
        <p className="auth-eyebrow">
          <UserRoundPlus />
          {label("createAccount")}
        </p>
        <h2>{label("registerTitle")}</h2>
        <p>{label("registerBody")}</p>
      </div>
      <form className="auth-form" onSubmit={submit} noValidate>
        <div className="auth-field-pair">
          <label className="auth-field" htmlFor="register-name">
            <span>{label("fullName")}</span>
            <input
              id="register-name"
              autoComplete="name"
              value={form.fullName}
              onChange={(event) => update("fullName", event.target.value)}
            />
          </label>
          <label className="auth-field" htmlFor="register-email">
            <span>{label("email")}</span>
            <input
              id="register-email"
              type="email"
              autoComplete="email"
              value={form.email}
              onChange={(event) => update("email", event.target.value)}
            />
          </label>
        </div>
        <div className="auth-field-pair">
          <label className="auth-field" htmlFor="register-batch">
            <span>{label("batchName")}</span>
            <input
              id="register-batch"
              value={form.batch}
              onChange={(event) => update("batch", event.target.value)}
            />
          </label>
          <label className="auth-field" htmlFor="register-year">
            <span>{label("studyYear")}</span>
            <select
              id="register-year"
              value={form.year}
              onChange={(event) => update("year", Number(event.target.value))}
            >
              {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6].map((year) => (
                <option key={year} value={year}>
                  {label("year")} {year}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </label>
        </div>
        <label className="auth-field" htmlFor="register-password">
          <span>{label("password")}</span>
          <span className="auth-password-field">
            <input
              id="register-password"
              aria-label={label("password")}
              type={visible ? "text" : "password"}
              autoComplete="new-password"
              value={form.password}
              onChange={(event) => update("password", event.target.value)}
              aria-describedby="password-rules"
            />
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setVisible((value) => !value)}
              aria-label={label(visible ? "hidePassword" : "showPassword")}
            >
              {visible ? <EyeOff /> : <Eye />}
            </button>
          </span>
          <small id="password-rules" data-ready={passwordReady || undefined}>
            {label("passwordRules")}
          </small>
        </label>
        <label className="auth-field" htmlFor="register-confirm">
          <span>{label("confirmPassword")}</span>
          <input
            id="register-confirm"
            aria-label={label("confirmPassword")}
            type={visible ? "text" : "password"}
            autoComplete="new-password"
            value={form.confirm}
            onChange={(event) => update("confirm", event.target.value)}
          />
        </label>
        {error && (
          <p className="auth-form-error" role="alert">
            {error}
          </p>
        )}
        <Button
          type="submit"
          disabled={auth.isPending}
          className="button button-primary auth-submit"
        >
          {auth.isPending ? label("creatingAccount") : label("createAccount")}
        </Button>
      </form>
      <p className="auth-switch">
        {label("alreadyAccount")}{" "}
        <AppLink href={routes.signIn}>{label("signIn")}</AppLink>
      </p>
    </section>
  );
}

import { useState, type FormEvent } from "react";

import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { AppLink } from "../../components/navigation/AppLink";
import { Button } from "../../components/ui/button";

export default function SignInPage() {
  const auth = useAuth();

  const navigate = useNavigate();

              autoComplete="current-password"
              value={password}
              onChange={(event) => setPassword(event.target.value)}
              required
            />
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setVisible((value) => !value)}
              aria-label={label(visible ? "hidePassword" : "showPassword")}
            >
              {visible ? <EyeOff /> : <Eye />}
            </button>
          </span>
        </label>
        <div className="auth-form-between">
          <AppLink href={routes.recover}>{label("forgotPassword")}</AppLink>

            type="button"

              setEmail(PREVIEW_CREDENTIALS.email);
              setPassword(PREVIEW_CREDENTIALS.password);

            <KeyRound />

          {auth.isPending ? label("signingIn") : label("signIn")}
        </Button>
      </form>
      <p className="auth-demo-hint">{label("demoCredentialHint")}</p>
      <p className="auth-switch">
        {label("newHere")}{" "}
        <AppLink href={routes.register}>{label("createAccount")}</AppLink>
      </p>
      <div className="auth-boundary-note">
        <strong>{label("authPreview")}</strong>
        <span>{label("authPreviewBody")}</span>
      </div>

  );

import { useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { BadgeCheck } from "lucide-react";
import { useNavigate, useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { useAuth } from "../../app/providers/AuthProvider";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { AppLink } from "../../components/navigation/AppLink";
import { Button } from "../../components/ui/button";
import { authErrorKey, safeReturnTo } from "../../lib/auth";
import { routes } from "../../constants/routes";
import { AuthenticatedState } from "./AuthenticatedState";

export default function VerifyPage() {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const { label } = useLocale();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [search] = useSearchParams();
  const returnTo = safeReturnTo(search.get("returnTo"));
  const [code, setCode] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  if (auth.snapshot.status === "authenticated") return <AuthenticatedState />;

  const submit = async (event: FormEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    setError(null);

      navigate(returnTo, { replace: true });

      setError(label(authErrorKey(caught)));
    }
  };

  return (
    <section className="auth-panel auth-verify-panel">
      <div className="auth-panel-heading">

          <BadgeCheck />
          {label("verificationCode")}
        </p>
        <h2>{label("verifyTitle")}</h2>
        <p>
          {label("verifyBody")}{" "}
          <strong>{auth.snapshot.pendingEmail || "—"}</strong>
        </p>
      </div>
      <form className="auth-form" onSubmit={submit}>
        <label
          className="auth-field auth-code-field"
          htmlFor="verification-code"
        >
          <span>{label("verificationCode")}</span>
          <input
            id="verification-code"
            aria-label={label("verificationCode")}
            inputMode="numeric"
            autoComplete="one-time-code"
            maxLength={6}
            value={code}
            onChange={(event) => setCode(event.target.value.replace(/\D/g, ""))}
          />
          <small>{label("previewCode")}</small>
        </label>
        {error && (
          <p className="auth-form-error" role="alert">
            {error}
          </p>
        )}
        <Button
          type="submit"
          disabled={auth.isPending || code.length !== 6}
          className="button button-primary auth-submit"
        >
          {auth.isPending ? label("verifying") : label("verifyEmail")}
        </Button>
      </form>
      <p className="auth-switch">
        <AppLink href={routes.register}>{label("createAccount")}</AppLink>
        <span aria-hidden="true">·</span>
        <AppLink href={routes.signIn}>{label("backToSignIn")}</AppLink>
      </p>
    </section>
  );
}

FILE: src/features/calendar/CalendarPage.tsx
============================================================
import { useState, type KeyboardEvent } from "react";
import {
  CalendarDays,
  ChevronLeft,
  ChevronRight,
  Plus,
  Clock3,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { useWorkspace } from "../../app/providers/WorkspaceProvider";
import { PageIntro } from "../../components/data-display/PageIntro";
import { SelectField } from "../../components/forms/SelectField";
import { Button } from "../../components/ui/button";
import { Modal } from "../../components/ui/Modal";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { formatDate } from "../../lib/dates";
import {
  calendarDate,
  dateAtNoon,
  monthDays,
  shiftDay,
  shiftMonth,
} from "../../lib/calendar";
import { DEMO_TODAY } from "../../constants/config";
import { useCalendar } from "./useCalendar";
import { StudyEditor } from "./StudyEditor";
import type { CalendarItem, StudyEntry } from "../../types/workspace";
export const calendarKindLabels = {
  study: "studyBlock",
  exam: "examDate",
  event: "savedEvent",
  deadline: "deadlineDate",
  mentorship: "mentorship",
  recruitment: "recruitment",
} as const;
export default function CalendarPage() {
  const { label, t, locale, dir } = useLocale();
  const workspace = useWorkspace(),
    calendar = useCalendar();
  const [month, setMonth] = useState(DEMO_TODAY.slice(0, 7)),
    [day, setDay] = useState<string | null>(DEMO_TODAY);
  const [view, setView] = useState<"month" | "agenda">("month"),
    [kind, setKind] = useState("");
  const [editor, setEditor] = useState<{
      day: string;
      entry?: StudyEntry;
    } | null>(null),
    [detail, setDetail] = useState<CalendarItem | null>(null);
  if (calendar.isError) return <ErrorState retry={calendar.retry} />;
  if (calendar.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  const visible = calendar.items.filter(
    (i) =>
      (!kind || kind === i.kind) && calendarDate(i.startsAt).startsWith(month),
  );
  const selectedItems = visible.filter(
    (i) => !day || calendarDate(i.startsAt) === day,
  );
  const days = monthDays(month);
  const moveMonth = (count: number) => {
    setMonth(shiftMonth(month, count));
    setDay(null);
  };
  function moveFocus(e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLButtonElement>, date: string) {
    let target: string | undefined;
    if (e.key === "ArrowRight") target = shiftDay(date, dir === "rtl" ? -1 : 1);
    if (e.key === "ArrowLeft") target = shiftDay(date, dir === "rtl" ? 1 : -1);
    if (e.key === "ArrowDown") target = shiftDay(date, 7);
    if (e.key === "ArrowUp") target = shiftDay(date, -7);
    if (e.key === "Home")
      target = shiftDay(
        date,
        -((new Date(dateAtNoon(date)).getUTCDay() + 6) % 7),
      );
    if (e.key === "End")
      target = shiftDay(
        date,
        6 - ((new Date(dateAtNoon(date)).getUTCDay() + 6) % 7),
      );
    if (!target) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    setDay(target);
    setMonth(target.slice(0, 7));
    requestAnimationFrame(() =>
      document
        .querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(
          `button[data-calendar-date="${target}"]`,
        )
        ?.focus(),
    );
  }
  const openItem = (item: CalendarItem) => {
    if (item.kind === "study")
      setEditor({
        day: calendarDate(item.startsAt),
        entry: workspace.state.studyEntries.find((e) => e.id === item.id),
      });
    else setDetail(item);
  };
  return (
    <div className="container calendar-v3">
      <PageIntro
        eyebrow={label("calendarEyebrow")}
        title={label("calendarTitle")}
        description={label("calendarDescription")}
      />
      <div className="calendar-toolbar">
        <div className="calendar-month-controls">
          <button
            className="workspace-icon"
            aria-label={label("previousMonth")}
            onClick={() => moveMonth(-1)}
          >
            <ChevronLeft className="directional" size={20} />
          </button>
          <h2 aria-live="polite">
            {formatDate(dateAtNoon(month + "-01"), locale, {
              month: "long",
              year: "numeric",
            })}
          </h2>
          <button
            className="workspace-icon"
            aria-label={label("nextMonth")}
            onClick={() => moveMonth(1)}
          >
            <ChevronRight className="directional" size={20} />
          </button>
        </div>
        <div className="calendar-toolbar-actions">
          <button
            className="quiet-button"
            onClick={() => {
              setMonth(DEMO_TODAY.slice(0, 7));
              setDay(DEMO_TODAY);
            }}
          >
            {label("today")}
          </button>
          <div className="segmented-pills" aria-label={label("calendar")}>
            {(["month", "agenda"] as const).map((v) => (
              <button
                key={v}
                aria-pressed={view === v}
                onClick={() => {
                  setView(v);
                  setDay(null);
                }}
              >
                {label(v === "agenda" ? "calendarAgenda" : v)}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
          <Button
            className="button button-primary"
            onClick={() => setEditor({ day: day || month + "-01" })}
          >
            <Plus size={17} />
            {label("addStudy")}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="calendar-legend">
        <SelectField
          label={label("searchType")}
          value={kind}
          onChange={(e) => setKind(e.target.value)}
        >
          <option value="">{label("allTypes")}</option>
          {Object.entries(calendarKindLabels).map(([key, value]) => (
            <option key={key} value={key}>
              {label(value)}
            </option>
          ))}
        </SelectField>
        <div>
          {Object.entries(calendarKindLabels).map(([key, value]) => (
            <span key={key}>
              <i data-kind={key} />
              {label(value)}
            </span>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div
        className={
          view === "month"
            ? "calendar-workbench"
            : "calendar-workbench agenda-only"
        }
      >
        {view === "month" && (
          <div className="calendar-board">
            <table className="month-grid">
              <caption className="sr-only">
                {formatDate(dateAtNoon(month + "-01"), locale, {
                  month: "long",
                  year: "numeric",
                })}
              </caption>
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  {days.slice(0, 7).map((d) => (
                    <th scope="col" key={d}>
                      {formatDate(dateAtNoon(d), locale, { weekday: "short" })}
                    </th>
                  ))}
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {Array.from({ length: 6 }, (_, row) => (
                  <tr key={row}>
                    {days.slice(row * 7, row * 7 + 7).map((date) => {
                      const entries = calendar.items.filter(
                        (i) =>
                          (!kind || kind === i.kind) &&
                          calendarDate(i.startsAt) === date,
                      );
                      return (
                        <td key={date}>
                          <button
                            data-calendar-date={date}
                            data-outside={!date.startsWith(month)}
                            data-today={date === DEMO_TODAY}
                            aria-pressed={day === date}
                            tabIndex={date === (day || month + "-01") ? 0 : -1}
                            aria-label={`${formatDate(dateAtNoon(date), locale, { weekday: "long", day: "numeric", month: "long", year: "numeric" })}, ${entries.length} ${label("calendar")}`}
                            onKeyDown={(e) => moveFocus(e, date)}
                            onClick={() => {
                              setDay(date);
                              setMonth(date.slice(0, 7));
                            }}
                          >
                            <span>
                              {new Intl.NumberFormat(locale).format(
                                Number(date.slice(-2)),
                              )}
                            </span>
                            <div className="day-markers" aria-hidden="true">
                              {entries.slice(0, 3).map((item) => (
                                <i key={item.id} data-kind={item.kind} />
                              ))}
                              {entries.length > 3 && <small>+</small>}
                            </div>
                          </button>
                        </td>
                      );
                    })}
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
            <p className="workspace-note">{label("timezoneNote")}</p>
          </div>
        )}
        <section className="day-agenda">
          <div className="agenda-heading">
            <CalendarDays size={21} />
            <h3>
              {day
                ? formatDate(dateAtNoon(day), locale, {
                    weekday: "long",
                    day: "numeric",
                    month: "short",
                  })
                : label("calendarAgenda")}
            </h3>
            {day && (
              <button className="quiet-button" onClick={() => setDay(null)}>
                {label("clearDayFilter")}
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
          {(view === "month" ? selectedItems : visible).map((item) => (
            <button
              key={item.id}
              className="agenda-entry"
              data-kind={item.kind}
              onClick={() => openItem(item)}
            >
              <span className="agenda-date">
                {formatDate(item.startsAt, locale, {
                  day: "numeric",
                  month: "short",
                })}
              </span>
              <span className="agenda-copy">
                <small>{label(calendarKindLabels[item.kind])}</small>
                <strong>{t(item.title)}</strong>
                <span>
                  <Clock3 size={13} />
                  {formatDate(item.startsAt, locale, {
                    hour: "2-digit",
                    minute: "2-digit",
                  })}
                  {item.endsAt &&
                    ` – ${formatDate(item.endsAt, locale, { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" })}`}
                </span>
              </span>
            </button>
          ))}
          {!(view === "month" ? selectedItems : visible).length && (
            <div className="agenda-empty">
              <CalendarDays size={34} />
              <p>{label(day ? "noDayItems" : "noMonthItems")}</p>
              <button
                className="text-link"
                onClick={() => setEditor({ day: day || month + "-01" })}
              >
                {label("addStudy")} <Plus size={15} />
              </button>
            </div>
          )}
        </section>
      </div>
      <p className="workspace-note">{label("calendarSampleNote")}</p>
      {editor && (
        <StudyEditor
          day={editor.day}
          entry={editor.entry}
          close={() => setEditor(null)}
        />
      )}
      {detail && (
        <Modal
          open
          onClose={() => setDetail(null)}
          title={t(detail.title)}
          description={t(detail.description)}
        >
          <p>
            {formatDate(detail.startsAt, locale, {
              dateStyle: "full",
              timeStyle: "short",
            })}
          </p>
          <p className="workspace-note">{label("calendarSampleNote")}</p>
        </Modal>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/features/calendar/README.md
============================================================
# Calendar — V0.3

Implemented at /my/calendar: month/agenda views, illustrative course dates, saved events/deadlines, and personal study block creation, editing and deletion. Keyboard arrows move the date cursor. All displayed times use Amman time.

useCalendar composes service records with workspace state. Data models live in types/workspace.ts; date composition lives in lib/calendar.ts. The stable demo anchor is constants/config.ts. There is no registration engine or background alert delivery.

FILE: src/features/calendar/StudyEditor.tsx
============================================================
import { useState } from "react";
import { createRecordId } from "../../lib/record-id";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { useWorkspace } from "../../app/providers/WorkspaceProvider";
import { useCourses, useStudentProfile } from "../../hooks/useContent";
import { Modal } from "../../components/ui/Modal";
import { Button } from "../../components/ui/button";
import { SelectField } from "../../components/forms/SelectField";
import { validStudyEntry } from "../../lib/workspace-state";
import type { StudyEntry } from "../../types/workspace";
export function StudyEditor({
  entry,
  day,
  close,
}: {
  entry?: StudyEntry;
  day: string;
  close: () => void;
}) {
  const { label, t } = useLocale();
  const { send } = useWorkspace();
  const courses = useCourses(),
    profile = useStudentProfile();
  const [form, setForm] = useState<StudyEntry>(
    () =>
      entry || {
        id: createRecordId(),
        title: "",
        date: day,
        time: "16:00",
        durationMinutes: 25,
        notes: "",
      },
  );
  const [error, setError] = useState(""),
    [busy, setBusy] = useState(false),
    [deleting, setDeleting] = useState(false);
  async function save() {
    if (!validStudyEntry(form)) {
      setError(label("entryInvalid"));
      return;
    }
    setBusy(true);
    const ok = await send({ type: "upsert-study", entry: form });
    setBusy(false);
    if (ok) close();
  }
  return (
    <Modal
      open
      onClose={close}
      title={label(deleting ? "deleteStudy" : entry ? "editStudy" : "addStudy")}
      description={label(deleting ? "deleteStudyBody" : "timezoneNote")}
    >
      {deleting ? (
        <div className="workspace-form-actions">
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setDeleting(false)}>
            {label("cancel")}
          </Button>
          <Button
            disabled={busy}
            onClick={async () => {
              setBusy(true);
              if (await send({ type: "delete-study", id: form.id })) close();
              setBusy(false);
            }}
          >
            {label("delete")}
          </Button>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <form
          className="workspace-form"
          onSubmit={(e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            void save();
          }}
        >
          <label className="workspace-field">
            <span>{label("entryTitle")}</span>
            <input
              required
              maxLength={100}
              value={form.title}
              onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, title: e.target.value })}
            />
          </label>
          <div className="form-pair">
            <label className="workspace-field">
              <span>{label("entryDate")}</span>
              <input
                required
                type="date"
                value={form.date}
                onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, date: e.target.value })}
              />
            </label>
            <label className="workspace-field">
              <span>{label("entryTime")}</span>
              <input
                required
                type="time"
                value={form.time}
                onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, time: e.target.value })}
              />
            </label>
          </div>
          <div className="form-pair">
            <label className="workspace-field">
              <span>{label("entryDuration")}</span>
              <input
                required
                type="number"
                min={5}
                max={480}
                step={1}
                value={form.durationMinutes}
                onChange={(e) =>
                  setForm({ ...form, durationMinutes: Number(e.target.value) })
                }
              />
            </label>
            <SelectField
              label={label("courseOptional")}
              value={form.courseId || ""}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setForm({ ...form, courseId: e.target.value || undefined })
              }
            >
              <option value="">{label("noCourse")}</option>
              {courses.data
                ?.filter((c) => profile.data?.courseIds.includes(c.id))
                .map((c) => (
                  <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>
                    {t(c.title)}
                  </option>
                ))}
            </SelectField>
          </div>
          <label className="workspace-field">
            <span>{label("entryNotes")}</span>
            <textarea
              maxLength={500}
              value={form.notes}
              onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, notes: e.target.value })}
            />
          </label>
          {error && (
            <p className="field-error" role="alert">
              {error}
            </p>
          )}
          <div className="workspace-form-actions">
            {entry && (
              <button
                type="button"
                className="quiet-button danger-text"
                onClick={() => setDeleting(true)}
              >
                {label("delete")}
              </button>
            )}
            <Button variant="outline" type="button" onClick={close}>
              {label("cancel")}
            </Button>
            <Button
              type="submit"
              disabled={busy}
              className="button button-primary"
            >
              {label("saveChanges")}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </form>
      )}
    </Modal>
  );
}

import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import {
  Activity,
  HeartPulse,
  Search,
  Stethoscope,
  UsersRound,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { CommunityActivityCard } from "../../components/cards/CommunityActivityCard";
import { CommunityNavigation } from "../../components/navigation/CommunityNavigation";
import { AliveTabs } from "../../components/navigation/AliveTabs";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { EmptyState } from "../../components/feedback/EmptyState";
import { useCommunityActivities } from "../../hooks/useContent";

type View =
  "all" | "health-campaign" | "peer-learning" | "volunteering" | "student-life";

export default function ActivitiesPage() {
  const { t, label } = useLocale();
  const query = useCommunityActivities();
  const [view, setView] = useState<View>("all");
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const activities = query.data || [];
  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    const needle = search.trim().toLocaleLowerCase();
    return activities.filter(
      (item) =>
        (view === "all" || item.kind === view) &&
        (!needle ||
          [t(item.title), t(item.summary), t(item.location)].some((value) =>
            value.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(needle),
          )),
    );
  }, [activities, search, t, view]);
  if (query.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (query.isError) return <ErrorState retry={() => void query.refetch()} />;
  const tabs = [
    {
      id: "all",
      label: label("allActivities"),
      icon: Activity,
      count: activities.length,
    },
    {
      id: "health-campaign",
      label: label("healthCampaign"),
      icon: HeartPulse,
      count: activities.filter((item) => item.kind === "health-campaign")
        .length,
    },
    {
      id: "peer-learning",
      label: label("peerLearning"),
      icon: Stethoscope,
      count: activities.filter((item) => item.kind === "peer-learning").length,
    },
    {
      id: "volunteering",
      label: label("volunteering"),
      icon: UsersRound,
      count: activities.filter((item) => item.kind === "volunteering").length,
    },
  ] as const;
  return (
    <div className="community-v5 community-index-page container">
      <CommunityNavigation />
      <header className="community-page-intro">
        <span className="eyebrow">{label("activitiesEyebrow")}</span>
        <h1 tabIndex={-1} data-page-heading>
          {label("activitiesTitle")}
        </h1>
        <p>{label("activitiesBody")}</p>
      </header>
      <section
        className="community-filter-panel"
        aria-label={label("activityFilters")}
      >
        <AliveTabs
          label={label("activityFilters")}
          items={[...tabs]}
          value={view}
          onChange={setView}
        />
        <label className="community-search">
          <Search size={18} />
          <span className="sr-only">{label("activityFilters")}</span>
          <input
            value={search}
            onChange={(event) => setSearch(event.target.value)}
            placeholder={label("searchSomething")}
          />
        </label>
      </section>
      <p className="community-results" role="status">
        <strong>{filtered.length}</strong> {label("results")}
      </p>
      {filtered.length ? (
        <div className="community-activity-grid">
          {filtered.map((item) => (
            <CommunityActivityCard key={item.id} activity={item} />
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <EmptyState title={label("noActivityResults")} />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import {
  Activity,
  ArrowUpRight,
  Award,
  Camera,
  HeartPulse,
  Newspaper,
  ShieldCheck,
  UsersRound,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { CommunityActivityCard } from "../../components/cards/CommunityActivityCard";
import { ArticleCard } from "../../components/cards/ArticleCard";
import { CommunityNavigation } from "../../components/navigation/CommunityNavigation";
import { AppLink } from "../../components/navigation/AppLink";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { Notice } from "../../components/feedback/Notice";
import { routes } from "../../constants/routes";
import {
  useCommunityActivities,
  useCommunityMedia,
  useExecutiveBodies,
  useJournal,
} from "../../hooks/useContent";

const portals = [
  { href: routes.activities, label: "activities", icon: Activity, tone: "red" },
  { href: routes.journal, label: "journal", icon: Newspaper, tone: "ink" },
  { href: routes.media, label: "media", icon: Camera, tone: "russet" },
  {
    href: routes.executiveBodies,
    label: "executiveBodies",
    icon: ShieldCheck,
    tone: "olive",
  },
  { href: routes.honorPlate, label: "recognition", icon: Award, tone: "red" },
] as const;

export default function CommunityPage() {
  const { label } = useLocale();
  const activities = useCommunityActivities();
  const journal = useJournal();
  const media = useCommunityMedia();
  const bodies = useExecutiveBodies();
  const queries = [activities, journal, media, bodies];
  if (queries.some((query) => query.isPending)) return <LoadingState />;
  if (queries.some((query) => query.isError))
    return (
      <ErrorState
        retry={() => queries.forEach((query) => void query.refetch())}
      />
    );
  const featuredActivity = activities.data?.find((item) => item.featured);
  const featuredArticle = journal.data?.find((item) => item.featured);
  const memberCount =
    bodies.data?.find((body) => body.current)?.members.length || 0;
  return (
    <div className="community-v5 container">
      <CommunityNavigation />
      <section className="community-hero">
        <div className="community-hero-copy">
          <span className="eyebrow">{label("communityEyebrow")}</span>
          <h1 tabIndex={-1} data-page-heading>
            {label("communityTitle")}
          </h1>
          <p>{label("communityBody")}</p>
          <AppLink className="button button-primary" href={routes.activities}>
            {label("exploreCommunity")}
            <ArrowUpRight className="directional" size={18} />
          </AppLink>
        </div>
        <div
          className="community-monitor"
          aria-label={label("communitySignal")}
        >
          <div className="monitor-head">
            <span>
              <HeartPulse size={17} />
              {label("communitySignal")}
            </span>
            <i />
          </div>
          <div className="monitor-trace" aria-hidden="true">
            <span />
            <b />
          </div>
          <p>{label("communitySignalBody")}</p>
          <div className="monitor-stats">
            <span>
              <b>{activities.data?.length || 0}</b>
              {label("activities")}
            </span>
            <span>
              <b>{journal.data?.length || 0}</b>
              {label("journal")}
            </span>
            <span>
              <b>{memberCount}</b>
              {label("leadership")}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>
      <section
        className="community-portals"
        aria-label={label("communityNavigation")}
      >
        {portals.map(({ href, label: key, icon: Icon, tone }) => (
          <AppLink href={href} key={href} data-tone={tone}>
            <span className="portal-medical-icon" aria-hidden="true">
              <Icon size={22} />
              <i />
            </span>
            <strong>{label(key)}</strong>
            <ArrowUpRight className="directional" size={18} />
          </AppLink>
        ))}
      </section>
      {(featuredActivity || featuredArticle) && (
        <section className="community-feature-grid">
          {featuredActivity && (
            <div>
              <span className="eyebrow">{label("activities")}</span>
              <CommunityActivityCard activity={featuredActivity} />
            </div>
          )}
          {featuredArticle && (
            <div>
              <span className="eyebrow">{label("featuredStory")}</span>
              <ArticleCard article={featuredArticle} />
            </div>
          )}
        </section>
      )}
      <section className="community-callout">
        <div>
          <UsersRound size={26} />
          <span className="eyebrow">{label("aboutMedClub")}</span>
          <h2>{label("aboutTitle")}</h2>
          <p>{label("aboutBody")}</p>
        </div>
        <AppLink className="button button-outline" href={routes.about}>
          {label("aboutMedClub")}
          <ArrowUpRight className="directional" size={17} />
        </AppLink>

import { ArrowLeft, Clock3, ShieldCheck, UserRound } from "lucide-react";
import { useParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { SaveButton } from "../../components/cards/SaveButton";
import { CommunityNavigation } from "../../components/navigation/CommunityNavigation";
import { AppLink } from "../../components/navigation/AppLink";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { useArticle, useJournal } from "../../hooks/useContent";
import { formatDate } from "../../lib/dates";
import { articlePath, routes } from "../../constants/routes";

export default function JournalArticlePage() {
  const { slug } = useParams();
  const { t, label, locale } = useLocale();
  const article = useArticle(slug);
  const journal = useJournal();
  if (article.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (article.isError)
    return <ErrorState retry={() => void article.refetch()} />;
  if (!article.data)
    return (
      <div className="community-v5 container article-not-found">
        <CommunityNavigation />
        <h1>{label("notFound")}</h1>
        <AppLink className="button button-primary" href={routes.journal}>
          {label("backToJournal")}
        </AppLink>
      </div>
    );
  const item = article.data;
  const related = (journal.data || [])
    .filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== item.id)
    .slice(0, 2);
  return (
    <article className="community-v5 journal-article-page container">
      <CommunityNavigation />
      <AppLink className="journal-back" href={routes.journal}>
        <ArrowLeft className="directional" size={17} />
        {label("backToJournal")}
      </AppLink>
      <header className="journal-article-header">
        <div>
          <span className="eyebrow">{t(item.category)}</span>
          <h1 tabIndex={-1} data-page-heading>
            {t(item.title)}
          </h1>
          <p>{t(item.excerpt)}</p>
        </div>
        <SaveButton id={item.id} title={t(item.title)} />
      </header>
      <div className="journal-byline">
        <span>
          <UserRound size={17} />
          <b>{label("writtenBy")}</b>
          {t(item.author)}
        </span>
        <span>
          <ShieldCheck size={17} />
          <b>{label("scientificallyReviewedBy")}</b>
          {t(item.reviewer)}
        </span>
        <span>
          <Clock3 size={17} />
          <b>{label("published")}</b>
          <time dateTime={item.publishedAt}>
            {formatDate(item.publishedAt, locale, {
              day: "numeric",
              month: "long",
              year: "numeric",
            })}
          </time>
        </span>
      </div>
      <div className="journal-reading-layout">
        <aside className="reading-signal" aria-hidden="true">
          <span />
          <i />
          <b />
        </aside>
        <div className="journal-article-body">
          {item.body.map((paragraph, index) => (
            <p key={index}>{t(paragraph)}</p>
          ))}
          <div className="editorial-note">
            <ShieldCheck size={20} />
            <div>
              <strong>{label("editorialNote")}</strong>
              <p>{label("editorialNoteBody")}</p>

              </AppLink>

FILE: src/features/community/JournalPage.tsx

import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import {
  BookOpen,
  HeartHandshake,
  Microscope,
  Search,
  Stethoscope,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { ArticleCard } from "../../components/cards/ArticleCard";
import { CommunityNavigation } from "../../components/navigation/CommunityNavigation";
import { AliveTabs } from "../../components/navigation/AliveTabs";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { EmptyState } from "../../components/feedback/EmptyState";
import { useJournal } from "../../hooks/useContent";

type View = "all" | "student-life" | "research" | "clinical" | "community";

export default function JournalPage() {
  const { t, label } = useLocale();
  const query = useJournal();
  const [view, setView] = useState<View>("all");
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const articles = query.data || [];
  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    const needle = search.trim().toLocaleLowerCase();
    return articles.filter(
      (article) =>
        (view === "all" || article.categoryId === view) &&
        (!needle ||
          [
            t(article.title),
            t(article.excerpt),
            t(article.author),
            ...article.tags.map(t),
          ].some((value) => value.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(needle))),
    );
  }, [articles, search, t, view]);
  if (query.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (query.isError) return <ErrorState retry={() => void query.refetch()} />;
  const tabs = [
    {
      id: "all",
      label: label("allArticles"),
      icon: BookOpen,
      count: articles.length,
    },
    {
      id: "student-life",
      label: label("studentPerspectives"),
      icon: HeartHandshake,
      count: articles.filter((item) => item.categoryId === "student-life")
        .length,
    },
    {
      id: "research",
      label: label("researchMethods"),
      icon: Microscope,
      count: articles.filter((item) => item.categoryId === "research").length,
    },
    {
      id: "clinical",
      label: label("clinicalLearning"),
      icon: Stethoscope,
      count: articles.filter((item) => item.categoryId === "clinical").length,
    },
  ] as const;
  return (
    <div className="community-v5 journal-page container">
      <CommunityNavigation />
      <header className="journal-hero">
        <div>
          <span className="eyebrow">{label("journalEyebrow")}</span>
          <h1 tabIndex={-1} data-page-heading>
            {label("journalTitle")}
          </h1>
          <p>{label("journalBody")}</p>
        </div>
        <div className="journal-diagnostic" aria-hidden="true">
          <span />
          <i />
          <b />
          <small>MCJ · 05</small>
        </div>
      </header>
      <section
        className="community-filter-panel journal-filter-panel"
        aria-label={label("journalFilters")}
      >
        <AliveTabs
          label={label("journalFilters")}
          items={[...tabs]}
          value={view}
          onChange={setView}
        />
        <label className="community-search">
          <Search size={18} />
          <span className="sr-only">{label("journalSearch")}</span>
          <input
            value={search}
            onChange={(event) => setSearch(event.target.value)}
            placeholder={label("journalSearch")}
          />
        </label>
      </section>
      <p className="community-results" role="status">
        <strong>{filtered.length}</strong> {label("results")}
      </p>
      {filtered.length ? (
        <div className="journal-story-grid">
          {filtered.map((article) => (
            <ArticleCard key={article.id} article={article} />
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <EmptyState title={label("noJournalResults")} />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/features/contributions/ContributionEditor.tsx
============================================================
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { Modal } from "../../components/ui/Modal";
import { Button } from "../../components/ui/button";
import { useCourses } from "../../hooks/useContent";
import type {
  ContributionInput,
  StudentContribution,
} from "../../types/content";

const empty: ContributionInput = {
  kind: "resource",
  title: "",
  topic: "",
  summary: "",
  courseId: undefined,
  sourceUrl: "",
  assetName: "",
  rightsConfirmed: false,
  references: [""],
};
export function ContributionEditor({
  open,
  contribution,
  busy,
  onClose,
  onSave,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  contribution: StudentContribution | null;
  busy: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSave: (input: ContributionInput) => Promise<unknown>;
}) {
  const { t, label } = useLocale();
  const courses = useCourses();
  const [form, setForm] = useState<ContributionInput>(empty);
  const [references, setReferences] = useState("");
  useEffect(() => {
    const value = contribution
      ? {
          id: contribution.id,
          kind: contribution.kind,
          title: contribution.title,
          topic: contribution.topic,
          summary: contribution.summary,
          courseId: contribution.courseId,
          sourceUrl: contribution.sourceUrl,
          assetName: contribution.assetName,
          rightsConfirmed: contribution.rightsConfirmed,
          references: contribution.references,
        }
      : empty;
    setForm(value);
    setReferences(value.references.join("\n"));
  }, [contribution, open]);
  const set = <K extends keyof ContributionInput>(
    key: K,
    value: ContributionInput[K],
  ) => setForm((current) => ({ ...current, [key]: value }));
  async function save(event: React.FormEvent) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const input = {
      ...form,
      references: references
        .split("\n")
        .map((item) => item.trim())
        .filter(Boolean),
    };
    if (
      !input.title.trim() ||
      !input.topic.trim() ||
      !input.summary.trim() ||
      !input.references.length ||
      !input.rightsConfirmed
    ) {
      toast.error(label("contributionIncomplete"));
      return;
    }
    try {
      await onSave(input);
      toast.success(label("draftSaved"));
      onClose();
    } catch {
      toast.error(label("contributionFailed"));
    }
  }
  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onClose={onClose}
      title={label(contribution ? "editContribution" : "newContribution")}
      description={label("contributionPreviewNotice")}
      className="contribution-editor-modal"
    >
      <form className="contribution-editor" onSubmit={save}>
        <div className="editor-two-column">
          <label>
            <span>{label("contributionKind")}</span>
            <select
              value={form.kind}
              onChange={(event) =>
                set("kind", event.target.value as ContributionInput["kind"])
              }
            >
              <option value="resource">{label("resourceContribution")}</option>
              <option value="article">{label("articleContribution")}</option>
            </select>
          </label>
          <label>
            <span>{label("relatedCourse")}</span>
            <select
              value={form.courseId || ""}
              onChange={(event) =>
                set("courseId", event.target.value || undefined)
              }
            >
              <option value="">{label("noCourse")}</option>
              {courses.data?.map((course) => (
                <option value={course.id} key={course.id}>
                  {t(course.title)}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </label>
        </div>
        <label>
          <span>{label("contributionTitle")}</span>
          <input
            value={form.title}
            onChange={(event) => set("title", event.target.value)}
            required
          />
        </label>
        <label>
          <span>{label("contributionTopic")}</span>
          <input
            value={form.topic}
            onChange={(event) => set("topic", event.target.value)}
            required
          />
        </label>
        <label>
          <span>{label("contributionSummary")}</span>
          <textarea
            value={form.summary}
            onChange={(event) => set("summary", event.target.value)}
            rows={4}
            required
          />
        </label>
        <div className="editor-two-column">
          <label>
            <span>{label("sourceUrl")}</span>
            <input
              type="url"
              value={form.sourceUrl}
              onChange={(event) => set("sourceUrl", event.target.value)}
            />
          </label>
          <label>
            <span>{label("assetName")}</span>
            <input
              value={form.assetName}
              onChange={(event) => set("assetName", event.target.value)}
            />
          </label>
        </div>
        <label>
          <span>{label("references")}</span>
          <textarea
            value={references}
            onChange={(event) => setReferences(event.target.value)}
            rows={3}
            placeholder={label("referencePlaceholder")}
            required
          />
        </label>
        <label className="rights-confirmation">
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            checked={form.rightsConfirmed}
            onChange={(event) => set("rightsConfirmed", event.target.checked)}
          />
          <span>
            <strong>{label("rightsConfirmed")}</strong>
            <small>{label("rightsBody")}</small>
          </span>
        </label>
        <div className="workspace-form-actions">
          <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={onClose}>
            {label("cancel")}
          </Button>
          <Button className="button button-primary" disabled={busy}>
            {label("saveDraft")}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </Modal>
  );
}

import { useState } from "react";
import {
  CheckCircle2,
  Clock3,
  FileCheck2,
  FilePenLine,
  Plus,
  RotateCcw,
  Send,
  Trash2,
} from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { PageIntro } from "../../components/data-display/PageIntro";
import { EmptyState } from "../../components/feedback/EmptyState";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { AliveTabs } from "../../components/navigation/AliveTabs";
import { Modal } from "../../components/ui/Modal";
import { Button } from "../../components/ui/button";
import { useContributions } from "../../hooks/useContent";
import { formatDate } from "../../lib/dates";
import type {
  ContributionStatus,
  StudentContribution,
} from "../../types/content";
import { ContributionEditor } from "./ContributionEditor";

type View = "all" | ContributionStatus;
const statusKey = (status: ContributionStatus) =>
  status === "under-review"
    ? ("underReview" as const)
    : status === "changes-requested"
      ? ("changesRequested" as const)
      : status === "published"
        ? ("publishedStatus" as const)
        : status;
export default function MyContributionsPage() {
  const { label, t, locale } = useLocale();
  const contributions = useContributions();
  const [view, setView] = useState<View>("all");
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<StudentContribution | null>(null);
  const [editorOpen, setEditorOpen] = useState(false);
  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState<StudentContribution | null>(null);
  if (contributions.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (contributions.isError) return <ErrorState retry={contributions.retry} />;
  const filtered = contributions.items.filter(
    (item) => view === "all" || item.status === view,
  );
  const tabs = [
    {
      id: "all",
      label: label("allContent"),
      icon: FileCheck2,
      count: contributions.items.length,
    },
    {
      id: "draft",
      label: label("draft"),
      icon: FilePenLine,
      count: contributions.items.filter((item) => item.status === "draft")
        .length,
    },
    {
      id: "under-review",
      label: label("underReview"),
      icon: Clock3,
      count: contributions.items.filter(
        (item) => item.status === "under-review",
      ).length,
    },
    {
      id: "changes-requested",
      label: label("changesRequested"),
      icon: RotateCcw,
      count: contributions.items.filter(
        (item) => item.status === "changes-requested",
      ).length,
    },
    {
      id: "approved",
      label: label("approved"),
      icon: CheckCircle2,
      count: contributions.items.filter((item) => item.status === "approved")
        .length,
    },
  ] as const;
  async function submit(id: string) {
    try {
      await contributions.submit(id);
      toast.success(label("submissionSent"));
    } catch {
      toast.error(label("contributionFailed"));
    }
  }
  async function remove() {
    if (!deleting) return;
    try {
      await contributions.deleteDraft(deleting.id);
      setDeleting(null);
      toast.success(label("deleteDraft"));
    } catch {
      toast.error(label("contributionFailed"));
    }
  }
  const openEditor = (item: StudentContribution | null) => {
    setEditing(item);
    setEditorOpen(true);
  };
  return (
    <div className="container contributions-v6 my-contributions-page">
      <PageIntro
        eyebrow={label("myContributionsEyebrow")}
        title={label("myContributionsTitle")}
        description={label("myContributionsBody")}
      />
      <div className="contribution-toolbar">
        <AliveTabs
          label={label("status")}
          items={[...tabs]}
          value={view}
          onChange={setView}
        />
        <Button
          className="button button-primary"
          onClick={() => openEditor(null)}
        >
          <Plus size={17} />
          {label("newContribution")}
        </Button>
      </div>
      {filtered.length ? (
        <div className="contribution-records">
          {filtered.map((item) => (
            <article key={item.id} data-status={item.status}>
              <header>
                <span className="contribution-kind">
                  <FileCheck2 size={17} />
                  {label(
                    item.kind === "resource"
                      ? "resourceContribution"
                      : "articleContribution",
                  )}
                </span>
                <span className="contribution-status">
                  {label(statusKey(item.status))}
                </span>
              </header>
              <h2>{item.title}</h2>
              <p>{item.summary}</p>
              <dl>
                <div>
                  <dt>{label("contributionTopic")}</dt>
                  <dd>{item.topic}</dd>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <dt>{label("updatedOn")}</dt>
                  <dd>{formatDate(item.updatedAt, locale)}</dd>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <dt>{label("references")}</dt>
                  <dd>{item.references.length}</dd>
                </div>
              </dl>
              {item.reviewerFeedback && (
                <aside className="reviewer-feedback">
                  <strong>{label("reviewerFeedback")}</strong>
                  <p>{t(item.reviewerFeedback)}</p>
                  {item.reviewer && <span>{t(item.reviewer)}</span>}
                </aside>
              )}
              <details className="contribution-history">
                <summary>{label("reviewHistory")}</summary>
                <ol>
                  {item.history.map((entry) => (
                    <li key={entry.id} data-status={entry.status}>
                      <i />
                      <div>
                        <strong>{label(statusKey(entry.status))}</strong>
                        <span>
                          {t(entry.note)} · {formatDate(entry.at, locale)}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ol>
              </details>
              <footer>
                {(item.status === "draft" ||
                  item.status === "changes-requested") && (
                  <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => openEditor(item)}>
                    <FilePenLine size={16} />
                    {label(
                      item.status === "changes-requested"
                        ? "editAndResubmit"
                        : "editContribution",
                    )}
                  </Button>
                )}
                {item.status === "draft" && (
                  <>
                    <Button
                      className="button button-primary"
                      disabled={contributions.isMutating}
                      onClick={() => void submit(item.id)}
                    >
                      <Send size={16} />
                      {label("submitForReview")}
                    </Button>
                    <Button variant="ghost" onClick={() => setDeleting(item)}>
                      <Trash2 size={16} />
                      {label("deleteDraft")}
                    </Button>
                  </>
                )}
              </footer>
            </article>
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <EmptyState
          title={label("noContributions")}
          description={label("noContributionsBody")}
        />
      )}
      <p className="v6-boundary-note">{label("contributionPreviewNotice")}</p>
      <ContributionEditor
        open={editorOpen}
        contribution={editing}
        busy={contributions.isMutating}
        onClose={() => setEditorOpen(false)}
        onSave={contributions.saveDraft}
      />
      <Modal
        open={!!deleting}
        onClose={() => setDeleting(null)}
        title={label("deleteDraftTitle")}
        description={label("deleteDraftBody")}
      >
        <div className="workspace-form-actions">
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setDeleting(null)}>
            {label("cancel")}
          </Button>
          <Button variant="destructive" onClick={() => void remove()}>
            {label("deleteDraft")}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
}

# Scientific contributions — implemented in V0.6

Includes student submission, locked review state, requested changes, revision, resubmission and explicit approval/publication separation. Local fixtures demonstrate the workflow; scientific-review authority, immutable history, rights records and publishing permission must be enforced by the production backend.
