FILE: src/features/courses/CourseNotebook.tsx
============================================================
import {
  useEffect,
  useLayoutEffect,
  useMemo,
  useRef,
  useState,
  type CSSProperties,
} from "react";
import {
  ArrowLeft,
  ArrowUpRight,
  BookMarked,
  BookOpen,
  CircleHelp,
  ClipboardList,
  Columns2,
  FileText,
  Film,
  Focus,
  Globe2,
  LayoutDashboard,
  Lightbulb,
  Maximize2,
  X,
} from "lucide-react";
import type { Course, CourseSectionKind, Resource } from "../../types/content";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { useStudyChrome } from "../../app/providers/StudyChromeProvider";
import { useWorkspace } from "../../app/providers/WorkspaceProvider";
import { EmptyState } from "../../components/feedback/EmptyState";
import { AppLink } from "../../components/navigation/AppLink";
import { useWorkspacePaths } from "../../hooks/useWorkspacePaths";
import { formatDate } from "../../lib/dates";
import { useStudyCopy } from "./study-copy";
import { useStudyState } from "./useStudyState";
import { StudyResourceViewer } from "./StudyResourceViewer";
import { NotebookResourceCard } from "./NotebookResourceCard";
import { safeResourceUrl, type StudyPosition } from "./study-state";

const icons = {
  overview: LayoutDashboard,
  guidance: Lightbulb,
  slides: FileText,
  notes: ClipboardList,
  summary: BookMarked,
  recording: Film,
  book: BookOpen,
  questions: CircleHelp,
  external: Globe2,
} satisfies Record<CourseSectionKind, typeof FileText>;

export function CourseNotebook({
  course,
  resources,
  storageKey,
}: {
  course: Course;
  resources: Resource[];
  storageKey: string;
}) {
  const { t, label, locale, dir } = useLocale();
  const s = useStudyCopy();
  const paths = useWorkspacePaths();
  const { focus, setFocus } = useStudyChrome();
  const workspace = useWorkspace();
  const study = useStudyState(storageKey);
  const ordered = useMemo(
    () => [...course.sections].sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order),
    [course.sections],
  );
  const bySection = useMemo(
    () =>
      Object.fromEntries(
        ordered.map((section) => [
          section.kind,
          resources.filter((resource) => resource.kind === section.kind),
        ]),
      ) as Partial<Record<CourseSectionKind, Resource[]>>,
    [ordered, resources],
  );
  const active =
    ordered.find((section) => section.kind === study.state.active) ||
    ordered[0];
  const [peek, setPeek] = useState<CourseSectionKind | null>(null);
  const [turn, setTurn] = useState<{ id: number; backwards: boolean } | null>(
    null,
  );
  const [peekTop, setPeekTop] = useState(100);
  const [mobileIndex, setMobileIndex] = useState(false);
  const page = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
  const book = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const title = useRef<HTMLHeadingElement>(null);
  const peekTimer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined>(
    undefined,
  );
  const suppressed = useRef<CourseSectionKind | null>(null);
  const visited = useRef(false);
  const switching = useRef(false);
  const restoring = useRef(false);
  const activeRef = useRef(active?.kind);
  activeRef.current = active?.kind;
  const selected = resources.find(
    (resource) =>
      resource.kind === active?.kind &&
      resource.id === study.state.sections[active?.kind]?.resourceId,
  );
  const companion = resources.find(
    (resource) =>
      resource.id === study.state.companionId && resource.id !== selected?.id,
  );
  const lastResource = resources.find(
    (resource) => resource.id === study.state.lastResourceId,
  );
  const visible = bySection[active?.kind] || [];
  const peekSection = ordered.find((section) => section.kind === peek);
  const peekResources = peek ? bySection[peek] || [] : [];
  const firstMaterial =
    resources.find((resource) => resource.kind === "guidance") || resources[0];

  function closePeek() {
    if (peekTimer.current) clearTimeout(peekTimer.current);
    setPeek(null);
  }
  function dismissPeek() {
    const kind = peek;
    suppressed.current = kind;
    const previewHasFocus = book.current
      ?.querySelector(".notebook-peek")
      ?.contains(document.activeElement);
    closePeek();
    if (previewHasFocus && kind)
      book.current
        ?.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(`[data-notebook-section="${kind}"]`)
        ?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  }
  function preview(kind: CourseSectionKind, element: HTMLButtonElement) {
    if (peekTimer.current) clearTimeout(peekTimer.current);
    if (suppressed.current === kind || kind === active.kind || focus) {
      setPeek(null);
      return;
    }
    suppressed.current = null;
    const spread = book.current?.querySelector(".notebook-spread");
    if (spread) {
      const bounds = element.getBoundingClientRect();
      const top = Math.min(bounds.top, Math.max(80, window.innerHeight - 380));
      setPeekTop(Math.max(20, top - spread.getBoundingClientRect().top));
    }
    peekTimer.current = setTimeout(() => setPeek(kind), 180);
  }
  function scheduleClosePeek() {
    if (peekTimer.current) clearTimeout(peekTimer.current);
    peekTimer.current = setTimeout(() => setPeek(null), 140);
  }
  function animateTo(kind: CourseSectionKind) {
    closePeek();
    if (kind === active.kind) return;
    const backwards =
      ordered.findIndex((section) => section.kind === kind) <
      ordered.findIndex((section) => section.kind === active.kind);
    if (
      !focus &&
      !window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches
    )
      setTurn((previous) => ({ id: (previous?.id || 0) + 1, backwards }));
  }
  function rememberSection() {
    if (!page.current || !activeRef.current || restoring.current) return;
    const top = page.current.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY;
    const scroll = Math.max(0, window.scrollY - top);
    const kind = activeRef.current;
    study.update(
      (previous) => ({
        ...previous,
        sections: {
          ...previous.sections,
          [kind]: { ...previous.sections[kind], scroll },
        },
      }),
      false,
    );
  }
  function select(kind: CourseSectionKind) {
    rememberSection();
    switching.current = kind !== active.kind;
    animateTo(kind);
    suppressed.current = kind;
    setMobileIndex(false);
    study.update((previous) => ({ ...previous, active: kind }));
  }
  function open(resource: Resource) {
    rememberSection();
    switching.current = resource.kind !== active.kind;
    animateTo(resource.kind);
    study.update((previous) => ({
      ...previous,
      active: resource.kind,
      lastResourceId: resource.id,
      sections: {
        ...previous.sections,
        [resource.kind]: {
          scroll: previous.sections[resource.kind]?.scroll || 0,
          resourceId: resource.id,
        },
      },
    }));
    if (!workspace.isPending && !workspace.isError)
      void workspace.send({ type: "view-resource", id: resource.id });
    setMobileIndex(false);
  }
  function closeResource() {
    study.update((previous) => ({
      ...previous,
      sections: {
        ...previous.sections,
        [active.kind]: {
          ...previous.sections[active.kind],
          scroll: 0,
          resourceId: undefined,
        },
      },
    }));
    requestAnimationFrame(() => title.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true }));
  }
  function savePosition(id: string, position: Partial<StudyPosition>) {
    study.update(
      (previous) => ({
        ...previous,
        resources: {
          ...previous.resources,
          [id]: {
            ...(previous.resources[id] || { scroll: 0, page: 1, seconds: 0 }),
            ...position,
          },
        },
      }),
      false,
    );
  }
  useEffect(() => {
    let frame = 0;
    const scroll = () => {
      if (!frame)
        frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          frame = 0;
          rememberSection();
        });
    };
    window.addEventListener("scroll", scroll, { passive: true });
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("scroll", scroll);
      cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
      if (peekTimer.current) clearTimeout(peekTimer.current);
    };
    // This keyed component keeps the same account/course. The ref tracks its active section.
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const offset = study.current.current.sections[active.kind]?.scroll || 0;
    const switched = switching.current;
    switching.current = false;
    const shouldRestore = offset > 0 || (visited.current && switched);
    visited.current = true;
    if (!shouldRestore) return;
    restoring.current = true;
    let second = 0;
    const first = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      second = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        if (page.current) {
          const top = page.current.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY;
          window.scrollTo({
            top: Math.max(0, top + offset - (offset ? 0 : 76)),
            behavior: "instant",
          });
        }
        restoring.current = false;
      });
    });
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(first);
      cancelAnimationFrame(second);
      restoring.current = false;
    };
  }, [active.kind]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (focus) closePeek();
  }, [focus]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const shortcut = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (
        event.key === "Escape" &&
        focus &&
        !document.querySelector('dialog[open], [role="dialog"]') &&
        !event.defaultPrevented
      )
        setFocus(false);
    };
    document.addEventListener("keydown", shortcut);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("keydown", shortcut);
  }, [focus, setFocus]);
  if (!active) return <EmptyState />;

  return (
    <div
      ref={book}
      className="study-notebook"
      data-course-tone={course.accent}
      data-focus={focus || undefined}
      data-split={study.state.split || undefined}
      dir={dir}
    >
      <div className="notebook-toolbar">
        <div className="notebook-current-course">
          <BookOpen size={20} aria-hidden="true" />
          <div>
            <span>
              {s("notebook")} · <bdi>{course.code}</bdi>
            </span>
            <strong>{t(course.title)}</strong>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="notebook-tools">
          <button
            type="button"
            className="notebook-button"
            aria-pressed={focus}
            onClick={() => setFocus(!focus)}
          >
            {focus ? <Maximize2 size={17} /> : <Focus size={17} />}
            {s(focus ? "exitFocus" : "focus")}
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="notebook-button"
            aria-pressed={study.state.split}
            onClick={() => {
              closePeek();
              study.update((previous) => ({
                ...previous,
                split: !previous.split,
              }));
            }}
          >
            <Columns2 size={17} />
            {s(study.state.split ? "single" : "split")}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="notebook-object">
        <div className="notebook-back-cover" aria-hidden="true" />
        <div className="notebook-page-stack" aria-hidden="true" />
        <div className="notebook-spread">
          <aside
            className="notebook-index"
            data-mobile-open={mobileIndex || undefined}
          >
            <div className="notebook-index-heading">
              <span>{s("index")}</span>
              <bdi>{course.code}</bdi>
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              className="notebook-mobile-index"
              aria-expanded={mobileIndex}
              aria-controls="notebook-bookmarks"
              onClick={() => setMobileIndex((value) => !value)}
            >
              <BookMarked size={17} />
              {t(active.title)}
              <span>{s("contents")}</span>
            </button>
            <nav
              id="notebook-bookmarks"
              className="notebook-bookmarks"
              aria-label={label("courseSections")}
              onKeyDown={(event) => {
                if (event.key === "Escape") {
                  event.stopPropagation();
                  dismissPeek();
                }
                const buttons = [
                  ...event.currentTarget.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>(
                    "button",
                  ),
                ];
                const current = buttons.indexOf(
                  document.activeElement as HTMLButtonElement,
                );
                if (current < 0) return;
                const nextKey = dir === "rtl" ? "ArrowLeft" : "ArrowRight";
                const previousKey = dir === "rtl" ? "ArrowRight" : "ArrowLeft";
                let next: number | undefined;
                if (event.key === "ArrowDown" || event.key === nextKey)
                  next = (current + 1) % buttons.length;
                if (event.key === "ArrowUp" || event.key === previousKey)
                  next = (current - 1 + buttons.length) % buttons.length;
                if (event.key === "Home") next = 0;
                if (event.key === "End") next = buttons.length - 1;
                if (next !== undefined) {
                  event.preventDefault();
                  buttons[next].focus();
                }
              }}
            >
              {ordered.map((section, index) => {
                const Icon = icons[section.kind];
                const items = bySection[section.kind] || [];
                const count =
                  section.kind === "overview"
                    ? course.outcomes.length
                    : items.length;
                const hint =
                  section.kind === "overview"
                    ? course.outcomes[0]
                    : items[0]?.title;
                return (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    key={section.id}
                    className="notebook-bookmark"
                    data-notebook-section={section.kind}
                    aria-current={
                      active.kind === section.kind ? "page" : undefined
                    }
                    aria-controls="notebook-reading-page"
                    onClick={() => select(section.kind)}
                    onPointerEnter={(event) => {
                      if (event.pointerType === "mouse")
                        preview(section.kind, event.currentTarget);
                    }}
                    onPointerLeave={scheduleClosePeek}
                    onFocus={(event) =>
                      preview(section.kind, event.currentTarget)
                    }
                    onBlur={scheduleClosePeek}
                  >
                    <span className="notebook-bookmark-top">
                      <Icon size={18} aria-hidden="true" />
                      <b>{t(section.title)}</b>
                      <small>{count}</small>
                    </span>
                    <span className="notebook-bookmark-glimpse">
                      {hint ? t(hint) : s("noResources")}
                    </span>
                    <span
                      className="notebook-bookmark-number"
                      aria-hidden="true"
                    >
                      {String(index + 1).padStart(2, "0")}
                    </span>
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </nav>
            <div className="notebook-colophon">
              <span>{label("batch")}</span>
              <strong>{t(course.batch)}</strong>
              <span>
                {s("updated")} {formatDate(course.lastUpdated, locale)}
              </span>
              <AppLink href={paths.learning}>
                {label("allCoursesLink")}
                <ArrowUpRight size={14} className="directional" />
              </AppLink>
            </div>
          </aside>
          <div className="notebook-binding" aria-hidden="true">
            {Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, index) => (
              <i key={index} />
            ))}
          </div>
          <section
            ref={page}
            id="notebook-reading-page"
            className="notebook-reading-page"
            aria-labelledby="notebook-section-heading"
          >
            <div className="notebook-page-running">
              <span>{s("notebook")}</span>
              <span aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true">
                {t(active.title)} ·{" "}
                {ordered.findIndex((section) => section.kind === active.kind) +
                  1}{" "}
                / {ordered.length}
              </span>
            </div>
            <header className="notebook-section-heading">
              <div>
                <span>
                  {label(
                    active.kind === "overview" ? "beginHere" : "materials",
                  )}
                </span>
                <h2 ref={title} id="notebook-section-heading" tabIndex={-1}>
                  {t(active.title)}
                </h2>
                <p>{t(active.description)}</p>
              </div>
              <BookMarked size={26} aria-hidden="true" />
            </header>
            {selected && (
              <button
                type="button"
                className="notebook-return"
                onClick={closeResource}
              >
                <ArrowLeft size={16} className="directional" />
                {s("return")}
              </button>
            )}
            <div
              className="notebook-study-layout"
              style={
                { "--reading-width": `${study.state.width}%` } as CSSProperties
              }
            >
              <div className="notebook-primary-pane">
                {selected ? (
                  <StudyResourceViewer
                    key={`main:${selected.id}`}
                    item={selected}
                    position={study.state.resources[selected.id]}
                    onPosition={(position) =>
                      savePosition(selected.id, position)
                    }
                    onClose={closeResource}
                  />
                ) : active.kind === "overview" ? (
                  <div className="notebook-overview">
                    <div className="notebook-orientation">
                      <Lightbulb size={22} aria-hidden="true" />
                      <p>{label("overviewBody")}</p>
                    </div>
                    {(lastResource || firstMaterial) && (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        className="notebook-resume"
                        onClick={() => open((lastResource || firstMaterial)!)}
                      >
                        <BookOpen size={22} />
                        <span>
                          <small>{s(lastResource ? "resume" : "start")}</small>
                          <strong>
                            {t((lastResource || firstMaterial)!.title)}
                          </strong>
                        </span>
                        <ArrowUpRight size={20} className="directional" />
                      </button>
                    )}
                    <h3>{label("learningOutcomes")}</h3>
                    <ol className="notebook-outcomes">
                      {course.outcomes.map((outcome, index) => (
                        <li key={outcome.en}>
                          <span>{String(index + 1).padStart(2, "0")}</span>
                          <p>{t(outcome)}</p>
                        </li>
                      ))}
                    </ol>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className="notebook-button notebook-button-quiet"
                      onClick={() =>
                        select(
                          ordered.find((section) => section.kind === "guidance")
                            ?.kind ||
                            ordered[1]?.kind ||
                            "overview",
                        )
                      }
                    >
                      {label("openSection")}
                      <ArrowUpRight size={16} className="directional" />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                ) : visible.length ? (
                  <div className="resource-grid course-material-grid notebook-material-grid">
                    {visible.map((resource) => (
                      <NotebookResourceCard
                        key={resource.id}
                        resource={resource}
                        course={course}
                        seconds={study.state.resources[resource.id]?.seconds}
                        onOpen={() => open(resource)}
                      />
                    ))}
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <EmptyState
                    title={label("emptyTitle")}
                    description={label("emptyBody")}
                  />
                )}
              </div>
              {study.state.split && (
                <aside className="notebook-companion">
                  <label className="notebook-companion-picker">
                    <span>{s("companion")}</span>
                    <select
                      value={companion?.id || ""}
                      onChange={(event) =>
                        study.update((previous) => ({
                          ...previous,
                          companionId: event.target.value || undefined,
                        }))
                      }
                    >
                      <option value="">{s("choose")}</option>
                      {resources
                        .filter((resource) => resource.id !== selected?.id)
                        .map((resource) => (
                          <option key={resource.id} value={resource.id}>
                            {label(resource.kind)} · {t(resource.title)}
                          </option>
                        ))}
                    </select>
                  </label>
                  {companion ? (
                    <StudyResourceViewer
                      key={`companion:${companion.id}`}
                      item={companion}
                      position={study.state.resources[companion.id]}
                      onPosition={(position) =>
                        savePosition(companion.id, position)
                      }
                      companion
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <div className="notebook-companion-empty">
                      <Columns2 size={30} aria-hidden="true" />
                      <p>{s("choose")}</p>
                    </div>
                  )}
                  <label className="notebook-width-control">
                    <span>
                      {s("width")} · {Math.round(study.state.width)}%
                    </span>
                    <input
                      type="range"
                      min={35}
                      max={65}
                      step={1}
                      value={study.state.width}
                      onChange={(event) =>
                        study.update((previous) => ({
                          ...previous,
                          width: Number(event.target.value),
                        }))
                      }
                    />
                  </label>
                  <p className="notebook-split-hint">{s("splitHint")}</p>
                </aside>
              )}
            </div>
            <footer className="notebook-page-footer">
              <span>
                {courseResourcesLabel(
                  resources.length,
                  label("resourcesCount"),
                )}
              </span>
              <span>{s(study.persistent ? "saved" : "session")}</span>
            </footer>
            {turn && (
              <div
                key={turn.id}
                className="notebook-turn-sheet"
                data-backwards={turn.backwards || undefined}
                aria-hidden="true"
                onAnimationEnd={() => setTurn(null)}
              >
                <div />
                <i />
                <b />
              </div>
            )}
          </section>
          {peekSection && (
            <aside
              className="notebook-peek"
              style={{ top: peekTop }}
              aria-label={s("peek")}
              onPointerEnter={() => {
                if (peekTimer.current) clearTimeout(peekTimer.current);
              }}
              onPointerLeave={scheduleClosePeek}
              onFocusCapture={() => {
                if (peekTimer.current) clearTimeout(peekTimer.current);
              }}
              onBlur={scheduleClosePeek}
              onKeyDown={(event) => {
                if (event.key === "Escape") {
                  event.stopPropagation();
                  dismissPeek();
                }
              }}
            >
              <div className="notebook-peek-head">
                <span>{s("peek")}</span>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="notebook-icon-button"
                  aria-label={label("close")}
                  onClick={dismissPeek}
                >
                  <X size={16} />
                </button>
              </div>
              <h3>{t(peekSection.title)}</h3>
              <p>{t(peekSection.description)}</p>
              {peekResources[0]?.preview?.thumbnailUrl &&
                safeResourceUrl(peekResources[0].preview.thumbnailUrl) && (
                  <img
                    src={safeResourceUrl(peekResources[0].preview.thumbnailUrl)}
                    alt={t(peekResources[0].title)}
                    loading="lazy"
                  />
                )}
              <ul>
                {peekSection.kind === "overview" ? (
                  course.outcomes
                    .slice(0, 3)
                    .map((outcome) => <li key={outcome.en}>{t(outcome)}</li>)
                ) : peekResources.length ? (
                  peekResources.slice(0, 3).map((resource) => (
                    <li key={resource.id}>
                      <strong>{t(resource.title)}</strong>
                      <span>
                        {resource.durationMinutes
                          ? `${resource.durationMinutes} ${s("minutes")}`
                          : `${resource.pages} ${label("pages")}`}
                      </span>
                    </li>
                  ))
                ) : (
                  <li>{s("noResources")}</li>
                )}
              </ul>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="notebook-button notebook-button-primary"
                onClick={() => select(peekSection.kind)}
              >
                {label("openSection")}
                <ArrowUpRight size={16} className="directional" />
              </button>
            </aside>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function courseResourcesLabel(count: number, label: string) {
  return `${count} ${label}`;
}

import { useParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { Sparkles } from "lucide-react";
import { useWorkspacePaths } from "../../hooks/useWorkspacePaths";
import { useCourses, useResources } from "../../hooks/useContent";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { useAuth } from "../../app/providers/AuthProvider";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { EmptyState } from "../../components/feedback/EmptyState";
import { CourseNotebook } from "./CourseNotebook";
import { studyStorageKey } from "./study-state";
import "../../styles/course-notebook.css";

export default function CoursePage() {
  const paths = useWorkspacePaths();
  const { slug } = useParams();
  const courses = useCourses(),
    resources = useResources();
  const { t, label } = useLocale();
  const { snapshot } = useAuth();
  if (courses.isPending || resources.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (courses.isError || resources.isError)
    return (
      <ErrorState
        retry={() => {
          void courses.refetch();
          void resources.refetch();
        }}
      />
    );
  const course = courses.data.find((item) => item.slug === slug);
  if (!course)
    return (
      <div className="container section">
        <EmptyState
          title={label("notFound")}
          description={label("notFoundBody")}
          href={paths.learning}
        />
      </div>
    );
  const key = studyStorageKey(
    snapshot.status === "authenticated" ? snapshot.user!.id : "guest",
    course.id,
  );
  return (
    <div
      className={`container course-atlas course-atlas-${course.accent} course-study-edition`}
    >
      <header className="course-atlas-hero">
        <div className="course-atlas-title">
          <span className="academic-kicker">
            <Sparkles size={14} />
            {label("courseHome")} · {course.code}
          </span>
          <h1 data-page-heading tabIndex={-1}>
            {t(course.title)}
          </h1>
          <p>{t(course.description)}</p>
        </div>
        <dl className="course-atlas-meta">
          <div>
            <dt>{label("year")}</dt>
            <dd>{course.year}</dd>
          </div>
          <div>
            <dt>{label("semester")}</dt>
            <dd>{course.semester}</dd>
          </div>
          <div>
            <dt>{label("credits")}</dt>
            <dd>{course.credits}</dd>
          </div>
        </dl>
        <span className="course-atlas-orbit" aria-hidden="true">
          <i />
          <i />
          <i />
        </span>
      </header>
      <CourseNotebook
        key={key}
        course={course}
        resources={resources.data.filter((item) => item.courseId === course.id)}
        storageKey={key}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

import { BookOpen, Clock3, FileText } from "lucide-react";
import type { Course, Resource } from "../../types/content";
import { ResourceCard } from "../../components/cards/ResourceCard";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { useStudyCopy } from "./study-copy";
import { ResourceProvenance } from "./StudyResourceViewer";
import { safeResourceUrl, timeLabel } from "./study-state";

export function NotebookResourceCard({
  resource,
  course,
  onOpen,
  seconds,
}: {
  resource: Resource;
  course: Course;
  onOpen: () => void;
  seconds?: number;
}) {
  const { t } = useLocale();
  const s = useStudyCopy();
  const thumbnail = safeResourceUrl(resource.preview?.thumbnailUrl);
  return (
    <div className="notebook-material">
      {thumbnail && (
        <img
          src={thumbnail}
          alt={t(resource.title)}
          className="study-resource-thumbnail"
          loading="lazy"
          decoding="async"
          onError={(event) => {
            event.currentTarget.hidden = true;
          }}
        />
      )}
      <ResourceCard resource={resource} course={course} />
      <div className="notebook-material-preview">
        <span className="study-availability">
          <FileText size={14} />
          {s(safeResourceUrl(resource.fileUrl) ? "fileReady" : "previewOnly")}
        </span>
        <p>{t(resource.preview?.excerpt || resource.description)}</p>
        {!!resource.preview?.chapters?.length && (
          <ul>
            {resource.preview.chapters.slice(0, 3).map((chapter, index) => (
              <li key={index}>{t(chapter.title)}</li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
        <ResourceProvenance item={resource} />
        <button
          type="button"
          className="notebook-button notebook-button-primary"
          onClick={onOpen}
        >
          <BookOpen size={17} />
          {s("open")}
          {seconds ? (
            <span>
              <Clock3 size={13} />
              <bdi>{timeLabel(seconds)}</bdi>
            </span>
          ) : null}
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


============================================================
FILE: src/features/courses/StudyResourceViewer.tsx
============================================================
import { useEffect, useId, useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import {
  ArrowUpRight,
  BookOpen,
  CheckCircle2,
  FileText,
  X,
} from "lucide-react";
import type { Resource } from "../../types/content";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { useWorkspace } from "../../app/providers/WorkspaceProvider";
import { SaveButton } from "../../components/cards/SaveButton";
import { formatDate } from "../../lib/dates";
import { useStudyCopy } from "./study-copy";
import { safeResourceUrl, timeLabel, type StudyPosition } from "./study-state";

export function resourceMediaType(item: Resource) {
  if (item.mediaType) return item.mediaType;
  const url = safeResourceUrl(item.fileUrl);
  const path = url ? new URL(url).pathname.toLowerCase() : "";
  if (/\.(mp4|webm|ogg)$/.test(path)) return "video";
  if (/\.(mp3|m4a|wav|oga)$/.test(path)) return "audio";
  if (/\.pdf$/.test(path)) return "pdf";
  if (/\.(png|jpe?g|webp|avif)$/.test(path)) return "image";
  return "external";
}

export function ResourceProvenance({ item }: { item: Resource }) {
  const { t, label, locale } = useLocale();
  const s = useStudyCopy();
  return (
    <details className="study-provenance">
      <summary>{s("provenance")}</summary>
      <dl>
        <div>
          <dt>{label("contributor")}</dt>
          <dd>{t(item.contributor)}</dd>
        </div>
        <div>
          <dt>{s("reviewer")}</dt>
          <dd>{item.reviewer ? t(item.reviewer) : s("noReviewer")}</dd>
        </div>
        <div>
          <dt>{s("updated")}</dt>
          <dd>{formatDate(item.updatedAt, locale)}</dd>
        </div>
      </dl>
      <strong>{s("references")}</strong>
      {item.references?.length ? (
        <ul>
          {item.references.map((reference, index) => {
            const url = safeResourceUrl(reference.url);
            return (
              <li key={index}>
                {url ? (
                  <a href={url} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
                    {t(reference.title)}
                    <ArrowUpRight size={14} aria-hidden="true" />
                  </a>
                ) : (
                  t(reference.title)
                )}
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ul>
      ) : (
        <p>{s("noReferences")}</p>
      )}
    </details>
  );
}

export function StudyResourceViewer({
  item,
  position,
  onPosition,
  onClose,
  companion = false,
}: {
  item: Resource;
  position?: StudyPosition;
  onPosition: (position: Partial<StudyPosition>) => void;
  onClose?: () => void;
  companion?: boolean;
}) {
  const { t, label } = useLocale();
  const s = useStudyCopy();
  const { state, send, isPending } = useWorkspace();
  const pane = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const media = useRef<HTMLMediaElement | null>(null);
  const pageInput = useId();
  const titleId = useId();
  const initial = useRef(position);
  const save = useRef(onPosition);
  save.current = onPosition;
  const [page, setPage] = useState(position?.page || 1);
  const [error, setError] = useState(false);
  const url = safeResourceUrl(item.fileUrl);
  const type = resourceMediaType(item);
  const maxPage = Math.max(1, item.pages);
  const thumbnail = safeResourceUrl(item.preview?.thumbnailUrl);
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (pane.current) pane.current.scrollTop = initial.current?.scroll || 0;
  }, []);
  useEffect(
    () => () => {
      const player = media.current;
      if (player && Number.isFinite(player.currentTime))
        save.current({ seconds: player.currentTime });
    },
    [],
  );
  function rememberMedia() {
    const player = media.current;
    if (player && Number.isFinite(player.currentTime))
      onPosition({ seconds: player.currentTime });
  }
  function restoreMedia() {
    const player = media.current;
    const seconds = initial.current?.seconds || 0;
    if (!player || !seconds) return;
    player.currentTime = Number.isFinite(player.duration)
      ? Math.min(seconds, Math.max(0, player.duration - 0.1))
      : seconds;
  }
  function seek(seconds: number) {
    if (!Number.isFinite(seconds) || seconds < 0 || !media.current || error)
      return;
    media.current.currentTime = Number.isFinite(media.current.duration)
      ? Math.min(seconds, media.current.duration)
      : seconds;
    rememberMedia();
  }
  const mediaEvents = {
    onLoadedMetadata: restoreMedia,
    onTimeUpdate: rememberMedia,
    onPause: rememberMedia,
    onSeeked: rememberMedia,
    onError: () => setError(true),
  };
  return (
    <section
      className={`study-reader ${companion ? "study-reader-companion" : ""}`}
      aria-labelledby={titleId}
    >
      <header className="study-reader-heading">
        <div>
          <span>{label(item.kind)}</span>
          <h3 id={titleId}>{t(item.title)}</h3>
        </div>
        {onClose && (
          <button
            type="button"
            className="notebook-icon-button"
            onClick={onClose}
            aria-label={s("close")}
          >
            <X size={18} />
          </button>
        )}
      </header>
      <div
        ref={pane}
        className="study-reader-scroll"
        tabIndex={0}
        aria-label={`${s("reading")}: ${t(item.title)}`}
        onScroll={(event) =>
          onPosition({ scroll: event.currentTarget.scrollTop })
        }
      >
        {url && !error ? (
          <>
            {type === "video" && (
              <video
                ref={(node) => {
                  media.current = node;
                }}
                controls
                preload="metadata"
                playsInline
                poster={thumbnail}
                aria-label={t(item.title)}
                {...mediaEvents}
              >
                <source src={url} />
              </video>
            )}
            {type === "audio" && (
              <audio
                ref={(node) => {
                  media.current = node;
                }}
                controls
                preload="metadata"
                aria-label={t(item.title)}
                {...mediaEvents}
              >
                <source src={url} />
              </audio>
            )}
            {type === "image" && (
              <img
                className="study-document-image"
                src={url}
                alt={t(item.title)}
                onError={() => setError(true)}
              />
            )}
            {type === "pdf" && (
              <>
                <label className="study-page-control" htmlFor={pageInput}>
                  <span>{s("page")}</span>
                  <input
                    id={pageInput}
                    type="number"
                    inputMode="numeric"
                    min={1}
                    max={maxPage}
                    value={page}
                    onChange={(event) => {
                      const value = Math.min(
                        maxPage,
                        Math.max(
                          1,
                          Math.floor(Number(event.target.value) || 1),
                        ),
                      );
                      setPage(value);
                      onPosition({ page: value });
                    }}
                  />
                  <span>/ {maxPage}</span>
                </label>
                <p className="study-reader-hint">{s("pageHelp")}</p>
                <object
                  className="study-pdf"
                  data={`${url.split("#")[0]}#page=${page}`}
                  type="application/pdf"
                  aria-label={t(item.title)}
                >
                  <p>{s("unpreviewable")}</p>
                </object>
              </>
            )}
            {type === "external" && (
              <p className="study-file-notice">
                <FileText size={20} />
                {s("unpreviewable")}
              </p>
            )}
            <a
              className="study-source-link"
              href={url}
              target="_blank"
              rel="noopener noreferrer"
            >
              {s("openFile")}
              <ArrowUpRight size={16} className="directional" />
            </a>
          </>
        ) : (
          <div className="study-file-notice">
            <BookOpen size={26} aria-hidden="true" />
            <p>{error ? s("fileError") : s("unavailable")}</p>
            {error && url && (
              <a href={url} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
                {s("openFile")}
              </a>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
        {position &&
          position.seconds > 0 &&
          (type === "video" || type === "audio") && (
            <p className="study-resume-time">
              {s("resumeAt")} <bdi>{timeLabel(position.seconds)}</bdi>
            </p>
          )}
        {!!item.preview?.chapters?.length && (
          <ol className="study-chapters">
            {item.preview.chapters
              .filter(
                (chapter) =>
                  Number.isFinite(chapter.seconds) && chapter.seconds >= 0,
              )
              .map((chapter, index) => (
                <li key={index}>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => seek(chapter.seconds)}
                    disabled={
                      !url || error || !["video", "audio"].includes(type)
                    }
                  >
                    <bdi>{timeLabel(chapter.seconds)}</bdi>
                    {t(chapter.title)}
                  </button>
                </li>
              ))}
          </ol>
        )}
        <div className="study-resource-text">
          <h4>{s(item.preview?.excerpt ? "excerpt" : "description")}</h4>
          <p>{t(item.preview?.excerpt || item.description)}</p>
        </div>
        <ResourceProvenance item={item} />
      </div>
      <footer className="study-reader-actions">
        <SaveButton id={item.id} title={t(item.title)} />
        <button
          type="button"
          className="notebook-button notebook-button-quiet"
          disabled={isPending}
          aria-pressed={state.reviewedResourceIds.includes(item.id)}
          onClick={() => void send({ type: "toggle-reviewed", id: item.id })}
        >
          <CheckCircle2 size={17} />
          {label(
            state.reviewedResourceIds.includes(item.id)
              ? "unmarkReviewed"
              : "markReviewed",
          )}
        </button>
      </footer>
    </section>
  );
}

FILE: src/features/events/EventRegistrationAction.tsx
============================================================
import { useState } from "react";
import { Check, TicketCheck, UsersRound, X } from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { Modal } from "../../components/ui/Modal";
import { Button } from "../../components/ui/button";
import { eventAvailability } from "../../lib/discovery";
import { useEventRegistrations } from "../../hooks/useContent";
import type { ClubEvent } from "../../types/content";

export function EventRegistrationAction({ event }: { event: ClubEvent }) {
  const { label } = useLocale();
  const registrations = useEventRegistrations();
  const [confirmCancel, setConfirmCancel] = useState(false);
  const registration = registrations.registrations.find(
    (item) => item.eventId === event.id,
  );
  const availability = eventAvailability(event);
  const canJoin = availability === "open" || availability === "waitlist";

  async function join() {
    try {
      const result = await registrations.register(event.id);
      toast.success(
        label(
          result.status === "registered"
            ? "registrationConfirmed"
            : "waitlistConfirmed",
        ),
      );
    } catch {
      toast.error(label("registrationFailed"));
    }
  }
  async function cancel() {
    try {
      await registrations.cancel(event.id);
      setConfirmCancel(false);
      toast.success(label("registrationCancelled"));
    } catch {
      toast.error(label("registrationFailed"));
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="registration-action">
      {registration ? (
        <>
          <div
            className="registration-confirmed"
            data-status={registration.status}
            role="status"
          >
            <span>
              {registration.status === "registered" ? (
                <Check size={20} />
              ) : (
                <UsersRound size={20} />
              )}
            </span>
            <div>
              <small>{label("registrationStatus")}</small>
              <strong>{label(registration.status)}</strong>
            </div>
          </div>
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            className="button"
            onClick={() => setConfirmCancel(true)}
          >
            <X size={17} />
            {label("cancelRegistration")}
          </Button>
        </>
      ) : (
        <Button
          className="button button-primary registration-button"
          disabled={
            !canJoin || registrations.isMutating || registrations.isPending
          }
          onClick={() => void join()}
        >
          {availability === "waitlist" ? (
            <UsersRound size={18} />
          ) : (
            <TicketCheck size={18} />
          )}
          {label(
            availability === "waitlist"
              ? "joinWaitlist"
              : availability === "upcoming"
                ? "opensSoon"
                : availability === "closed" || availability === "ended"
                  ? "registrationClosed"
                  : "registerEvent",
          )}
        </Button>
      )}
      <Modal
        open={confirmCancel}
        onClose={() => setConfirmCancel(false)}
        title={label("cancelRegistrationTitle")}
        description={label("cancelRegistrationBody")}
      >
        <div className="workspace-form-actions">
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setConfirmCancel(false)}>
            {label("cancel")}
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="destructive"
            disabled={registrations.isMutating}
            onClick={() => void cancel()}
          >
            {label("cancelRegistration")}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/features/events/EventsPage.tsx
============================================================
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import {
  CalendarDays,
  PartyPopper,
  Search,
  TicketCheck,
  UsersRound,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { EventTicketCard } from "../../components/cards/EventTicketCard";
import { AliveTabs } from "../../components/navigation/AliveTabs";
import { EmptyState } from "../../components/feedback/EmptyState";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { useEvents } from "../../hooks/useContent";
import { eventAvailability } from "../../lib/discovery";

type View = "all" | "upcoming" | "open" | "waitlist";
export default function EventsPage() {
  const { t, label } = useLocale();
  const query = useEvents();
  const [view, setView] = useState<View>("upcoming");
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [category, setCategory] = useState("");
  const [format, setFormat] = useState("");
  const events = query.data || [];
  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    const needle = search.trim().toLocaleLowerCase();
    return events.filter((event) => {
      const status = eventAvailability(event);
      const tabMatch =
        view === "all" ||
        (view === "upcoming" ? status !== "ended" : status === view);
      const textMatch =
        !needle ||
        [
          t(event.title),
          t(event.description),
          t(event.location),
          t(event.type),
        ].some((value) => value.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(needle));
      return (
        tabMatch &&
        textMatch &&
        (!category || event.category === category) &&
        (!format || event.format === format)
      );
    });
  }, [events, view, search, category, format, t]);
  if (query.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (query.isError) return <ErrorState retry={() => void query.refetch()} />;
  const tabs = [
    {
      id: "upcoming",
      label: label("eventUpcoming"),
      icon: PartyPopper,
      count: events.filter((event) => eventAvailability(event) !== "ended")
        .length,
    },
    {
      id: "open",
      label: label("eventOpen"),
      icon: TicketCheck,
      count: events.filter((event) => eventAvailability(event) === "open")
        .length,
    },
    {
      id: "waitlist",
      label: label("eventWaitlist"),
      icon: UsersRound,
      count: events.filter((event) => eventAvailability(event) === "waitlist")
        .length,
    },
    {
      id: "all",
      label: label("eventAll"),
      icon: CalendarDays,
      count: events.length,
    },
  ] as const;
  return (
    <div className="discovery-page event-hub container">
      <section className="discovery-hero event-discovery-hero">
        <div className="discovery-hero-copy">
          <span className="eyebrow">{label("eventsHubEyebrow")}</span>
          <h1 tabIndex={-1} data-page-heading>
            {label("eventsHubTitle")}
          </h1>
          <p>{label("eventsHubBody")}</p>
        </div>
        <div className="event-constellation" aria-hidden="true">
          <i />
          <i />
          <i />
          <span>
            <CalendarDays size={28} />
          </span>
          <b>{events.length}</b>
          <small>{label("events")}</small>
        </div>
      </section>
      <section
        className="discovery-controls"
        aria-label={label("eventFilters")}
      >
        <AliveTabs
          label={label("eventFilters")}
          items={[...tabs]}
          value={view}
          onChange={setView}
        />
        <div className="discovery-filter-row">
          <label className="discovery-search">
            <Search size={18} />
            <input
              value={search}
              onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
              placeholder={label("eventSearch")}
            />
          </label>
          <label>
            <span>{label("category")}</span>
            <select
              value={category}
              onChange={(e) => setCategory(e.target.value)}
            >
              <option value="">{label("allCategories")}</option>
              {[
                "workshop",
                "talk",
                "volunteering",
                "conference",
                "training",
              ].map((value) => (
                <option value={value} key={value}>
                  {label(value as "workshop")}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </label>
          <label>
            <span>{label("format")}</span>
            <select value={format} onChange={(e) => setFormat(e.target.value)}>
              <option value="">{label("allTypes")}</option>
              {["onsite", "hybrid", "online"].map((value) => (
                <option value={value} key={value}>
                  {label(value as "onsite")}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </label>
        </div>
      </section>
      <div className="results-line">
        <strong>{filtered.length}</strong> {label("results")}
      </div>
      {filtered.length ? (
        <div className="event-ticket-grid">
          {filtered.map((event) => (
            <EventTicketCard event={event} key={event.id} />
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <EmptyState />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/features/events/MyEventsPage.tsx
============================================================
import { CalendarCheck, PartyPopper } from "lucide-react";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { useWorkspace } from "../../app/providers/WorkspaceProvider";
import { EventTicketCard } from "../../components/cards/EventTicketCard";
import { PageIntro } from "../../components/data-display/PageIntro";
import { EmptyState } from "../../components/feedback/EmptyState";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { AppLink } from "../../components/navigation/AppLink";
import { useEventRegistrations, useEvents } from "../../hooks/useContent";

export default function MyEventsPage() {
  const { label } = useLocale();
  const events = useEvents();
  const registrations = useEventRegistrations();
  const workspace = useWorkspace();
  if (events.isPending || registrations.isPending || workspace.isPending)
    return <LoadingState />;
  if (events.isError || registrations.isError || workspace.isError)
    return (
      <ErrorState
        retry={() => {
          void events.refetch();
          registrations.retry();
          workspace.retry();
        }}
      />
    );
  const planned = (events.data || []).filter((event) =>
    registrations.registrations.some((item) => item.eventId === event.id),
  );
  const saved = (events.data || []).filter(
    (event) =>
      workspace.state.savedIds.includes(event.id) &&
      !planned.some((item) => item.id === event.id),
  );
  return (
    <div className="container personal-discovery-page">
      <PageIntro
        eyebrow={label("myEventsEyebrow")}
        title={label("myEventsTitle")}
        description={label("myEventsBody")}
      />
      {planned.length ? (
        <section>
          <div className="personal-section-heading">
            <div>
              <span className="eyebrow">
                <CalendarCheck size={14} /> {label("registrationStatus")}
              </span>
              <h2>{label("myEvents")}</h2>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="event-ticket-grid">
            {planned.map((event) => {
              const status = registrations.registrations.find(
                (item) => item.eventId === event.id,
              )!.status;
              return (
                <div
                  className="personal-event-plan"
                  data-status={status}
                  key={event.id}
                >
                  <span className="personal-plan-status">{label(status)}</span>
                  <EventTicketCard event={event} />
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </section>
      ) : (
        <EmptyState
          title={label("noEventPlans")}
          description={label("noEventPlansBody")}
          href="/events"
        />
      )}
      {saved.length > 0 && (
        <section className="saved-discovery-section">
          <div className="personal-section-heading">
            <div>
              <span className="eyebrow">
                <PartyPopper size={14} /> {label("discoverSavedEvents")}
              </span>
              <h2>{label("savedShort")}</h2>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="event-ticket-grid">
            {saved.map((event) => (
              <EventTicketCard event={event} key={event.id} />
            ))}
          </div>
        </section>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { ArrowRight } from "lucide-react";
import { useJournal } from "../../../hooks/useContent";
import { useLocale } from "../../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { LoadingState } from "../../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { ErrorState } from "../../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { EmptyState } from "../../../components/feedback/EmptyState";
import { AppLink } from "../../../components/navigation/AppLink";
import { articlePath } from "../../../constants/routes";
export function Journal() {
  const query = useJournal();
  const { t, label } = useLocale();
  if (query.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (query.isError) return <ErrorState retry={() => void query.refetch()} />;
  const article = query.data[0];
  if (!article) return <EmptyState />;
  return (
    <article className="journal-card">
      <span className="eyebrow">
        {t(article.category)} · {article.readMinutes} {label("readMinutes")}
      </span>
      <h3>{t(article.title)}</h3>
      <p>{t(article.excerpt)}</p>

import type { SiteContent, HomeSection } from "../../types/content";
import { useSiteContent } from "../../hooks/useContent";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { visibleSections } from "../../lib/home-sections";
import { SectionHeading } from "../../components/data-display/SectionHeading";
import { Hero } from "./sections/Hero";
import { Announcement } from "./sections/Announcement";
import { QuickAccess } from "./sections/QuickAccess";
import { LatestResources } from "./sections/LatestResources";
import { UpcomingEvents } from "./sections/UpcomingEvents";
import { Opportunities } from "./sections/Opportunities";
import { Journal } from "./sections/Journal";
import { Community } from "./sections/Community";
const registry = {
  pathways: QuickAccess,
  resources: LatestResources,
  events: UpcomingEvents,
  opportunities: Opportunities,
  journal: Journal,
};
function Section({
  section,
  site,
  compact = false,
}: {
  section: HomeSection;
  site: SiteContent;
  compact?: boolean;
}) {
  const { label } = useLocale();
  if (section.type === "announcement")
    return (
      <section id={section.id}>
        <Announcement site={site} />
      </section>
    );
  if (section.type === "community")
    return (
      <section id={section.id} className="container section">
        <Community site={site} />
      </section>
    );
  const Component = registry[section.type];
  return (
    <section
      id={section.id}
      className={
        compact
          ? ""
          : "section " +
            (section.type === "resources" ? "resource-section" : "container")
      }
    >
      <div className={section.type === "resources" ? "container" : undefined}>
        <SectionHeading
          heading={site.headings[section.type]}
          href={
            section.type === "resources"
              ? "/learn"
              : section.type === "events"
                ? "/events"
                : section.type === "opportunities"
                  ? "/opportunities"
                  : section.type === "journal"
                    ? "/journal"
                    : undefined
          }
          linkLabel={label(
            section.type === "events"
              ? "exploreAllEvents"
              : section.type === "opportunities"
                ? "exploreAllOpportunities"
                : section.type === "journal"
                  ? "allArticles"
                  : "browse",
          )}
        />
        <Component site={site} />
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
export default function Homepage() {
  const { data: site } = useSiteContent();
  if (!site) return null;
  const sections = visibleSections(site.sections, new Date());
  return (
    <>
      <Hero hero={site.hero} brand={site.brand} />
      {sections.map((section, index) => {
        if (
          section.type === "opportunities" &&
          sections[index + 1]?.type === "journal"
        )
          return (
            <div className="container growth-wrap section" key={section.id}>
              <Section section={section} site={site} compact />
              <Section section={sections[index + 1]} site={site} compact />
            </div>
          );
        if (
          section.type === "journal" &&
          sections[index - 1]?.type === "opportunities"
        )
          return null;
        return <Section key={section.id} section={section} site={site} />;
      })}
    </>
  );
}

import { useMemo, useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { ArrowUpRight, BookOpenCheck, BrainCircuit, Download, LockKeyhole, Sparkles, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { useWorkspace } from "../../app/providers/WorkspaceProvider";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { AppLink } from "../../components/navigation/AppLink";
import { PageIntro } from "../../components/data-display/PageIntro";
import { useCourses, useResources } from "../../hooks/useContent";
import { downloadCsv } from "../../lib/csv";
import { formatDate } from "../../lib/dates";
import { assessmentPercent, consecutiveStudyDays } from "../../lib/insights";
import { coursePath } from "../../constants/routes";
import { AttemptBars } from "./InsightCharts";
import { useAcademicInsights } from "./useInsights";

export default function AcademicProgressPage() {
  const { label, t, locale } = useLocale();
  const courses = useCourses();
  const resources = useResources();
  const insights = useAcademicInsights();
  const workspace = useWorkspace();
  const [formOpen, setFormOpen] = useState(false);
  const [courseId, setCourseId] = useState("");
  const [title, setTitle] = useState("");
  const [correct, setCorrect] = useState("");
  const [total, setTotal] = useState("");
  const [completedAt, setCompletedAt] = useState("2026-09-08");

  const selectedCourses = useMemo(() => courses.data?.filter((course) => insights.profile.data?.courseIds.includes(course.id)) || [], [courses.data, insights.profile.data?.courseIds]);
  const courseNames = useMemo(() => new Map(selectedCourses.map((course) => [course.id, t(course.title)])), [selectedCourses, t]);
  if (courses.isPending || resources.isPending || insights.isPending || workspace.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (courses.isError || resources.isError || insights.isError || workspace.isError || !insights.record) return <ErrorState retry={() => { void courses.refetch(); void resources.refetch(); insights.retry(); workspace.retry(); }} />;

  const record = insights.record;
  const reviewed = workspace.state.reviewedResourceIds.length;
  const average = record.attempts.length ? Math.round(record.attempts.reduce((sum, attempt) => sum + assessmentPercent(attempt), 0) / record.attempts.length) : 0;
  const streak = consecutiveStudyDays([...record.attempts.map((attempt) => attempt.completedAt), ...workspace.state.studyEntries.map((entry) => entry.date)]);
  const courseSignals = selectedCourses.map((course) => {
    const courseResources = resources.data.filter((resource) => resource.courseId === course.id);
    const ids = new Set(courseResources.map((resource) => resource.id));
    const confidence = record.confidence.find((item) => item.courseId === course.id)?.value;
    return {
      course,
      resources: courseResources.length,
      reviewed: workspace.state.reviewedResourceIds.filter((id) => ids.has(id)).length,
      viewed: new Set(workspace.state.recentResources.filter((item) => ids.has(item.resourceId)).map((item) => item.resourceId)).size,
      saved: workspace.state.savedIds.filter((id) => ids.has(id)).length,
      confidence,
    };
  });
  const next = [...courseSignals].sort((a, b) => (a.confidence || 0) - (b.confidence || 0) || a.reviewed - b.reviewed)[0];

  const setConfidence = async (id: string, value: number) => {
    try { await insights.setConfidence({ courseId: id, value }); }
    catch { toast.error(label("progressSaveFailed")); }
  };
  const submit = async (event: FormEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    try {
      await insights.recordAssessment({ courseId, title, correct: Number(correct), total: Number(total), completedAt });
      setTitle(""); setCorrect(""); setTotal(""); setFormOpen(false);
      toast.success(label("progressAttemptSaved"));
    } catch { toast.error(label("progressSaveFailed")); }
  };
  const remove = async (id: string) => {
    try { await insights.deleteAssessment(id); toast.success(label("progressAttemptDeleted")); }
    catch { toast.error(label("progressSaveFailed")); }
  };
  const exportProgress = () => {
    downloadCsv("my-medclub-study-insights.csv", [
      ["course_id", "course", "confidence", "practice_title", "correct", "total", "completed_at"],
      ...record.attempts.map((attempt) => [attempt.courseId, courseNames.get(attempt.courseId) || attempt.courseId, record.confidence.find((item) => item.courseId === attempt.courseId)?.value || "", attempt.title, attempt.correct, attempt.total, attempt.completedAt]),
    ]);
    toast.success(label("insightsExported"));
  };
  return (
    <div className="container academic-progress-page">
      <section className="progress-hero">
        <PageIntro eyebrow={label("progressEyebrow")} title={label("progressTitle")} description={label("progressBody")} />
        <div className="progress-hero-visual" aria-hidden="true"><BrainCircuit size={30} /><i /><b /><span /></div>
      </section>
      {!record.persistent && <p className="workspace-warning" role="status">{label("progressPersistenceWarning")}</p>}
      <section className="progress-metrics" aria-label={label("myProgress")}>
        <article><span className="progress-metric-mark"><Sparkles size={19} /></span><strong>{streak}</strong><p>{label("progressStudyDays")}</p><small>{label("progressRecorded")}</small></article>
        <article><span className="progress-metric-mark"><BookOpenCheck size={19} /></span><strong>{reviewed}</strong><p>{label("progressResourcesReviewed")}</p><small>{label("progressRecorded")}</small></article>
        <article><span className="progress-metric-mark"><BrainCircuit size={19} /></span><strong>{record.attempts.length ? `${average}%` : "—"}</strong><p>{label("progressPracticeAverage")}</p><small>{label("progressSelfRated")}</small></article>
      </section>
      {next && <AppLink href={coursePath(next.course.slug)} className="progress-next-step"><span><small>{label("progressNextStep")}</small><strong>{t(next.course.title)}</strong><p>{label("progressNextStepBody")}</p></span><ArrowUpRight size={21} className="directional" /></AppLink>}
      <section className="progress-section">
        <header className="progress-section-heading"><div><h2>{label("progressCourseSignals")}</h2><p>{label("progressCourseSignalsBody")}</p></div><button className="button button-secondary" type="button" onClick={exportProgress}><Download size={17} />{label("insightsExport")}</button></header>
        <div className="course-signal-grid">
          {courseSignals.map((signal) => <article key={signal.course.id} className="course-signal-card" data-accent={signal.course.accent}>
            <header><span>{signal.course.code}</span><h3>{t(signal.course.title)}</h3></header>
            <dl><div><dt>{label("progressReviewed")}</dt><dd>{signal.reviewed}/{signal.resources}</dd></div><div><dt>{label("progressViewed")}</dt><dd>{signal.viewed}</dd></div><div><dt>{label("progressSaved")}</dt><dd>{signal.saved}</dd></div></dl>
            <fieldset><legend>{label("progressConfidence")} <small>{label("progressSelfRated")}</small></legend><div className="confidence-scale">{[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((value) => <button type="button" key={value} aria-pressed={signal.confidence === value} aria-label={`${label("progressConfidence")}: ${label(`progressConfidence${value}` as "progressConfidence1")}`} onClick={() => void setConfidence(signal.course.id, value)} disabled={insights.isMutating}>{value}</button>)}</div><p>{signal.confidence ? label(`progressConfidence${signal.confidence}` as "progressConfidence1") : label("progressConfidence1")}</p></fieldset>
            <AppLink href={coursePath(signal.course.slug)}>{label("courseHome")}<ArrowUpRight size={16} className="directional" /></AppLink>
          </article>)}
        </div>
      </section>
      <section className="progress-practice progress-section">
        <header className="progress-section-heading"><div><h2>{label("progressPracticeHistory")}</h2><p>{label("progressPracticeBody")}</p></div><button className="button" type="button" onClick={() => { setCourseId(courseId || selectedCourses[0]?.id || ""); setFormOpen((open) => !open); }}>{label("progressAddAttempt")}</button></header>
        {formOpen && <form className="practice-form" onSubmit={submit}>
          <label><span>{label("progressCourse")}</span><select required value={courseId} onChange={(event) => setCourseId(event.target.value)}>{selectedCourses.map((course) => <option key={course.id} value={course.id}>{t(course.title)}</option>)}</select></label>
          <label><span>{label("progressAssessmentTitle")}</span><input required maxLength={80} value={title} onChange={(event) => setTitle(event.target.value)} /></label>
          <label><span>{label("progressCorrect")}</span><input required type="number" min="0" max="300" value={correct} onChange={(event) => setCorrect(event.target.value)} /></label>
          <label><span>{label("progressTotal")}</span><input required type="number" min="1" max="300" value={total} onChange={(event) => setTotal(event.target.value)} /></label>
          <label><span>{label("progressCompleted")}</span><input required type="date" max="2026-09-08" value={completedAt} onChange={(event) => setCompletedAt(event.target.value)} /></label>
          <button className="button" type="submit" disabled={insights.isMutating}>{label("progressSaveAttempt")}</button>
        </form>}
        {record.attempts.length ? <><AttemptBars attempts={record.attempts} courseNames={courseNames} /><div className="practice-history">{[...record.attempts].sort((a, b) => b.completedAt.localeCompare(a.completedAt)).map((attempt) => <article key={attempt.id}><span><strong>{attempt.title}</strong><small>{courseNames.get(attempt.courseId)} · {formatDate(attempt.completedAt, locale)}</small></span><b>{attempt.correct}/{attempt.total} · {assessmentPercent(attempt)}%</b><button type="button" onClick={() => void remove(attempt.id)} aria-label={`${label("progressDeleteAttempt")}: ${attempt.title}`}><Trash2 size={16} /></button></article>)}</div></> : <p className="progress-empty">{label("progressNoAttempts")}</p>}
      </section>
      <aside className="progress-privacy"><LockKeyhole size={22} /><span><strong>{label("progressPrivacy")}</strong><p>{label("progressPrivacyBody")}</p></span></aside>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/features/insights/InsightCharts.tsx

import type { CSSProperties } from "react";
import type { AnalyticsPoint, AssessmentAttempt } from "../../types/insights";
import { assessmentPercent } from "../../lib/insights";

function pathFor(values: number[]) {
  if (!values.length) return "";
  const min = Math.min(...values);
  const max = Math.max(...values);
  const spread = Math.max(1, max - min);
  return values
    .map((value, index) => {
      const x = values.length === 1 ? 50 : (index / (values.length - 1)) * 100;
      const y = 88 - ((value - min) / spread) * 72;
      return `${index ? "L" : "M"}${x.toFixed(2)} ${y.toFixed(2)}`;
    })
    .join(" ");
}

export function EngagementTrend({
  points,
  labels,
}: {
  points: AnalyticsPoint[];
  labels: { opens: string; searches: string; saves: string; accessible: string };
}) {
  const series = [
    { id: "opens", label: labels.opens, values: points.map((point) => point.resourceOpens) },
    { id: "searches", label: labels.searches, values: points.map((point) => point.searches) },
    { id: "saves", label: labels.saves, values: points.map((point) => point.saves) },
  ];
  return (
    <div className="insight-trend" role="img" aria-label={labels.accessible}>
      <div className="insight-chart-legend" aria-hidden="true">
        {series.map((item) => <span key={item.id} data-series={item.id}><i />{item.label}</span>)}
      </div>
      <svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" preserveAspectRatio="none" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">
        <g className="insight-grid-lines"><path d="M0 16H100M0 40H100M0 64H100M0 88H100" /></g>
        {series.map((item) => <path key={item.id} data-series={item.id} d={pathFor(item.values)} vectorEffect="non-scaling-stroke" />)}
      </svg>
      <div className="insight-chart-dates" aria-hidden="true"><span>{points[0]?.date}</span><span>{points.at(-1)?.date}</span></div>
      <ul className="sr-only">
        {points.map((point) => <li key={point.date}>{point.date}: {labels.opens} {point.resourceOpens}, {labels.searches} {point.searches}, {labels.saves} {point.saves}</li>)}
      </ul>
    </div>
  );
}

export function AttemptBars({ attempts, courseNames }: { attempts: AssessmentAttempt[]; courseNames: Map<string, string> }) {
  const visible = [...attempts].sort((a, b) => a.completedAt.localeCompare(b.completedAt)).slice(-8);
  return (
    <div className="attempt-bars" aria-label="Practice result chart">
      {visible.map((attempt) => {
        const score = assessmentPercent(attempt);
        return (
          <div className="attempt-bar" key={attempt.id} title={`${attempt.title}: ${score}%`}>
            <span className="attempt-bar-fill" style={{ "--score": score } as CSSProperties} />
            <strong>{score}%</strong>
            <small>{courseNames.get(attempt.courseId) || attempt.courseId}</small>
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

import { toast } from "sonner";
import { UsersRound } from "lucide-react";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { MentorshipSessionCard } from "../../components/cards/MentorshipSessionCard";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { MentorshipNavigation } from "../../components/navigation/MentorshipNavigation";
import {
  useMentors,
  useMentorshipSessions,
  useMentorshipWorkspace,
} from "../../hooks/useContent";

export default function GroupSessionsPage() {
  const { label } = useLocale();
  const mentors = useMentors();
  const sessions = useMentorshipSessions();
  const workspace = useMentorshipWorkspace();
  const pending =
    mentors.isPending || sessions.isPending || workspace.isPending;
  const failed = mentors.isError || sessions.isError || workspace.isError;
  if (pending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (failed)
    return (
      <ErrorState
        retry={() => {
          void mentors.refetch();
          void sessions.refetch();
          workspace.retry();
        }}
      />
    );
  async function toggle(sessionId: string, joined: boolean) {
    try {
      if (joined) await workspace.cancelSession(sessionId);
      else await workspace.registerSession(sessionId);
      toast.success(label(joined ? "sessionLeft" : "sessionJoined"));
    } catch {
      toast.error(label("sessionActionFailed"));
    }
  }
  return (
    <div className="mentorship-v6 group-sessions-page container">
      <MentorshipNavigation />
      <header className="v6-page-intro">
        <div>
          <span className="eyebrow">{label("groupSessionsEyebrow")}</span>
          <h1 tabIndex={-1} data-page-heading>
            {label("groupSessionsTitle")}
          </h1>
          <p>{label("groupSessionsBody")}</p>
        </div>
        <span className="v6-intro-icon" aria-hidden="true">
          <UsersRound size={38} />
          <i />
        </span>
      </header>
      <div className="mentor-session-list">
        {sessions.data?.map((session) => {
          const joined = workspace.registrations.some(
            (item) => item.sessionId === session.id,
          );
          return (
            <MentorshipSessionCard
              key={session.id}
              session={session}
              mentor={mentors.data?.find(
                (item) => item.id === session.mentorId,
              )}
              joined={joined}
              busy={workspace.isMutating}
              onToggle={() => void toggle(session.id, joined)}
            />
          );
        })}
      </div>
      <p className="v6-boundary-note">{label("mentorPreviewNotice")}</p>
    </div>
  );
}
