FILE: src/features/search/SearchPanel.tsx
============================================================
import { useState } from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import {
  ArrowUpRight,
  BookOpen,
  FileText,
  CalendarDays,
  Compass,
  Newspaper,
  LoaderCircle,
  History,
  HeartHandshake,
  UsersRound,
  ShoppingBag,
  BriefcaseBusiness,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { useOverlays } from "../../app/providers/OverlayProvider";
import { useWorkspace } from "../../app/providers/WorkspaceProvider";
import { useWorkspacePaths } from "../../hooks/useWorkspacePaths";
import { useDebouncedValue } from "../../hooks/useDebouncedValue";
import { useCourses } from "../../hooks/useContent";
import { useSearch } from "./useSearch";
import { SelectField } from "../../components/forms/SelectField";
import { Button } from "../../components/ui/button";
import { AppLink } from "../../components/navigation/AppLink";
import {
  Command,
  CommandInput,
  CommandList,
  CommandEmpty,
  CommandGroup,
  CommandItem,
} from "../../components/ui/command";
import type { SearchFilters, SearchResult } from "../../types/content";
const kinds = [
  "course",
  "resource",
  "event",
  "opportunity",
  "article",
  "mentor",
  "mentorship-session",
  "product",
  "position",
] as const;
const formats = [
  "guidance",
  "slides",
  "notes",
  "summary",
  "recording",
  "book",
  "questions",
  "external",
] as const;
const icons = {
  course: BookOpen,
  resource: FileText,
  event: CalendarDays,
  opportunity: Compass,
  article: Newspaper,
  mentor: HeartHandshake,
  "mentorship-session": UsersRound,
  product: ShoppingBag,
  position: BriefcaseBusiness,
};
export function SearchPanel({
  compact = false,
  initialQuery = "",
}: {
  compact?: boolean;
  initialQuery?: string;
}) {
  const { label, t } = useLocale();
  const navigate = useNavigate(),
    paths = useWorkspacePaths();
  const { closeSearch, openDetail } = useOverlays();
  const { state, send } = useWorkspace();
  const courses = useCourses();
  const [query, setQuery] = useState(initialQuery);
  const [scope, setScope] = useState<"all" | "my">(
    paths.personal ? "my" : "all",
  );
  const [filters, setFilters] = useState<SearchFilters>({});
  const value = useDebouncedValue(query);
  const result = useSearch(value, scope, filters);
  const pending = !result.isError && (result.isPending || value !== query);
  const updateFilter = (field: keyof SearchFilters, value: string) =>
    setFilters((f) => ({ ...f, [field]: value || undefined }));
  const choose = (item: SearchResult) => {
    if (query.trim()) void send({ type: "remember-search", query });
    if (item.record.kind === "course") {
      closeSearch();
      navigate(paths.course(item.record.item.slug));
    } else if (item.record.kind === "mentor") {
      closeSearch();
      navigate(
        `/mentorship?mentor=${encodeURIComponent(item.record.item.slug)}`,
      );
    } else if (item.record.kind === "mentorship-session") {
      closeSearch();
      navigate("/mentorship/sessions");
    } else if (item.record.kind === "product") {
      closeSearch();
      navigate(`/store/products/${encodeURIComponent(item.record.item.slug)}`);
    } else if (item.record.kind === "position") {
      closeSearch();
      navigate(`/recruitment/${encodeURIComponent(item.record.item.slug)}`);
    } else openDetail(item.record);
  };
  const results = result.data || [];
  const suggestions = state.recentSearches.length
    ? state.recentSearches
    : ["physiology", "cardio", "research"];
  return (
    <div
      className={compact ? "search-panel search-panel-compact" : "search-panel"}
    >
      <Command shouldFilter={false} label={label("search")} loop>
        <CommandInput
          value={query}
          onValueChange={setQuery}
          placeholder={label("searchPlaceholder")}
          aria-label={label("search")}
        />
        <div className="search-controls">
          <SelectField
            label={label("searchScope")}
            value={scope}
            onChange={(e) => setScope(e.target.value as "all" | "my")}
          >
            <option value="all">{label("everywhereScope")}</option>
            <option value="my">{label("myLearningScope")}</option>
          </SelectField>
          <SelectField
            label={label("searchType")}
            value={filters.type || ""}
            onChange={(e) => updateFilter("type", e.target.value)}
          >
            <option value="">{label("allContent")}</option>
            {kinds.map((k) => (
              <option key={k} value={k}>
                {label(k === "mentorship-session" ? "mentorshipSession" : k)}
              </option>
            ))}
          </SelectField>
          {!compact && (
            <>
              <SelectField
                label={label("searchTrack")}
                value={filters.track || ""}
                onChange={(e) => updateFilter("track", e.target.value)}
              >
                <option value="">{label("allTracks")}</option>
                <option value="basic">{label("basic")}</option>
                <option value="clinical">{label("clinical")}</option>
              </SelectField>
              <SelectField
                label={label("searchResourceKind")}
                value={filters.resourceKind || ""}
                onChange={(e) => updateFilter("resourceKind", e.target.value)}
              >
                <option value="">{label("allFormats")}</option>
                {formats.map((k) => (
                  <option key={k} value={k}>
                    {label(k)}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </SelectField>
              <SelectField
                label={label("course")}
                value={filters.courseId || ""}
                onChange={(e) => updateFilter("courseId", e.target.value)}
              >
                <option value="">{label("allCourses")}</option>
                {courses.data?.map((c) => (
                  <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>
                    {t(c.title)}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </SelectField>
            </>
          )}
          <button
            className="quiet-button"
            onClick={() => {
              setFilters({});
              setQuery("");
            }}
          >
            {label("clearFilters")}
          </button>
        </div>
        {!query && (
          <div className="search-recents">
            <span>
              <History size={14} />
              {label(
                state.recentSearches.length
                  ? "recentSearches"
                  : "suggestedSearches",
              )}
            </span>
            <div>
              {suggestions.map((q) => (
                <button key={q} onClick={() => setQuery(q)}>
                  {q}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
            {!!state.recentSearches.length && (
              <button
                className="quiet-button"
                onClick={() => void send({ type: "clear-searches" })}
              >
                {label("clearHistory")}
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
        <p className="search-count" role="status" aria-live="polite">
          {pending
            ? label("loading")
            : result.isError
              ? label("searchFailed")
              : `${results.length} ${label("resultsFound")}`}
        </p>
        <CommandList
          aria-label={label("searchResults")}
          className="workspace-search-results"
        >
          {pending ? (
            <div className="search-loading">
              <LoaderCircle className="animate-spin" />
            </div>
          ) : result.isError ? (
            <div className="search-loading" role="alert">
              <p>{label("searchFailed")}</p>
              <Button variant="outline" onClick={result.retry}>
                {label("retry")}
              </Button>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <>
              <CommandEmpty>
                <strong>{label("nothingFound")}</strong>
                <p>{label("searchReset")}</p>
              </CommandEmpty>
              {kinds.map((kind) => {
                const rows = results.filter((r) => r.record.kind === kind);
                const Icon = icons[kind];
                return (
                  rows.length > 0 && (
                    <CommandGroup
                      key={kind}
                      heading={label(
                        kind === "mentorship-session"
                          ? "mentorshipSession"
                          : kind,
                      )}
                    >
                      {rows.map((row) => (
                        <CommandItem
                          key={row.id}
                          value={row.id}
                          onSelect={() => choose(row)}
                        >
                          <span className="search-kind-icon">
                            <Icon size={19} />
                          </span>
                          <div className="search-result-copy">
                            <strong>{t(row.title)}</strong>
                            <small>{t(row.subtitle)}</small>
                            {query && (
                              <span className="search-reason">
                                {label(
                                  row.matchReason === "title"
                                    ? "matchTitle"
                                    : row.matchReason === "course"
                                      ? "matchCourse"
                                      : "matchKeyword",
                                )}
                              </span>
                            )}
                          </div>
                          <ArrowUpRight size={17} className="directional" />
                        </CommandItem>
                      ))}
                    </CommandGroup>
                  )
                );
              })}
            </>
          )}
        </CommandList>
      </Command>
      <div className="search-footer">
        <span>{label("searchHelp")}</span>
        {compact && (
          <AppLink
            href={`${paths.personal ? "/my/search" : "/search"}?q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}`}
            onClick={closeSearch}
          >
            {label("seeAllResults")} <ArrowUpRight size={14} />
          </AppLink>
        )}
      </div>
      {!compact && (
        <p className="workspace-note">{label("searchMetadataNote")}</p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/features/store/CartPage.tsx
============================================================
import { useState } from "react";
import { Minus, PackageCheck, Plus, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { EmptyState } from "../../components/feedback/EmptyState";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { StoreNavigation } from "../../components/navigation/StoreNavigation";
import { Modal } from "../../components/ui/Modal";
import { Button } from "../../components/ui/button";
import { useStoreProducts, useStoreWorkspace } from "../../hooks/useContent";
import { cartSubtotal, formatStorePrice } from "../../lib/store";
import { ProductVisual } from "./ProductVisual";

export default function CartPage() {
  const { label, t, locale } = useLocale();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const products = useStoreProducts();
  const store = useStoreWorkspace();
  const [confirming, setConfirming] = useState(false);
  if (products.isPending || store.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (products.isError || store.isError)
    return (
      <ErrorState
        retry={() => {
          void products.refetch();
          store.retry();
        }}
      />
    );
  const rows = store.cart.lines.flatMap((line) => {
    const product = products.data?.find((item) => item.id === line.productId);
    const variant = product?.variants.find(
      (item) => item.id === line.variantId,
    );
    return product && variant ? [{ line, product, variant }] : [];
  });
  const subtotal = cartSubtotal(store.cart, products.data || []);
  async function change(
    productId: string,
    variantId: string,
    quantity: number,
  ) {
    try {
      await store.setQuantity({ productId, variantId, quantity });
    } catch {
      toast.error(label("maxStockReached"));
    }
  }
  async function remove(productId: string, variantId: string) {
    try {
      await store.remove({ productId, variantId });
    } catch {
      toast.error(label("cartError"));
    }
  }
  async function reserve() {
    try {
      await store.reserve();
      setConfirming(false);
      toast.success(label("reservationCreated"));
      navigate("/my/orders");
    } catch {
      toast.error(label("reserveFailed"));
    }
  }
  return (
    <div className="container store-v7 cart-page">
      <StoreNavigation />
      <header className="cart-header">
        <span className="eyebrow">{label("reservationSummary")}</span>
        <h1 tabIndex={-1} data-page-heading>
          {label("cartTitle")}
        </h1>
        <p>{label("cartBody")}</p>
      </header>
      {rows.length ? (
        <div className="cart-layout">
          <section className="cart-lines" aria-label={label("cart")}>
            {rows.map(({ line, product, variant }) => (
              <article key={`${line.productId}:${line.variantId}`}>
                <ProductVisual visual={product.visual} />
                <div className="cart-line-copy">
                  <span>{label(product.category)}</span>
                  <h2>{t(product.name)}</h2>
                  <p>{t(variant.label)}</p>
                  <strong>{formatStorePrice(product.priceFils, locale)}</strong>
                </div>
                <div className="cart-line-actions">
                  <div
                    className="quantity-stepper"
                    aria-label={label("quantity")}
                  >
                    <button
                      aria-label={label("decreaseQuantity")}
                      onClick={() =>
                        void change(product.id, variant.id, line.quantity - 1)
                      }
                    >
                      <Minus size={16} />
                    </button>
                    <output>{line.quantity}</output>
                    <button
                      aria-label={label("increaseQuantity")}
                      disabled={line.quantity >= variant.stock}
                      onClick={() =>
                        void change(product.id, variant.id, line.quantity + 1)
                      }
                    >
                      <Plus size={16} />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                  <button
                    className="cart-remove"
                    aria-label={`${label("removeItem")} ${t(product.name)}`}
                    onClick={() => void remove(product.id, variant.id)}
                  >
                    <Trash2 size={17} /> {label("removeItem")}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </article>
            ))}
          </section>
          <aside className="cart-summary">
            <span className="summary-icon">
              <PackageCheck />
            </span>
            <h2>{label("reservationSummary")}</h2>
            <dl>
              <div>
                <dt>{label("products")}</dt>
                <dd>{rows.length}</dd>
              </div>
              <div>
                <dt>{label("subtotal")}</dt>
                <dd>{formatStorePrice(subtotal, locale)}</dd>
              </div>
            </dl>
            <Button
              className="button button-primary"
              onClick={() => setConfirming(true)}
            >
              {label("reserveForPickup")}
            </Button>
            <p>{label("noPaymentNow")}</p>
          </aside>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <EmptyState
          title={label("cartEmpty")}
          description={label("cartEmptyBody")}
          href="/store"
          actionLabel={label("continueShopping")}
        />
      )}
      <p className="store-boundary-note">{label("storePreviewNotice")}</p>
      <Modal
        open={confirming}
        onClose={() => setConfirming(false)}
        title={label("reserveTitle")}
        description={label("reserveBody")}
      >
        <div className="workspace-form-actions">
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setConfirming(false)}>
            {label("cancel")}
          </Button>
          <Button
            className="button button-primary"
            disabled={store.isMutating}
            onClick={() => void reserve()}
          >
            {label("confirmReservation")}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState } from "react";
import {
  CheckCircle2,
  Clock3,
  PackageCheck,
  ShoppingBag,
  XCircle,
} from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { PageIntro } from "../../components/data-display/PageIntro";
import { EmptyState } from "../../components/feedback/EmptyState";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { StoreNavigation } from "../../components/navigation/StoreNavigation";
import { Modal } from "../../components/ui/Modal";
import { Button } from "../../components/ui/button";
import { useStoreWorkspace } from "../../hooks/useContent";
import { formatDate } from "../../lib/dates";
import { formatStorePrice } from "../../lib/store";
import type { StoreOrder } from "../../types/content";

const progress = ["reserved", "confirmed", "ready", "collected"] as const;
export default function MyOrdersPage() {
  const { label, t, locale } = useLocale();
  const store = useStoreWorkspace();
  const [cancelling, setCancelling] = useState<StoreOrder | null>(null);
  if (store.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (store.isError) return <ErrorState retry={store.retry} />;
  async function cancel() {
    if (!cancelling) return;
    try {
      await store.cancelOrder(cancelling.id);
      setCancelling(null);
      toast.success(label("orderCancelled"));
    } catch {
      toast.error(label("orderActionFailed"));
    }
  }
  return (
    <div className="container store-v7 my-orders-page">
      <PageIntro
        eyebrow={label("myOrdersEyebrow")}
        title={label("myOrdersTitle")}
        description={label("myOrdersBody")}
      />
      <StoreNavigation />
      {store.orders.length ? (
        <div className="order-list">
          {store.orders.map((order) => {
            const current = progress.indexOf(
              order.status as (typeof progress)[number],
            );
            return (
              <article
                className="order-card"
                key={order.id}
                data-status={order.status}
              >
                <header>
                  <span className="order-mark">
                    {order.status === "cancelled" ? (
                      <XCircle />
                    ) : order.status === "ready" ? (
                      <PackageCheck />
                    ) : (
                      <Clock3 />
                    )}
                  </span>
                  <div>
                    <small>{label("orderNumber")}</small>
                    <h2>{order.number}</h2>
                  </div>
                  <span className="order-status">{label(order.status)}</span>
                </header>
                <div className="order-lines">
                  {order.lines.map((line) => (
                    <div key={`${line.productId}:${line.variantId}`}>
                      <span>
                        <ShoppingBag size={17} />
                      </span>
                      <p>
                        <strong>{t(line.name)}</strong>
                        <small>
                          {t(line.variantLabel)} · {line.quantity}
                        </small>
                      </p>
                      <b>
                        {formatStorePrice(
                          line.unitPriceFils * line.quantity,
                          locale,
                        )}
                      </b>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
                {order.status !== "cancelled" && (
                  <section
                    className="order-progress"
                    aria-label={label("orderTimeline")}
                  >
                    {progress.map((status, index) => (
                      <div
                        key={status}
                        data-complete={index <= current || undefined}
                        data-current={status === order.status || undefined}
                      >
                        <span>
                          {index < current ? <CheckCircle2 /> : index + 1}
                        </span>
                        <small>{label(status)}</small>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </section>
                )}
                <dl className="order-facts">
                  <div>
                    <dt>{label("orderedOn")}</dt>
                    <dd>{formatDate(order.reservedAt, locale)}</dd>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <dt>{label("pickupLocation")}</dt>
                    <dd>{t(order.pickupLocation)}</dd>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <dt>{label("orderTotal")}</dt>
                    <dd>{formatStorePrice(order.totalFils, locale)}</dd>
                  </div>
                  {order.reservationExpiresAt && (
                    <div>
                      <dt>{label("reservationExpires")}</dt>
                      <dd>{formatDate(order.reservationExpiresAt, locale)}</dd>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </dl>
                {order.status === "reserved" && (
                  <footer>
                    <Button
                      variant="outline"
                      onClick={() => setCancelling(order)}
                    >
                      {label("cancelOrder")}
                    </Button>
                  </footer>
                )}
              </article>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <EmptyState
          title={label("noOrders")}
          description={label("noOrdersBody")}
        />
      )}
      <p className="store-boundary-note">{label("storePreviewNotice")}</p>
      <Modal
        open={!!cancelling}
        onClose={() => setCancelling(null)}
        title={label("cancelOrderTitle")}
        description={label("cancelOrderBody")}
      >
        <div className="workspace-form-actions">
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setCancelling(null)}>
            {label("cancel")}
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="destructive"
            disabled={store.isMutating}
            onClick={() => void cancel()}
          >
            {label("cancelOrder")}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/features/store/ProductPage.tsx
============================================================
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { ArrowLeft, Boxes, Minus, Plus, ShoppingCart } from "lucide-react";
import { useParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { StoreNavigation } from "../../components/navigation/StoreNavigation";
import { ActionLink } from "../../components/ui/ActionLink";
import { Button } from "../../components/ui/button";
import { useStoreProduct, useStoreWorkspace } from "../../hooks/useContent";
import { formatStorePrice, productStock } from "../../lib/store";
import { ProductVisual } from "./ProductVisual";

export default function ProductPage() {
  const { slug } = useParams();
  const { label, t, locale } = useLocale();
  const query = useStoreProduct(slug);
  const store = useStoreWorkspace();
  const [variantId, setVariantId] = useState("");
  const [quantity, setQuantity] = useState(1);
  useEffect(() => {
    const first = query.data?.variants.find((variant) => variant.stock > 0);
    const selected = query.data?.variants.find(
      (variant) => variant.id === variantId && variant.stock > 0,
    );
    if (first && !selected) {
      setVariantId(first.id);
      setQuantity(1);
    }
  }, [query.data, variantId]);
  const variant = useMemo(
    () => query.data?.variants.find((item) => item.id === variantId),
    [query.data, variantId],
  );
  if (query.isPending || store.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (query.isError || store.isError)
    return (
      <ErrorState
        retry={() => {
          void query.refetch();
          store.retry();
        }}
      />
    );
  const product = query.data;
  if (!product)
    return (
      <div className="container not-found">
        <h1>{label("notFound")}</h1>
        <ActionLink href="/store">{label("backToStore")}</ActionLink>
      </div>
    );
  const stock = productStock(product);
  async function add() {
    if (!variant || quantity > variant.stock) return;
    try {
      await store.add({
        productId: product!.id,
        variantId: variant.id,
        quantity,
      });
      toast.success(label("addedToCart"));
    } catch {
      toast.error(label("cartError"));
    }
  }
  return (
    <div className="container store-v7 product-page">
      <StoreNavigation />
      <div className="store-back-link">
        <ActionLink href="/store">
          <ArrowLeft size={17} className="directional" /> {label("backToStore")}
        </ActionLink>
      </div>
      <div className="product-detail-layout" data-accent={product.accent}>
        <div className="product-detail-visual">
          <ProductVisual visual={product.visual} />
          <span>{label(product.category)}</span>
        </div>
        <section className="product-detail-copy">
          {product.featured && (
            <span className="product-featured">{label("featured")}</span>
          )}
          <h1 tabIndex={-1} data-page-heading>
            {t(product.name)}
          </h1>
          <p className="product-lead">{t(product.description)}</p>
          <div className="product-price-row">
            <strong>{formatStorePrice(product.priceFils, locale)}</strong>
            {product.compareAtFils && (
              <s>{formatStorePrice(product.compareAtFils, locale)}</s>
            )}
          </div>
          <div
            className="product-stock product-stock-large"
            data-stock={
              stock === 0 ? "soldOut" : stock <= 5 ? "lowStock" : "inStock"
            }
          >
            <Boxes size={18} />
            {label(
              stock === 0 ? "soldOut" : stock <= 5 ? "lowStock" : "inStock",
            )}
          </div>
          <fieldset className="variant-picker">
            <legend>{label("chooseVariant")}</legend>
            <div>
              {product.variants.map((option) => (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  key={option.id}
                  className={variantId === option.id ? "active" : ""}
                  aria-pressed={variantId === option.id}
                  disabled={option.stock === 0}
                  onClick={() => {
                    setVariantId(option.id);
                    setQuantity(1);
                  }}
                >
                  <strong>{t(option.label)}</strong>
                  <small>
                    {option.stock
                      ? `${option.stock} ${label("leftInStock")}`
                      : label("soldOut")}
                  </small>
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </fieldset>
          <div className="product-purchase-row">
            <div className="quantity-stepper" aria-label={label("quantity")}>
              <button
                aria-label={label("decreaseQuantity")}
                disabled={quantity <= 1}
                onClick={() => setQuantity((value) => value - 1)}
              >
                <Minus size={17} />
              </button>
              <output>{quantity}</output>
              <button
                aria-label={label("increaseQuantity")}
                disabled={!variant || quantity >= variant.stock}
                onClick={() => setQuantity((value) => value + 1)}
              >
                <Plus size={17} />
              </button>
            </div>
            <Button
              className="button button-primary"
              disabled={!variant || !variant.stock || store.isMutating}
              onClick={() => void add()}
            >
              <ShoppingCart size={18} /> {label("addToCart")}
            </Button>
          </div>
          <section className="product-materials">
            <h2>{label("materials")}</h2>
            <ul>
              {product.materials.map((item) => (
                <li key={item.en}>{t(item)}</li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </section>
        </section>
      </div>
      <p className="store-boundary-note">{label("storePreviewNotice")}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/features/store/README.md
============================================================
# Store feature — V0.7

## Screens

- `StorePage.tsx`: catalog, category tabs, query/material matching and stock filtering.
- `ProductPage.tsx`: product details, variants, quantity and add-to-cart behavior.
- `CartPage.tsx`: cart editing and explicit collection-reservation confirmation.
- `MyOrdersPage.tsx`: personal order state, progress, collection details and cancellation.
- `ProductVisual.tsx`: reusable icon-led visual language that does not pretend mock photography is real merchandise.

## Data flow

Screens use `useStoreProducts`, `useStoreProduct` and `useStoreWorkspace`. Those hooks call the injected `MedClubServices.store` contract. The current implementation delegates to `local-store.service.ts`; a future implementation can call an authenticated API without changing page component responsibilities.

Product/catalog fixtures live in `data/mock/store.ts`, not inside JSX. Money is stored as integer JOD fils and formatted only at the presentation layer. Order lines snapshot display and price data for stable history.

## Production boundary

Local storage is preview state, not a commerce or security system. Production must move identity, prices, stock, reservations, expiry, cancellation, checkout, fulfillment, refunds, reports, permissions, audit history and notifications to server-owned services.

V0.7 collects no payment details. The reservation action only demonstrates the approved UX boundary while payment, delivery and refund operations remain undecided.

FILE: src/features/store/StorePage.tsx
============================================================
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import {
  Boxes,
  PackageSearch,
  Search,
  ShoppingBag,
  Sparkles,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { ProductCard } from "../../components/cards/ProductCard";
import { EmptyState } from "../../components/feedback/EmptyState";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { AliveTabs } from "../../components/navigation/AliveTabs";
import { StoreNavigation } from "../../components/navigation/StoreNavigation";
import { useStoreProducts, useStoreWorkspace } from "../../hooks/useContent";
import { productStock } from "../../lib/store";
import type { ProductCategory } from "../../types/content";

type View = "all" | ProductCategory;
export default function StorePage() {
  const { label, t } = useLocale();
  const products = useStoreProducts();
  const store = useStoreWorkspace();
  const [view, setView] = useState<View>("all");
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [inStockOnly, setInStockOnly] = useState(false);
  const rows = useMemo(() => {
    const needle = search.trim().toLocaleLowerCase();
    return (products.data || []).filter((product) => {
      const haystack = [
        t(product.name),
        t(product.shortDescription),
        t(product.description),
        ...product.materials.map(t),
      ]
        .join(" ")
        .toLocaleLowerCase();
      return (
        (view === "all" || product.category === view) &&
        (!inStockOnly || productStock(product) > 0) &&
        (!needle || haystack.includes(needle))
      );
    });
  }, [inStockOnly, products.data, search, t, view]);
  if (products.isPending || store.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (products.isError || store.isError)
    return (
      <ErrorState
        retry={() => {
          void products.refetch();
          store.retry();
        }}
      />
    );
  const counts = (category?: ProductCategory) =>
    (products.data || []).filter(
      (product) => !category || product.category === category,
    ).length;
  const tabs = [
    {
      id: "all",
      label: label("allProducts"),
      icon: ShoppingBag,
      count: counts(),
    },
    {
      id: "apparel",
      label: label("apparel"),
      icon: Sparkles,
      count: counts("apparel"),
    },
    {
      id: "stationery",
      label: label("stationery"),
      icon: PackageSearch,
      count: counts("stationery"),
    },
    {
      id: "accessories",
      label: label("accessories"),
      icon: Boxes,
      count: counts("accessories"),
    },
    {
      id: "drinkware",
      label: label("drinkware"),
      icon: ShoppingBag,
      count: counts("drinkware"),
    },
  ] as const;
  return (
    <div className="container store-v7 store-page">
      <StoreNavigation />
      <section className="store-hero">
        <div>
          <span className="eyebrow">{label("storeEyebrow")}</span>
          <h1 tabIndex={-1} data-page-heading>
            {label("storeTitle")}
          </h1>
          <p>{label("storeBody")}</p>
        </div>
        <div className="store-shelf-signal" aria-hidden="true">
          <span>
            <ShoppingBag />
          </span>
          <i />
          <i />
          <i />
          <b>07</b>
        </div>
      </section>
      <section className="store-controls" aria-label={label("productFilters")}>
        <AliveTabs
          label={label("productFilters")}
          items={[...tabs]}
          value={view}
          onChange={setView}
        />
        <div className="store-filter-row">
          <label className="store-search">
            <Search size={18} />
            <input
              value={search}
              onChange={(event) => setSearch(event.target.value)}
              placeholder={label("storeSearch")}
            />
          </label>
          <label className="stock-toggle">
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              checked={inStockOnly}
              onChange={(event) => setInStockOnly(event.target.checked)}
            />
            <span aria-hidden="true">
              <i />
            </span>
            {label("inStockOnly")}
          </label>
        </div>
      </section>
      <p className="store-results" role="status">
        <strong>{rows.length}</strong> {label("products")}
      </p>
      {rows.length ? (
        <div className="product-grid">
          {rows.map((product) => (
            <ProductCard key={product.id} product={product} />
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <EmptyState />
      )}
      <p className="store-boundary-note">{label("storePreviewNotice")}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

import { ArrowUpRight, Clock3, BookOpen, Check, Sparkles } from "lucide-react";
import { useResources, useStudentProfile } from "../../hooks/useContent";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { useWorkspace } from "../../app/providers/WorkspaceProvider";
import { useOverlays } from "../../app/providers/OverlayProvider";
import { useCalendar } from "../calendar/useCalendar";
import { useNotifications } from "../notifications/useNotifications";
import { AppLink } from "../../components/navigation/AppLink";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { DEMO_TODAY } from "../../constants/config";
import { calendarDate, dateAtNoon } from "../../lib/calendar";
import { formatDate } from "../../lib/dates";
export function StudyOverview() {
  const { label, t, locale } = useLocale(),
    { state } = useWorkspace();
  const { openDetail } = useOverlays();
  const resources = useResources(),
    profile = useStudentProfile(),
    calendar = useCalendar(),
    notifications = useNotifications();
  if (
    resources.isError ||
    profile.isError ||
    calendar.isError ||
    notifications.isError
  )
    return (
      <ErrorState
        retry={() => {
          void resources.refetch();
          void profile.refetch();
          calendar.retry();
          notifications.retry();
        }}
      />
    );
  if (
    resources.isPending ||
    profile.isPending ||
    calendar.isPending ||
    notifications.isPending
  )
    return <LoadingState />;
  const mine = resources.data.filter((r) =>
    profile.data.courseIds.includes(r.courseId),
  );
  const recent = state.recentResources.flatMap((entry) => {
    const resource = mine.find((r) => r.id === entry.resourceId);
    return resource ? [{ resource, viewedAt: entry.viewedAt }] : [];
  });
  const latest = recent[0]?.resource;
  const reviewed = mine.filter((r) =>
    state.reviewedResourceIds.includes(r.id),
  ).length;
  const upcoming = calendar.items
    .filter((i) => calendarDate(i.startsAt) >= DEMO_TODAY)
    .slice(0, 3);
  const updates = [...mine]
    .sort((a, b) => Date.parse(b.updatedAt) - Date.parse(a.updatedAt))
    .slice(0, 3);
  return (
    <div className="study-overview">
      <div className="study-thread-grid">
        <section className="continue-thread">
          <div className="thread-orbits" aria-hidden="true">
            <i />
            <i />
            <i />
          </div>
          <span className="eyebrow">{label("continueEyebrow")}</span>
          <h2>{label(latest ? "continueLearning" : "beginLearning")}</h2>
          <p>{label(latest ? "continueBody" : "beginLearningBody")}</p>
          {latest ? (
            <button
              className="resume-resource"
              aria-label={label("resume") + " " + t(latest.title)}
              onClick={() => openDetail({ kind: "resource", item: latest })}
            >
              <BookOpen size={22} />
              <span>
                <small>{label("resume")}</small>
                <strong>{t(latest.title)}</strong>
              </span>
              <ArrowUpRight className="directional" size={21} />
            </button>
          ) : (
            <AppLink href="/my/learning" className="resume-resource">
              <BookOpen size={22} />
              <strong>{label("openMyLearning")}</strong>
              <ArrowUpRight className="directional" size={21} />
            </AppLink>
          )}
          <div className="review-meter">
            <div>
              <span>{label("reviewProgress")}</span>
              <strong>
                {reviewed}/{mine.length}
              </strong>
            </div>
            <progress
              max={Math.max(mine.length, 1)}
              value={reviewed}
              aria-label={label("reviewProgress")}
            />
            <small>{label("reviewNote")}</small>
          </div>
        </section>
        <section className="next-up-card">
          <div className="personal-section-heading">
            <h2>{label("workspaceUpcoming")}</h2>
            <AppLink href="/my/calendar" aria-label={label("openCalendar")}>
              <ArrowUpRight className="directional" size={20} />
            </AppLink>
          </div>
          <span className="demo-date-label">
            {label("demoDate")} · {formatDate(dateAtNoon(DEMO_TODAY), locale)}
          </span>
          {upcoming.map((item) => (
            <AppLink
              className="next-up-entry"
              key={item.id}
              href="/my/calendar"
            >
              <time dateTime={item.startsAt}>
                <b>{formatDate(item.startsAt, locale, { day: "numeric" })}</b>
                {formatDate(item.startsAt, locale, { month: "short" })}
              </time>
              <strong>{t(item.title)}</strong>
              <ArrowUpRight className="directional" size={15} />
            </AppLink>
          ))}
          {!upcoming.length && (
            <p className="workspace-note">{label("noUpcoming")}</p>
          )}
          <AppLink href="/my/notifications" className="updates-pill">
            <Sparkles size={15} />
            <b>{notifications.unread}</b>
            {label("unreadUpdates")}
            <ArrowUpRight className="directional" size={15} />
          </AppLink>
        </section>
      </div>
      <div className="personal-activity-grid">
        <section>
          <div className="personal-section-heading">
            <h2>{label("recentlyViewed")}</h2>
            <span className="eyebrow">{label("recentPreview")}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="activity-resource-list">
            {recent.slice(0, 3).map(({ resource, viewedAt }) => (
              <button
                key={resource.id}
                onClick={() => openDetail({ kind: "resource", item: resource })}
              >
                <Clock3 size={19} />
                <span>
                  <strong>{t(resource.title)}</strong>
                  <small>
                    {formatDate(viewedAt, locale, {
                      day: "numeric",
                      month: "short",
                    })}
                  </small>
                </span>
                {state.reviewedResourceIds.includes(resource.id) ? (
                  <Check size={16} aria-label={label("reviewed")} />
                ) : (
                  <ArrowUpRight className="directional" size={16} />
                )}
              </button>
            ))}
            {!recent.length && (
              <p className="personal-empty">{label("noRecent")}</p>
            )}
          </div>
        </section>
        <section>
          <div className="personal-section-heading">
            <h2>{label("courseUpdates")}</h2>
            <AppLink href="/my/learning" className="text-link">
              {label("viewAll")}
              <ArrowUpRight className="directional" size={15} />
            </AppLink>
          </div>
          <div className="activity-resource-list">
            {updates.map((r) => (
              <button
                key={r.id}
                onClick={() => openDetail({ kind: "resource", item: r })}
              >
                <BookOpen size={19} />
                <span>
                  <strong>{t(r.title)}</strong>
                  <small>
                    {formatDate(r.updatedAt, locale)} · {label(r.kind)}
                  </small>
                </span>
                <ArrowUpRight className="directional" size={16} />
              </button>
            ))}
            {!updates.length && (
              <p className="personal-empty">{label("noCourseUpdates")}</p>
            )}
          </div>
        </section>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useStudentProfile } from "../../hooks/useContent";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import StudyToolsPage from "./StudyToolsPage";
export default function PersonalFocusPage() {
  const profile = useStudentProfile();
  if (profile.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (profile.isError)
    return <ErrorState retry={() => void profile.refetch()} />;
  return <StudyToolsPage durationSeconds={profile.data.focusMinutes * 60} />;
}

FILE: src/features/utilities/StudyToolsPage.tsx
============================================================
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { useEffect, useState, useRef } from "react";
import { Play, Pause, RotateCcw, Timer } from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useSiteContent } from "../../hooks/useContent";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { PageIntro } from "../../components/data-display/PageIntro";
import { Button } from "../../components/ui/button";
import { Checkbox } from "../../components/ui/checkbox";
export default function StudyToolsPage({
  durationSeconds,
}: {
  durationSeconds?: number;
}) {
  const query = useSiteContent();
  const { data } = query;
  const { t, label } = useLocale();
  const duration = durationSeconds || data?.study.durationSeconds || 1500;
  const [seconds, setSeconds] = useState(duration);
  const [running, setRunning] = useState(false);
  const [checked, setChecked] = useState<number[]>([]);
  const end = useRef(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!running) return;
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      const left = Math.max(0, Math.ceil((end.current - Date.now()) / 1000));
      setSeconds(left);
      if (left === 0) {
        setRunning(false);
        toast(label("focusComplete"), { description: label("break") });
      }
    }, 250);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, [running, label]);
  useEffect(() => {
    setRunning(false);
    setSeconds(duration);
  }, [duration]);
  if (query.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (query.isError) return <ErrorState retry={() => void query.refetch()} />;
  if (!data) return null;
  function toggle() {
    if (running) setRunning(false);
    else {
      end.current = Date.now() + (seconds || duration) * 1000;
      setSeconds(seconds || duration);
      setRunning(true);
    }
  }
  return (
    <div className="container">
      <PageIntro
        title={t(data.study.title)}
        description={`${t(data.study.description)} ${label("timerNote")}`}
        eyebrow={label("tools")}
      />
      <div className="utilities-grid">
        <section className="utility-card">
          <Timer size={28} />
          <h2>{label("focus")}</h2>
          <p>{label("focusBody")}</p>
          <div
            role="timer"
            aria-label={label("remaining")}
            className="timer"
            dir="ltr"
          >
            {String(Math.floor(seconds / 60)).padStart(2, "0")}:
            {String(seconds % 60).padStart(2, "0")}
          </div>
          <div className="utility-actions">
            <Button className="button button-primary" onClick={toggle}>
              {running ? <Pause size={17} /> : <Play size={17} />}{" "}
              {label(running ? "pause" : "start")}
            </Button>
            <Button
              className="button button-outline"
              variant="outline"
              onClick={() => {
                setRunning(false);
                setSeconds(duration);
              }}
            >
              <RotateCcw size={17} />
              {label("reset")}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </section>
        <section className="utility-card">
          <h2>{label("before")}</h2>
          <p>{label("checklistNote")}</p>
          <div className="study-checklist">
            {data.study.checklist.map((item, i) => (
              <label key={i}>
                <Checkbox
                  checked={checked.includes(i)}
                  onCheckedChange={(value) =>
                    setChecked((current) =>
                      value === true
                        ? [...current, i]
                        : current.filter((n) => n !== i),
                    )
                  }
                />
                <span className={checked.includes(i) ? "completed-task" : ""}>
                  {t(item)}
                </span>
              </label>
            ))}
          </div>
        </section>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/App.tsx
============================================================
import { BrowserRouter, useInRouterContext } from "react-router-dom";
import { AppProviders } from "./app/providers/AppProviders";
import { AppRouter } from "./app/router/AppRouter";
import { AppErrorBoundary } from "./components/feedback/AppErrorBoundary";
import type { MedClubServices } from "./services/contracts";
import type { Locale } from "./types/content";
import "./styles/index.css";
export interface AppProps {
  services?: MedClubServices;
  initialLocale?: Locale;
}
export default function App(props: AppProps) {
  const insideRouter = useInRouterContext();
  const content = (
    <AppErrorBoundary>
      <AppProviders {...props}>
        <AppRouter />
      </AppProviders>
    </AppErrorBoundary>
  );
  return insideRouter ? (
    content
  ) : (
    <BrowserRouter
      basename={import.meta.env.BASE_URL.replace(/\/$/, "") || "/"}
    >
      {content}
    </BrowserRouter>
  );
}

FILE: src/ARCHITECTURE.md

# MedClub source architecture — V0.11

| Directory               | Responsibility                                                                 |
| ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `app/router`            | Lazy public/auth/personal routes, guarded return paths, titles and transitions |
| `app/providers`         | Query, services, auth, locale, appearance, workspace and overlay state         |
| `app/layouts`           | Distinct public, auth and personal application worlds                          |
| `components/ui`         | Reusable controls and native-dialog modal lifecycle                            |
| `components/navigation` | Responsive rails, phone dock, overflow measurement and feature navigation      |
| `components/cards`      | Academic, discovery, community, mentorship, store and recruitment presentation |
| `features/auth`         | Sign-in, registration, verification, recovery and WebGL identity field         |
| `features/profile`      | Authenticated account details, editing and sign-out                            |
| `features/recruitment`  | Public positions, applications, onboarding, team identity and volunteer hours  |
| `features/*`            | Other feature-owned screens, workflows and selectors                           |
| `data/mock`             | Typed illustrative content outside JSX                                         |
| `services`              | API contracts, local preview adapters, search and persistence                  |
| `hooks`                 | Shared queries, mutations, content paths and scroll-cue measurement            |
| `types`                 | Auth, content, student, workspace, commerce and recruitment contracts          |
| `constants`             | Configuration, route builders and bilingual messages                           |
| `styles`                | Tokens, RTL/accessibility and cumulative release layers                        |
| `admin`                 | Operations, review, audit, versions and the visual page-composition workspace  |
| `admin/builder`         | Page library, typed block canvas, inspector, preview and editing history       |
| Reserved admin folders  | Future users, roles and broader management modules                             |

## Identity flow

`AuthProvider` consumes the injected `AuthService`; pages never read browser storage directly. `RequireAuth` resolves three states: loading, anonymous, or authenticated. Anonymous requests are redirected to `/auth/sign-in` with a same-origin `returnTo`; unverified registrations are directed to `/auth/verify`. `safeReturnTo` accepts only internal paths.

The local adapter owns the demo account and browser-local registrations. It normalizes corrupt storage, broadcasts cross-tab changes, avoids raw registered-password storage, updates the shared personal-profile query and falls back to tab memory if storage is blocked. These behaviors make a coherent preview, not a security system.

The production replacement must establish identity on the server. It must not trust student IDs, role names, route visibility, local storage or client capability checks.

## Four application worlds

- Public: discovery-focused MedClub pages and public navigation.
- Auth: task-first form surface paired with a decorative medical WebGL field; no public or personal rail.
- Personal: protected My MedClub shell with account-aware profile data and a clear return to the public platform.
- Admin: protected operations shell with explicit review, audit and version boundaries.

`SpaceTransition` distinguishes all four without hiding a focused descendant. Titles and route focus are managed centrally.

## Admin operations

`AdminService` owns overview metrics, content workflow records, activity history and versions. Pages consume it only through query hooks. The local adapter validates allowed status transitions, requires notes for requested changes, blocks publication without approval/rights/references and appends versions and activity records for every mutation.

Restoration copies an earlier snapshot into a new version; it never deletes history. Activity records are read-only in the interface and intentionally exclude arbitrary values that could become secrets.

The V0.10 route guard proves identity only. It is not a permissions system. A production adapter must enforce capability-based authorization, founder protection, reviewer assignment, high-risk approvals and immutable audit persistence on the server. Those governance rules remain V0.12 scope.

## Page composition

`BuilderService` owns page documents, summaries, reusable blocks and milestone versions. The editor consumes the service through query hooks and keeps its working canvas in an undo/redo history. A debounced save writes the current structured document; public rendering is represented by the same `BuilderBlockPreview` contract rather than raw HTML.

Each block has a stable ID, a typed kind, bilingual content, an enabled state, audience/language visibility and an optional schedule. Page-level records add path, theme, audience, SEO metadata, status and revision. Groups contain related child blocks, while data blocks identify their source rather than embedding fetched API results.

Publishing and scheduling first save the latest draft and then append a milestone version. Restoration copies a prior snapshot into a new draft revision without deleting later history. Browser-local persistence is only a preview adapter: production must validate documents, resolve schedules, sanitize rich content, store assets, enforce capabilities and publish atomically on the server.

## WebGL field

`MedicalFieldCanvas` is a dependency-free WebGL renderer. It builds a double-helix-style point field plus low-density depth particles, uses restrained pointer parallax, caps rendering density, pauses when offscreen and cleans up listeners/resources. It is `aria-hidden` and has no semantic responsibility. Missing WebGL and `prefers-reduced-motion` use the static CSS composition.

## Navigation containment

`useNavigationScrollCues` measures the public and personal rail in either orientation using scroll events, resize observation and route changes. Scroll regions own their overflow, native scrollbars are hidden, and logical shadow cues indicate content above/below or before/after. Horizontal mega-menu content sits outside the clipping region so it remains usable while destinations cannot leak out of the rail.

## Existing domain architecture

V0.1–V0.8 retain the `UI → hooks/providers → MedClubServices → adapter` boundary. Academic relationships, normalized workspace persistence, search, notifications, event registration, opportunities, community, journal review, mentorship, contributions, store reservations and identity continue to share typed records and account profile.

## Recruitment workflow

`RecruitmentPosition` describes public role facts. `RecruitmentApplication` owns the student's form, stage, history, interview and onboarding tasks. `ClubMembershipProfile` owns organizational team identity, simultaneous positions and volunteer-hour records. These records are related, but none grants a website capability.

`useRecruitmentWorkspace` resolves the authenticated student, then calls the injected recruitment service. Public role queries remain usable without authentication; applications and membership do not. Search indexes public positions, calendar composes scheduled interviews, and notifications derive status updates from the same records.

The local adapter normalizes malformed storage, locks submitted drafts, prevents duplicate active applications and limits withdrawal/onboarding mutations to valid states. A production service must re-enforce every transition server-side and record reviewer identity, reasons, consent and audit events.

ISO timestamps retain explicit offsets and presentation uses `APP_TIMEZONE` (`Asia/Amman`). A production backend must own identity, time-sensitive authorization, recruitment decisions, hour verification, data retention and notification delivery.

# Console report — V0.8

## What the supplied messages mean

| Console message                                | Finding                                                  |
| ---------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| [vite] connecting / connected                  | Normal development-server connection messages            |
| Download React DevTools                        | Informational development hint, not an application error |
| Blocked aria-hidden … button.phone-search      | Application modal focus issue addressed in V0.3          |
| VM906 … reportAllChanges … undefined.startTime | Origin not established; not claimed fixed                |

## Focus fix

The old search overlay used a controlled Radix dialog without its own trigger, together with custom requestAnimationFrame focus restoration. Background hiding could run while the triggering phone-search button still held focus, and focus could be restored before the overlay finished closing.

The shared Modal now uses the native HTML dialog element and showModal/close. The browser coordinates modality, background inertness, initial focus, Escape cancellation and opener restoration. Search, resource details, collection dialogs, study editing, mobile navigation and appearance all use this lifecycle. No global console filtering, aria-hidden removal loop, or accessibility-disable workaround is installed.

The route focus effect also checks whether focus moved after navigation started; it no longer overrides a newly opened menu/dialog.

Relevant primary documentation:

- [WAI: native HTML dialog technique](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Techniques/html/H102)
- [WAI modal dialog pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/dialog-modal/)
- [HTML dialog specification](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/interactive-elements.html#the-dialog-element)

### Verify in your browser

1. Keep the Console visible and use the phone navigation search button.
2. Confirm the search input receives focus, Tab stays inside the modal, and background links cannot receive focus.
3. Press Escape. Focus should return to the opening search button.
4. Search for cardiac, open The cardiac cycle, then close details. Confirm a single modal is open at a time.
5. Repeat with the mobile menu, appearance switcher, collection editor and calendar editor.
6. Navigate between public and personal pages; verify route focus and no repeated aria-hidden warnings.

DOM tests exercise our open/close lifecycle with a native-dialog test double. They do not prove the real browser's top-layer or assistive-technology behavior.

## The `VM###` / `startTime` exception

`VM272`, `VM906` and similar names are runtime-generated script labels, not stable source filenames. The earlier supplied stack contains `reportAllChanges` inside an anonymous two-line script. That symbol is absent from the MedClub source and from the inspected React, React DOM, Framer Motion, Radix, cmdk, Vite and TanStack runtime package trees. This is therefore not a MedClub component exception. It is injected by the preview host, developer tooling or a browser extension.

Do not add global error suppression or random `startTime` checks to MedClub components. There is no corresponding failing statement in the supplied source to patch, and hiding it would also hide real failures.

Practical resolution:

1. Open the same localhost page in an Incognito/InPrivate window with extensions disabled.
2. If the exception disappears, re-enable extensions one at a time and update or remove the one that injects `reportAllChanges`.
3. If it remains only inside an embedded site preview, open the Vite localhost URL directly. The preview's monitoring layer is the source.
4. If it remains in a clean direct browser session, enable **Pause on uncaught exceptions**, click the `VM###:2` source link and inspect its source URL. A `chrome-extension://` URL identifies the extension; a preview-host URL identifies the host.
5. The two Vite connection messages and the React DevTools suggestion are informational, not errors.

If it remains in a clean direct session, inspect the integrating project's `index.html` and Vite plugins for extra monitoring code; setup files are not part of this source-only delivery. The script origin and the small function around `reportAllChanges`, with credentials or tokens removed, are the missing details required for a targeted patch.

[Chrome DevTools JavaScript debugging reference](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/devtools/javascript/reference)

This release cannot certify that an unidentified script outside the provided source has been fixed.

| `cmdk`                     | 1.1.1                      |
| `framer-motion`            | 12.43.0                    |
| `lucide-react`             | 1.39.0                     |
| `radix-ui`                 | 1.6.7                      |
| `react`                    | 19.2.6                     |
| `react-dom`                | 19.2.6                     |
| `react-router-dom`         | 7.18.3                     |
| `sonner`                   | 2.0.8                      |
| `tailwind-merge`           | 3.6.0                      |

Required styling packages: `tailwindcss` 4, `tw-animate-css`, and either your existing Tailwind Vite integration or `@tailwindcss/postcss` 4. The verification build used TypeScript 5.9.3 and Vite 8.0.13.

For an existing React project missing these runtime dependencies:

```bash
npm install react-router-dom @tanstack/react-query framer-motion radix-ui lucide-react cmdk sonner clsx class-variance-authority tailwind-merge tw-animate-css
```

Configure Tailwind 4 once in the existing project. For a PostCSS setup, install `tailwindcss` and `@tailwindcss/postcss` and use:

```js
// postcss.config.mjs
export default { plugins: { "@tailwindcss/postcss": {} } };
```

Do not keep a Tailwind 3 PostCSS configuration alongside this one. The stylesheet imports Tailwind itself; do not also import the Vite starter CSS. Keep TypeScript JSX mode `react-jsx`, DOM types and Vite client types enabled. No path alias is needed.

The source contains no external credentials, live API URL, downloadable course files or remote font dependency.

## Bundled fonts

Manrope (Latin, variable 200–800) and Noto Sans Arabic (Arabic, variable 100–900) are included as WOFF2 files with their SIL Open Font License notices. They are served from the source assets, with `font-display: swap`. No font package or external font provider is required in your existing project.

# V0.1 visual and personal-workspace revision

The content/services architecture is retained. The application shell and visual composition are redesigned.

| Area                        | Revised behavior                                                                                                                                   |
| --------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Desktop/laptop navigation   | Persistent left sidebar with expand/collapse, labeled compact icons, active destinations, Learn disclosure and Appearance control                  |
| Optional desktop navigation | Horizontal top navigation with the same destinations and a Learn dropdown                                                                          |
| Phone navigation            | Horizontal floating bottom dock; Home, Learn, Search, Saved and More; safe-area spacing                                                            |
| Navigation preference       | A working Appearance dialog; changes persist locally; invalid values use the sidebar default; unavailable storage keeps the change for the session |
| Hero                        | Large Manrope heading, red accent, layered CSS sculpture around the original logo, community link and full-width search entry                      |
| Page composition            | Warm canvas, rounded panels, soft surfaces, distinct academic/event/journal sections                                                               |
| Typography                  | Bundled variable Manrope and Noto Sans Arabic, with local files and licenses                                                                       |
| Components                  | Rounded resources, pathways, opportunities, course cards, event dates, dialogs and controls                                                        |
| Motion                      | Short hover transitions and existing reduced-motion support; no scroll hijacking                                                                   |
| Arabic                      | Localized interface and settings; mirrored content/icon direction; the desktop sidebar remains on the left as requested                            |
| Personal entry              | My profile enters `/my` with a short fade and warm tint; reduced-motion users get an immediate change                                              |
| Personal shell              | Dark russet sidebar, warm quiet canvas, personal monogram, own learning, saved collection, focus, profile and settings                             |
| Personal phone navigation   | Home, Learn, Saved, Focus and Profile; Settings remains available in the header                                                                    |
| Returning                   | Back to MedClub appears in every personal page's header and restores the public home and its navigation                                            |

## Extending settings later

`AppearanceProvider` owns typed navigation orientation and `sidebarCollapsed` values in the existing `medclub.appearance.v1` storage record. Previous orientation-only records remain valid and start expanded. Navigation components consume these preferences without managing storage. A future account-settings adapter can replace persistence and retain the UI contract.

V0.8 adds the browser-local account preview and editable identity. Preferences and account data are still device-local; production sessions and server-synced preferences remain future work.

## Verification

Strict TypeScript and production build pass. Component/data verification covers the original public flows plus compact navigation persistence, preference migration, public/personal entry and return, personal course links, scoped search, saved counts and profile recovery. Exact results are recorded in `V0.1-CHECKLIST.md`.

The browser security policy blocked the local visual preview, so real-device layout and pixel-level visual acceptance remain unverified. The delivered archive contains only the updated `src/` tree; the temporary verification harness and development dependencies are excluded.

FILE: src/PERSONAL-WORKSPACE.md

# Personal workspace extension points

The public experience and My MedClub are independent route layouts. The shared providers keep saved items, language and appearance stable while the page frame changes.

## Sidebar

`SidebarToggle` is used by both sidebars. `AppearanceProvider` stores `{ navigation, sidebarCollapsed }` under the existing `medclub.appearance.v1` key. Older orientation-only records work without a migration step; absent collapse state means expanded. Invalid storage uses the default vertical, expanded sidebar. If a write fails, the changed state still works for the session.

At widths of 768 px and above, vertical navigation can collapse to a 76 px icon rail. `NavigationHint` adds hover/focus labels in this mode; accessible link names remain in the DOM. The compact Learn disclosure opens beside the public rail. Horizontal navigation ignores the compact state visually while retaining its value. Phones always use the bottom dock.

## Personal layout and routes

`PersonalLayout` mounts its own navigation and header. The public footer and public menu are not mounted. All personal subpages share that frame; only the content changes. The header includes Back to MedClub, scoped search, language and settings. The default entry is the dashboard at `/my`; identity details are at `/my/profile`.

`SpaceTransition` detects crossings between `/my/*` and public routes. It keys only that boundary and uses a short opacity transition with a fading tint. It honors reduced motion and avoids transforming the fixed-navigation ancestor. Direct loads do not play an entrance transition. Overlays close on route changes, and the personal not-found page links back into the personal home.

`useWorkspacePaths` chooses public or personal course URLs and breadcrumb roots. Use it for new reusable academic components so a personal link does not unexpectedly open the public shell. Personal search filters results using the profile's course IDs and navigates to `/my/learning/:slug`.

## Data and persistence

`StudentProfile` is defined in `types/student.ts`. `MedClubServices.personal.getProfile()` supplies it, currently from `data/mock/student.ts`. Set its `courseIds` to existing course IDs. Its `focusMinutes` initializes the personal timer; it is not a count of time spent. Dashboard saved counts are computed from records that still exist, using the same selector as the library.

Only sample identity is shown. Browser-local saved items and preferences are working features; authentication, editable identity, account-specific storage and server synchronization are not implemented. A future signed-in implementation must provide real backend access checks and account-scoped persistence. The visual separation is not a security boundary.

No new package dependencies were added for this revision. Replace the complete `src` tree together, since routes, service types, providers, translations and shared cards changed alongside the new pages.

# MedClub V0.10 design direction

## Concept: the clinical control room

Admin is a separate operational product, not a public page with extra buttons. The V0.10 shell shifts into a dark diagnostic environment while preserving the red/russet MedClub identity. Warm content surfaces sit inside a focused control plane so long review sessions remain readable.

## Signature behavior

- A restrained ECG signal, diagnostic rings and breathing control mark establish the admin world on arrival.
- Navigation icons run a short instrument-check motion on hover; active icons emit a quiet diagnostic ring.
- Metric cards expose their signal color through a fast scan instead of generic scale animation.
- Content review uses a queue-and-inspector workbench on large screens and a stable stacked flow on smaller screens.
- Activity history pairs searchable operations with a before/after inspector.
- Version comparison places the current and selected snapshots side by side; restoration explicitly creates a new version.
- V0.8 authentication remains the only WebGL surface. Admin motion is CSS-only and operational.

## UX rules

- Nothing moves directly from review to publication. Approval and publication are separate decisions.
- Requesting changes requires an explanatory note.
- Publication requires an approved state, confirmed rights and at least one reference.
- Activity history offers no edit or delete operation.
- Restoration preserves every previous version and appends a new audit event.
- Preview access is visibly separated from production authorization.
- The admin navigation follows the existing vertical/horizontal preference on larger screens and becomes a fixed horizontal dock on phones.

## Accessibility and responsive rules

- Every workbench preserves a linear DOM order: queue first, inspector second.
- Status is always represented by text, not color alone.
- Scrollable tab and navigation regions hide native bars without disabling touch, wheel or keyboard input.
- Mobile controls remain at least 44 px and form text remains zoom-safe.
- Logical properties and mirrored directional icons support Arabic RTL.
- `prefers-reduced-motion` removes scans, pulses, orbiting and hover displacement.

## Honest boundary

V0.10 demonstrates admin operations with device-local sample data. It does not implement production permissions. V0.12 remains responsible for capability enforcement, protected founders, high-risk approval and immutable server audit storage.

# MedClub V0.11 design direction

## Concept: the living clinical canvas

The page builder extends the V0.10 control room without becoming a generic rectangular CMS. Dark instrument controls frame a warm page canvas. Red diagnostic pulses identify active state, while the actual page remains readable and close to its public appearance.

## Signature behavior

- The page library introduces CMS activity through a restrained node signal rather than dashboard decoration.
- Palette icons perform a short instrument check on hover.
- The canvas narrows smoothly between desktop, tablet and phone frames.
- Selected blocks expose a floating instrument strip with drag, move, duplicate and delete controls.
- Audience and schedule rules remain visible as annotations instead of being hidden in settings.
- Autosave behaves like a quiet cloud signal; it never blocks composition.
- Preview uses the exact structured block renderer used inside the canvas.

## UX rules

- The page is data, not hard-coded JSX or arbitrary HTML.
- Drag and drop is never the only reordering mechanism.
- Published edits return to draft until explicitly republished.
- Publishing and scheduling save the latest canvas first.
- Restoration creates a new draft revision and keeps all milestone history.
- Local image uploads are visibly described as preview-only.
- Status, audience and save state always include text, not only color.

## Responsive and accessibility rules

- Desktop uses a three-zone palette, canvas and inspector workbench.
- Medium layouts keep the canvas primary and move the inspector below it.
- Phones present canvas, block library and inspector in task order above the existing admin dock.
- Navigation and editor scrollers hide native bars while retaining touch, wheel and keyboard scrolling.
- Arabic uses logical layout and localized page and block content.
- Reduced motion removes scans, orbiting, pulses and width interpolation.

## Honest boundary

V0.11 is a complete front-end CMS preview backed by device-local structured documents. Its Publish action updates the preview repository; it does not deploy a public website. Production needs a server publishing pipeline, validated rich text, durable media storage, scheduling jobs, cache invalidation, permissions and immutable audit integration.
